izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfuls.name: Mindful Attention Awareness Scale
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfuls.summary: Find out how mindful you are on a scale of 1 to 6
izzyondroid:biz.binarysolutions.mindfuls.description:
The Mindful Attention Awareness Scale (MAAS) is a 15-item scale designed to assess a core characteristic of dispositional mindfulness, namely, open or receptive awareness of and attention to what is taking place in the present.
 The scale shows strong psychometric properties and has been validated with college, community, and cancer patient samples.
 Correlational, quasi-experimental, and laboratory studies have shown that the MAAS taps a unique quality of consciousness that is related to, and predictive of, a variety of self-regulation and well-being constructs.
 The measure takes 10 minutes or less to complete.
 Reference: Brown, K.W. & Ryan, R.M. (2003). The benefits of being present: Mindfulness and its role in psychological well-being. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 84, 822-848.

izzyondroid:com.mgoogle.android.gms.name: Vanced microG
izzyondroid:com.mgoogle.android.gms.summary: MicroG tweaked to work for applications such as Vanced
izzyondroid:com.mgoogle.android.gms.description:
microG GmsCore is a FLOSS (Free/Libre Open Source Software) framework to allow applications designed for Google Play Services to run on systems, where Play Services is not available.
 This fork tweaks MicroG to be usable by applications that require Google authentication such as Vanced.
 Notable changes: 
 No longer a system app
 Package name changed from com.google.android.gms to com.mgoogle.android.gms to support installation alongside the official MicroG
 Removed unnecessary features
 Removed all permissions, as none are required for Google authentication
 Note: microG (and so this fork of it) provides FOSS replacements for proprietary libraries in order to make apps which depend on such work. So a scanner will find the names used by those original, proprietary libraries as if they were there (which is how the apps needing them find them). Still the app won't be marked with the corresponding AntiFeatures, as those would apply to the original libraries only. NonFreeNet is still applied for Google authentication. Tracking is not, as Firebase Analytics here is just a stub (an „empty shell“ without functionality).

fdroid:com.slavabarkov.tidy.description:

Search for images in your Gallery by text description and other visually similar images. TIDY works entirely offline, ensuring your privacy and security.
Features:
* Text-to-Image Search - Simply type in a description of the image you are looking for, and TIDY will retrieve the most relevant matches from your local image library. Text-to-Image search functionality in TIDY goes beyond traditional keyword-based searches! You can use longer and more detailed descriptions to find the exact image you have in mind.
* Image-to-Image Search - Search for visually similar images by choosing a photo from your device's gallery. TIDY will analyze the image and retrieve images with similar visual features, allowing you to explore and discover new images in a whole new way.
First launch:

Once this initial indexing process is complete, the app will store the index on your device, and any new photos you add to your photo library will be automatically added to the index on the subsequent app launches.

fdroid:com.zerotoship.z2term.name: Z2Term
fdroid:com.zerotoship.z2term.summary: Rootless Linux terminal with a GUI, SSH, automation and a Japanese IME.
fdroid:com.zerotoship.z2term.description:
Z2Term is a terminal for Android that is also a way to drive Android.
It runs Alpine, Ubuntu, Arch and Kali without root, opens a Linux desktop in a tab, and lets the shell reach the phone itself: read a notification, ask you a question in the notification shade, or run a script when the battery, the network or an incoming SMS changes.
* Linux distributions without root: z2root is a ptrace-based userspace implementation written for this app and built from source. A real chroot is optionally available on rooted devices.
* Terminal emulator: VT100/xterm, 256-colour and true colour, alternate screen, East Asian Width (CJK / emoji) rendered as 2 cells, OSC 4/7/8/10/11/12/52
* 9 built-in themes plus a custom theme editor, and custom font loading
* 5,000-line scrollback (configurable 500-50,000) with search
* Multi-tab sessions with independent emulators, drag to reorder
* Linux GUI: Xvnc + openbox with an RFB client built into the app, with audio and video. "z2gui" starts a desktop, "z2run " launches a GUI program. The same screen also connects to another machine over VNC or RDP.
* SSH client and SFTP built in (public-key auth, secrets encrypted by the Android Keystore), port forwarding in both directions that can outlive the tab, plus a built-in sshd that binds to localhost only by default
* Android bridge: around 40 "z2-*" helpers call host features from the shell (notifications, clipboard, battery, sensors, torch, intents, alarms, text-to-speech, and wireless adb to the device itself)
* It can ask you things: "z2-ask" puts a question in the notification shade and reads your reply into a shell variable
* Automation hub: "z2-when" runs scripts on device events (charging, battery level, time or cron, Wi-Fi, connectivity, boot, a share from another app, an incoming SMS, sensors, an arriving notification, a new file), narrowed by filters. Rules are plain text and survive reboots without opening the app.
* Resident servers: register any server as a start command and keep it running in the background without the app being open
* Edge panels: "z2-edge" builds a panel that floats over other apps. It holds commands, macros and app launches as buttons, plus notes and a mini terminal. Open it by swiping the bar at the screen edge; it can be edited on screen as well
* Screen actions: "z2-action" sends taps, swipes and gestures from the shell. Steps live in a plain text file with repeats, conditions and calls to other step files. They can also be edited on screen or recorded by tracing with a finger, and run from a tile, a widget or an edge panel
* QR tools: scan and create QR codes offline, with a history; "z2-qr" makes one from the terminal as well
* Screenshots of just what you want: "z2-shot" grabs the screen, you draw around the part to keep, then save or share it
* Read what you built: "z2-view" opens a page made on the terminal inside the app, with JavaScript and network loads switched off
* Japanese IME: kana-kanji conversion with prediction and learning, and a custom on-screen keyboard that can also be enabled as an OS-wide input method. Its key layout is editable on every face (kana, letters, symbols) and can be saved under a name
* Terminal log: record what a tab shows to a plain text file with one tap
* Home screen widgets: a status and macro launcher, and a live tail of any file
* Receive from other apps' share sheet (inserted into the input line, never executed)
* Backup and restore: settings, SSH connections, snippets, automation rules and macros in one file
* Built-in help ("z2help") and self-diagnosis ("z2doctor") that answers "why isn't it working?" with a next step on every NG line
* A foreground service keeps your session alive, physical keyboards work (Bluetooth, Chromebook), and there is long-press selection, copy/paste and pinch-to-zoom
100% local - no telemetry, no analytics. This build bundles no third-party prebuilts: the Linux distribution is downloaded from the official CDN on first launch and verified by S

fdroid:de.spoolmaker.android.name: Spool Maker
fdroid:de.spoolmaker.android.summary: Read and create NFC spool tags for UltiMaker 3D printers
fdroid:de.spoolmaker.android.description:
Spool Maker is a free Android app for the NFC spool tags used with UltiMaker 3D printers.
UltiMaker filament spools use NFC tags (RFID) so the printer can identify material and spool information. With Spool Maker, you can read the data stored on these tags directly with an NFC-enabled Android device. The app is designed to read both original UltiMaker spool tags and tags written with Spool Maker.
You can also create new UltiMaker-compatible spool tags on writable NTAG media. The original UltiMaker tags examined for this project are NTAG216. Spool Maker also supports writing NTAG215 tags; the 228-byte payload fits in their user memory as well. However, NTAG215 has not yet been tested by the project maintainer with an actual UltiMaker printer.
Material profiles can be imported from Cura/UltiMaker .xml.fdm_material files and managed in a local material library. When writing a tag, you can select the material, total spool weight and remaining amount. For tags written by Spool Maker, the date field can also be assigned a meaning: manufactured, purchased, opened, created, or no date.
When reading a tag, Spool Maker displays information such as the UID, material GUID, total and remaining amount, date/time information, batch and station data, and integrity information. For technical inspection, all decoded values and the raw tag data can also be viewed and copied.
Before writing, the app checks the tag type and relevant lock and protection areas. After writing, the data is read back and verified so incomplete or failed writes can be detected.
The app works entirely locally: no Internet permission, no account, no ads, no trackers and no telemetry.
The supported tag format is based on independent analysis and reverse engineering of original UltiMaker NFC spool tags and selected printer firmware. Spool Maker is an independent community project and is not an official UltiMaker product. Compatibility may vary with printer model and firmware version.

apple-macos:1526775001.name: Lockbook: Private Notes
apple-macos:1526775001.description:
Lockbook is an end-to-end encrypted notes app for writing, sketching, storing files, syncing across devices, and collaborating in real time. Your notes are encrypted before they leave your device, so even we can't read them.
Lockbook is 100% open source:
https://github.com/lockbook/lockbook
Fast & Native:
We built Lockbook for everyday use because we use Lockbook every day. Our native apps feel at home on every platform, with fast sync, offline support, and a polished Markdown editor for serious notes.
Secure:
Keep your thoughts to yourself. Lockbook encrypts your notes with keys generated on your devices. Only you and the people you share with can access your notes, folders, sketches, and files.
Private:
Know your customer? We sure don't. We don't collect your email, phone number, or name. We don't need a password. Lockbook is for people with better things to worry about than privacy.
Collaborative:
Share folders, edit notes together, and see live updates from collaborators without giving up end-to-end encryption.
Open:
Write in Markdown, sketch in SVG, and keep your work in formats you can actually use.
Honest:
Be the customer, not the product. We sell a note-taking app, not your data.
Developer Friendly:
The Lockbook CLI fits right into your favorite chain of piped-together Unix commands. Search your notes with fzf, edit them with vim, and schedule backups with cron. When scripting doesn't cut it, use our Rust library for a robust programmatic interface.

apple-macos:494803304.name: WiFi Explorer: Scanner
apple-macos:494803304.description:
Discover, monitor, and troubleshoot wireless networks with WiFi Explorer.
Quickly identify channel conflicts, signal overlapping, or configuration problems that may affect the connectivity and performance of your home, office, or enterprise wireless network.
Get an insight into the network details: name (SSID), MAC address (BSSID), device manufacturer, signal strength (RSSI), noise, channel, band, security configuration, supported data rates, 802.11 information elements (IE), and much more.
• Suitable for home and small office networks
• Easy-to-use, intuitive user interface
• Graphical visualization of the Wi-Fi environment
• Supports 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz frequency bands as well as 20, 40, 80, 160, and 320 MHz channels
• Supports Wi-Fi 4, 5, 6, 6E, and 7
• Works with 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be networks
Also:
• Signal quality ratings based on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)
• Accurate conversion from dBm to percentage (%) for more straightforward analysis and optimization
• Detailed description of information elements (IE) advertised by the access point for advanced troubleshooting
• Export metrics and network details to CSV file format
• Save results for later review and analysis
• Access point name discovery (if supported)
• Editable column for labels or annotations
• Selectable and sortable columns
• Adjustable graph timescales
• Quick filtering
• Customizable colors for easily tracking particular networks
• Full-screen mode and split-view support
Are you a wireless engineer or IT professional working in the design, validation, management, or troubleshooting of enterprise wireless networks? Consider WiFi Explorer Pro 3. To learn more, visit www.intuitibits.com.
Notes:

• Requires a Mac with built-in Wi-Fi 6E for scanning networks on the 6 GHz band.

apple-macos:662002418.name: Italian Food by Blue Guides
apple-macos:662002418.description:
The Blue Guides Italian Food App is your pocket dictionary and miscellany of all the Italian food and drink you are likely to find on a menu or in a market. Suitable for browsing or on-site use, it is a self-contained app which once downloaded does not need Internet access and thus incurs no expensive roaming charges or download delays. With full searchability and indexing you can find what you want instantly. Audio guidance provides instant help pronouncing what you're eating.
The free version is limited to around 500 of the most common terms you'll find, or you can upgrade in-app to access all 2000+ entries.
The app is based on the content of the Blue Guide Italy Food Companion, described as a “Phrasebook & Miscellany”, which, as well as the useful dictionary, gives background, facts and guidance, for example on such things as the seasonality of particular foods, historical origins, classical references or regional specialities. All of this content is available in the app. The book is available at good bookshops for £6.99 / $10.95.
Blue Guides has been a leading publisher of cultural, English-language travel guides since the series’ launch in 1918. Described as “guidebooks in the grand tradition of thoroughness and objectivity” (Georgia Review), the guides maintain to this day their high standards of research and scholarship. With a strong range of Italy titles, this handy companion on Italian food is an ideal complement to a good guide book.

flathub:dev.linwood.butterfly.name: Linwood Butterfly
flathub:dev.linwood.butterfly.description:
Butterfly is an open-source app for people who think better with space around their ideas. Instead of
 writing everything from top to bottom on a fixed page, you get an endless workspace where you can place
 notes, sketches, diagrams, images, and documents wherever they make sense.
 Use it for class notes, meeting notes, research, math, worksheets, planning, whiteboarding, storyboards,
 product sketches, or any project that starts messy and needs room to grow. Write by hand with a stylus,
 touch, or mouse, type text and Markdown, add shapes and lines, place images and photos, import PDFs,
 SVGs, and image files, then export your work as PDF, SVG, images, or portable Butterfly files.
 Butterfly tries to stay out of your way while you work. Recent files, quick-start templates, search,
 folders, imports, page navigation, and tool settings are close when you need them, but the document
 stays at the center. You can begin with a plain page, ruled paper, a grid, dotted paper, music paper,
 or your own template.
 As your document grows, Butterfly gives you ways to keep it understandable. Split work into pages and
 page folders, use layers, mark important places with areas and waypoints, save reusable parts in packs,
 and keep palettes and text styles ready for the next document. Almost everything you add remains
 editable, so you can move, resize, recolor, reorder, and refine your work later instead of starting
 over.
 Your files stay under your control. Work offline, store documents on your device, choose a different
 data directory, or connect WebDAV and Nextcloud if you want your own sync setup. There is no required
 account, no required subscription, and no required proprietary cloud.
 Butterfly is free, community translated, available on phones, tablets, desktops, and the web, and
 developed in public under the AGPL-3.0 license.

flathub:io.jor.ottomatic.name: Otto Matic
flathub:io.jor.ottomatic.summary: Save the Earth from the clutches of the Giant Brain from Planet X
flathub:io.jor.ottomatic.description:
The year is 1957 and a fleet of flying saucers from Planet X have come to Earth. These saucers are under the control of the evil Brain Aliens who are abducting helpless human beings and taking them away to strange alien worlds to become slaves of The Giant Brain. Luckily for the human race there exist the Otto Matics, robots who police the galaxy in name of all that is good and decent.
 You are Otto Matic, the robot who is given the job of saving Earth from the clutches of The Giant Brain from Planet X. You must rescue as many humans as you can while defeating the Brain Aliens and all of their evil followers. Your mission will take you to strange and fantastic alien worlds which are often treacherous and will require Otto to perform amazing feats.
 Your rocket ship will take you to each of the planets, starting with Earth. While on each planet you must save as many humans as you can, but be careful because the Brain Aliens will try to abduct the humans before you can save them. When you save humans, they are teleported to your rocket ship. To escape the planet you must also collect rocket fuel. Once The Giant Brain has been defeated and peace restored to the galaxy, you will return to Earth with your human cargo where they will be freed.
 In Otto Matic...
 10 levels on strange alien planets!
 Battle 25 different alien creatures!
 Attack with 7 different types of space-age weapons
 Fight off giant radioactive killer vegetables!
 Ski behind giant metal beasts on a sea of toxic ooze!
 Ride soap bubbles across noxious lakes of slimy goo!
 Get shot out of a cannon!
 Smash alien clowns in hovercraft bumper-cars!
 Drink radioactive potions to grow to 50ft tall!
 Ride a zip-line to escape mutant radioactive robots!
 Pilot a flying saucer and lay waste to an alien fortress!
 Battle the Giant Brain from Planet X
 And much, much more!
 About this port: Otto Matic was released in 2001 by Pangea Software. It was a pack-in game on Macs that came out around that time. This port aims to provide the best way to experience the game today. This port was made and re-released under permission from Pangea Software, Inc.

flathub:org.indii.mendingwall.name: Mending Wall
flathub:org.indii.mendingwall.description:
Mending Wall eliminates common problems when using more than one desktop environment (e.g. GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce, Cinnamon, COSMIC).
 For example, if you use KDE Plasma then switch to GNOME, icon and cursor themes may have changed. When you switch back to KDE Plasma, scaling and light/dark mode may have changed. Meanwhile, menus may become cluttered with several core applications of similar functionality (e.g. terminals, file browsers, text editors).
 Mending Wall fixes all this.
 To use, simply launch the app and choose one or more features to enable. The best time to enable is before using a second desktop environment, to prevent issues before they occur. Mending Wall will then run in the background to maintain your setup. You can install any desktop environments in the usual way through your package manager, either before or after starting Mending Wall.

fedora-packages:adns/adns.name: adns
fedora-packages:adns/adns.summary: Advanced, easy to use, asynchronous-capable DNS client library
fedora-packages:adns/adns.description: adns is a resolver library for C (and C++) programs. In contrast with the existing interfaces, gethostbyname et al and libresolv, it has the following features: - It is reasonably easy to use for simple programs which just want to translate names to addresses, look up MX records, etc. - It can be used in an asynchronous, non-blocking, manner. Many queries can be handled simultaneously. - Responses are decoded automatically into a natural representation for a C program - there is no need to deal with DNS packet formats. - Sanity checking (eg, name syntax checking, reverse/forward correspondence, CNAME pointing to CNAME) is performed automatically. - Time-to-live, CNAME and other similar information is returned in an easy-to-use form, without getting in the way. - There is no global state in the library; resolver state is an opaque data structure which the client creates explicitly. A program can have several instances of the resolver. - Errors are reported to the application in a way that distinguishes the various causes of failure properly. - Understands conventional resolv.conf, but this can overridden by environment variables. - Flexibility. For example, the application can tell adns to: ignore environment variables (for setuid programs), disable sanity checks eg to return arbitrary data, override or ignore resolv.conf in favour of supplied configuration, etc. - Believed to be correct ! For example, will correctly back off to TCP in case of long replies or queries, or to other nameservers if several are available. It has sensible handling of bad responses etc.

fedora-packages:boinc-tui/boinc-tui.description: boinc-tui is a fullscreen text mode control tool for BOINC client It can manage local and remote clients (via boinc RPC), and allows you to switch between clients with a hot key. boinctui uses curses library and provides the following features: * Fullscreen curses based text user interface * Switch between several BOINC clients hosts via hot key * View task list (run, queue, suspend e.t.c state) * View message list * Suspend/Resume/Abort tasks * Update/Suspend/Resume/Reset/No New Task/Allow New Task for projects * Toggle activity state GPU and CPU tasks * Run benchmarks * Manage BOINC client on remote hosts via boinc_gui protocol

fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.name: catharsis-cormorant-fonts
fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.summary: Cormorant, a display serif font family inspired by the Garamond heritage
fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.description: Cormorant is an original design for an extravagant display serif font family inspired by the Garamond heritage, hand-drawn and produced by Catharsis Fonts. While traditional Garamond cuts make for exquisite reading at book sizes, they appear clumpy and inelegant at larger sizes. The design goal of Cormorant was to distill the aesthetic essence of Garamond, unfetter it from the limitations of metal printing, and allow it to bloom into its natural refined form at high definition. Cormorant is characterized by scandalously small counters, razor-sharp serifs, dangerously smooth curves, and flamboyantly tall accents. While many implementations of Garamond at small optical sizes already exist (including the open-sourced EB Garamond by Georg Duffner), Cormorant aims for the sparsely populated niche of display-size counterparts that exploit the high resolution of contemporary screens and print media to the fullest. Cormorant is made for large sizes; the larger, the better. However, it works well as a text face in high-resolution environments. Cormorant is a native 21st-century typeface making ample use of OpenType technology. Some OpenType features are applied automatically while you type, subtly improving the flow of the text. This includes kerning, standard ligatures, and contextual alternates. Other features are intended to be activated manually by the user, such as discretionary ligatures, stylistic alternates, small capitals, and alternate figure sets.

fedora-packages:checksec/checksec.name: checksec
fedora-packages:checksec/checksec.summary: Tool to check system for binary-hardening
fedora-packages:checksec/checksec.description: Modern Linux distributions offer some mitigation techniques to make it harder to exploit software vulnerabilities reliably. Mitigations such as RELRO, NoExecute (NX), Stack Canaries, Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) and Position Independent Executables (PIE) have made reliably exploiting any vulnerabilities that do exist far more challenging. The checksec script is designed to test what *standard* Linux OS and PaX (http://pax.grsecurity.net/) security features are being used. As of version 1.3 the script also lists the status of various Linux kernel protection mechanisms. checksec can check binary-files and running processes for hardening features.

fedora-packages:coan/coan.name: coan
fedora-packages:coan/coan.summary: A command line tool for simplifying the pre-processor conditionals in source code
fedora-packages:coan/coan.description: coan (formerly sunifdef) is a software engineering tool for analyzing pre-processor-based configurations of C or C++ source code. Its principal use is to simplify a body of source code by eliminating any parts that are redundant with respect to a specified configuration. coan is most useful to developers of constantly evolving products with large code bases, where pre-processor conditionals are used to configure the feature sets, APIs or implementations of different releases. In these environments the code base steadily accumulates #ifdef-pollution as transient configuration options become obsolete. coan can largely automate the recurrent task of purging redundant #if-logic from the code.

fedora-packages:dc3dd/dc3dd.name: dc3dd
fedora-packages:dc3dd/dc3dd.summary: Patched version of GNU dd for use in computer forensics
fedora-packages:dc3dd/dc3dd.description: dc3dd is a patched version of GNU dd to include a number of features useful for computer forensics. Many of these features were inspired by dcfldd, but were rewritten for dc3dd. * Pattern writes. The program can write a single hexadecimal value or a text string to the output device for wiping purposes. * Piecewise and overall hashing with multiple algorithms and variable size windows. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512. Hashes can be computed before or after conversions are made. * Progress meter with automatic input/output file size probing * Combined log for hashes and errors * Error grouping. Produces one error message for identical sequential errors * Verify mode. Able to repeat any transformations done to the input file and compare it to an output. * Ability to split the output into chunks with numerical or alphabetic extensions

fedora-packages:edwin-fonts/edwin-fonts.name: edwin-fonts
fedora-packages:edwin-fonts/edwin-fonts.summary: A text font for musical scores
fedora-packages:edwin-fonts/edwin-fonts.description: In 1999-2000, URW++ Design and Development GmbH released Type 1 implementations of the Core 35 fonts under the GNU General Public License (GPL) and the Aladdin Ghostscript Free Public License (AFPL). In 2009, URW++ additionally released the same fonts under the LaTeX Project Public License (LPPL). In 2016, URW++ released a major Version 2.0 upgrade to the Core 35 fonts. This version is an extensive reworking of the original Core 35 fonts, with improved font outlines, and greatly extended character sets, including Cyrillic and Greek. Also, some font names were changed. Version 2.0 was released in Type 1, OpenType-CFF and OpenType-TTF formats. URW++ released Version 2.0 of the fonts under the GNU Affero General Public License, Version 3 (AGPL) with an exemption. In 2017, URW++ additionally released the same Version 2.0 fonts under the LaTeX Project Public License (LPPL) Version 1.3c, and under the SIL Open Font License (OFL), Version 1.1, without a "Reserved Font Name" clause. In 2020, MuseScore BVBA released the Edwin font family, a renamed version of the C059 font family (Roman, Italic, Bold & Bold Italic) from the Core 35 font set. This was done in order to make modifications that suit the requirements of the open source notation software, MuseScore. It is released under the SIL Open Font License (OFL) only.

fedora-packages:gloo/gloo-mpich.name: gloo-mpich
fedora-packages:gloo/gloo-mpich.description: Gloo is a collective communications library. It comes with a number of collective algorithms useful for machine learning applications. These include a barrier, broadcast, and allreduce. Transport of data between participating machines is abstracted so that IP can be used at all times, or InifiniBand (or RoCE) when available. In the latter case, if the InfiniBand transport is used, GPUDirect can be used to accelerate cross machine GPU-to-GPU memory transfers. Where applicable, algorithms have an implementation that works with system memory buffers, and one that works with NVIDIA GPU memory buffers. In the latter case, it is not necessary to copy memory between host and device; this is taken care of by the algorithm implementations. This package can use mpich as a backend.

Fast, one-click downloads for any YouTube content.
But it doesn’t stop there - it’s a multi-platform marvel!
Support for All Major Platforms

TikTok Video Downloader – Grab TikTok clips, including support for downloading APK videos.

Vimeo Video Downloader – Perfect for high-quality Vimeo downloads.
Dailymotion Downloader – Access Dailymotion videos offline.
LinkedIn Video Downloader – Save professional videos from LinkedIn.
Pinterest Video Downloader – Download inspiring clips from Pinterest.
Reddit Video Downloader – Capture videos from Reddit threads.
Snapchat Downloader – Save public Snapchat stories or spotlight videos.
SoundCloud Downloader – Extract audio tracks as MP3s.

firefox-addons:3073998.name: Omarchy Web Theme
firefox-addons:3073998.summary: Make any website follow your Omarchy theme: palette, light/dark, and accent. Requires Omarchy 4+ on Linux and a small companion native host.
firefox-addons:3073998.description:
Omarchy Web Theme recolors the web to match your current Omarchy theme, so pages blend into the rest of your desktop instead of fighting it.
 Any site, one engine. Backgrounds, borders and shadows are drawn from the theme's surfaces; text, icons and links from its inks. Saturated colors (links, buttons, status) keep their hue by matching the theme's chromatic slots.
 Readable by construction. Every mapped pair is checked and repaired to at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA), preferring the theme's own colors over literal black/white.
 Follows light/dark. Switching Omarchy themes repaints open tabs immediately: a small native-messaging host is signalled by Omarchy's own theme-set hook.
 Role-aware. A page's background stays a background and its text stays text, even when the site's own light/dark mode disagrees with the theme.
 Omarchy 4+ on Arch Linux. The extension reads the active theme from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/ through a companion native-messaging host.
 The native host , installed by this project's installer or the omarchy-web-theme AUR package ( omarchy-web-theme-setup ).
Without Omarchy and the native host the extension installs and injects cleanly, but has no theme to read and does nothing.
 yay -S omarchy-web-theme # native host + extension
omarchy-web-theme-setup # per-user hook + browser wiring
Then fully quit and restart Firefox. Full source and setup instructions: < https://github.com/skooda/omarchy-web-theme >
The extension collects nothing and sends nothing. It reads your local theme through the native host and makes no network requests of its own.

Welcome to Cake Match Master - Color Sort, a cozy 3D dessert puzzle game full of sweet cakes and relaxing brain challenges!
If you’re obsessed with cute desserts and chill logic puzzles, this casual sorting game is made just for you. Step into a bright, candy-colored bakery world, where your mission is to sort, match and stack delicious cake slices to craft flawless whole cakes!

bluejetty:00004177:ios.description:
Make your everyday life easier as a teacher with Additio App!
(Download of the app is free but you need a paid license to access the features).
Save up to 7 hours of work every week with Additio App's AI-powered features. Automate repetitive tasks, create educational content in seconds, and spend more time teaching and less time on admin.
Additio App is the app you need to manage your classes in an easy and intuitive way. From students’ assessment to lesson planning and class scheduling, Additio App unifies management, assessment and communication in an easy-to-use app.
Additio App is available on several devices, including website version, tablets and smartphones. Thus, you can access your information and schedule your classes no matter the time or place. Also, you can synchronize devices (with Internet access) so you’ll never miss any valuable data and keep it all together.
Main functionalities and advantages:
- Powerful digital gradebook with unlimited assessments.
- Lesson planner in sessions and curriculum units with custom templates, enhanced with AI.
- 100% personalized rubrics with option for auto assessment and peer assessment, enhanced with AI.
- Skills and evaluation criteria assessment.
- Custom reports.
- Follow-up for assessment, schedule, class plan and calendar.
- Offline experience for mobiles.
- Integration with Google Classroom, Microsoft for Education and Moodle, with the option to import students, import and export grades, assess…
- Creation of automatically assessed quizzes.
- Easy to use and import data.
- Communication with families and students.
- Compliance with European data security and privacy regulations GDPR and LOPD.
- Excel and PDF data export.
- Organize and link any format resources, also via Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive.
- Calculation of means, average, conditionals and more than 150 functionalities for everyday classes.
Additio App will help you to keep it simple with your classes, to improve lesson planning and peer collaboration. Just as easy as the traditional paper and pen, and once you have started scheduling your daily routines you’ll wonder how you could do it without it. More than 500.000 teachers and more than 3.000 education centers on over 110 countries trust Additio App every day. In addition, our support team is always there ready to answer to your needs, the average qualification of this service is +4/5.
Available plans:
Teachers Pro AI: Our most comprehensive plan for teachers. Includes every Additio App feature, plus a growing suite of AI-powered tools that help you save time by automating tasks such as creating teaching resources, planning lessons, and many other day-to-day activities.
Teachers Standard: Access all Additio App features to manage, plan, and assess your classes. Carry out competency-based assessment using key competencies, specific competencies, and assessment criteria. You can also use Additio App across multiple devices and keep everything synchronized so your information is always with you.
Additio for Schools: for centers with accounts and accesses for families, students and a dashboard for admins.
- Centralized center’s management
- Creation of multiple center’s reports (report cards, attendance, incidents, skills…)
- Share groups and data
- Platform for communication with families and students
- Payments management
- Forms and authorizations management
- Creation of lesson plans from the center
- Report cards generator
Contact our team to prepare a custom proposal according to your center’s needs.
Additio App has been created by a team 100% devoted to produce new updates to easy teachers’ tasks.
Terms of use: https://static.additioapp.com/terms/terms-EN.html
Privacy policy: https://www.additioapp.com/en/security-and-privacy/

REAL-TIME RACE ENGINEER
Get live race-engineer guidance while you drive. Victory turns Gran Turismo 7 and F1 25 telemetry into timely voice calls, dashboards and post-race analysis—so you can focus on the next corner.
RACE WITH LESS HUD
bluejetty:00114971:ios.description:
REAL-TIME RACE ENGINEER
Get live race-engineer guidance while you drive. Victory turns Gran Turismo 7 and F1 25 telemetry into timely voice calls, dashboards and post-race analysis—so you can focus on the next corner.
RACE WITH LESS HUD
Your engineer calls out lap times, position changes, fuel, tire conditions, pit strategy, flags, penalties, damage, weather and nearby cars where supported. It is especially useful for PSVR2 and immersive, HUD-free racing.
ASK YOUR ENGINEER
Use voice commands to ask about fuel, tires, position, lap times and strategy. Choose from a range of engineer voices, accents and personalities.
LIVE TELEMETRY & DASHBOARDS
• Monitor speed, throttle, brake, steering, gear and G-forces
• Track tire temperatures and fuel use
• View live input traces, traction control feedback and race data
• Use multiple dashboard layouts
IMPROVE EVERY LAP
• Automatically record driving sessions
• Compare laps with sector-by-sector deltas
• Review throttle, braking, gear and tire charts
• Find where you gain or lose time
• Plan fuel and pit strategy
BUILT FOR SIM RACERS
Connect over your local network—no special hardware required. Route engineer audio and overlays to OBS for streaming, or send calls to Discord so you can hear them through your racing setup.
Whether you are chasing your first clean race or the final tenth, Victory gives you a clearer view of your driving and a smarter voice on the radio.
Le Mans Ultimate and Assetto Corsa Competizione are supported through the Victory app on Windows.
Gran Turismo 7, F1 25, Le Mans Ultimate and Assetto Corsa Competizione are not affiliated with Victory.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.victorydash.io/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00160530:ios.name: CrewLAB Sports Team Management
bluejetty:00160530:ios.summary: CrewLAB is a sports club and team management app for rowing, swimming, and running programs. Club directors, coaches, athletes, and parents use it to handle registration, payments, waivers, team chat, schedules, and training in one place.
bluejetty:00160530:ios.description:
CrewLAB is a sports club and team management app for rowing, swimming, and running programs. Club directors, coaches, athletes, and parents use it to handle registration, payments, waivers, team chat, schedules, and training in one place.
USA Swimming Coaching Software Supplier and official partner of USRowing, Rowing Canada Aviron, and Rowing New Zealand. Trusted by more than 3,000 teams.
If your coach or club sent you a team code, download CrewLAB and enter it. Your team's schedule, chat, and workouts will be waiting.
FOR CLUBS AND PROGRAM DIRECTORS
Run every team in your club from one dashboard. Athletes and parents register, sign digital waivers, and pay in a single flow on their phone. You can see who has paid, who hasn't, and who is cleared to train without exporting a spreadsheet, so your treasurer isn't chasing checks.
FOR COACHES
Post the schedule, take attendance, assign workouts, and set lineups from your phone. Daily wellness check-ins show how athletes slept and how they feel before practice starts. Video review with athlete tagging keeps feedback tied to the right person.
FOR ATHLETES
Log every session, from erg pieces to swim sets to tempo runs, and watch your progress build over the season. Share training with teammates, cheer each other on, and climb the team leaderboard during off-season challenges.
FOR PARENTS
See the schedule, get announcements, register, and pay in the same app your athlete uses.
TEAM COMMUNICATION BUILT TO SAFESPORT AND MAAPP STANDARDS
Team chat, announcements, and the calendar live in one place. Conversations between coaches and athletes are transparent and auditable. Announcements-only channels keep important updates from getting buried.
BUILT FOR YOUR SPORT
Rowing: registration, boat lineups, erg scores, and video review.
Swimming: meet entries, RSVPs, attendance records, and parent views.
Running, cross country, and track: workout tracking with analytics.
Connects with Garmin, Apple Watch, COROS, and Concept2.
COMMON QUESTIONS
Who is CrewLAB for?
Multi-team sports clubs, school and college programs, and individual coaches in rowing, swimming, running, cross country, and track. Clubs with 50 or more athletes across several teams get the most from the club-wide tools.
Is CrewLAB free?
Yes. The full coaching app is free for unlimited athletes and coaches. Club registration and payments are part of paid plans.
How do athletes and parents join a team?
Download the app and enter the team code, link, or QR code from your coach or club administrator.
Can I use CrewLAB on a computer?
Yes. Coaches and admins can work from any web browser at app.crewlab.io.
Can our club move over from another app?
Yes. CrewLAB's customer success team helps you move members, payments, and schedules, then stays with you after setup.
TRUSTED BY CLUBS
More than 3,000 teams and 30,000 athletes, coaches, and parents use CrewLAB.
Privacy Policy: crewlab.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: crewlab.io/terms

bluejetty:00184731:ios.description:
Prepare for the ultimate clash of strategy, firepower, and survival! A massive horde of renegade stickman troops has swept across the jungle, destroying every military outpost in their path. The region is on the brink of total collapse, and only your elite defense duo can halt the invasion. Enter the war zone and prove you have the strategic mind required to survive the onslaught.
Take direct command of two highly trained special operations soldiers stationed at the last stronghold. As wave after wave of hostile forces storms your barricades, you must deploy tactical precision and iron discipline. From agile infantry and armored strike teams to heavy demolition units, every enemy wave brings new tactical challenges that will test your defensive resolve.
Fortify your position with heavy weaponry, manage your resources in real time, and hold the line against overwhelming odds. The fate of the entire front line rests on your command—stand firm, unleash devastating firepower, and claim total victory!
FEATURES:
• Intense stickman defense battles packed with explosive tactical combat
• Over 60 lethal weapons, tactical turrets, and powerful bonuses to unlock
• More than 40 challenging campaign levels to test your defensive strategy
• Deploy snipers, bazookas, flamethrowers, and heavy artillery like Big Bertha
• Build barricades with sandbags, barbed wire, and landmines to stop raids
• Smooth intuitive controls, crisp graphics, and thrilling war sound effects
HOW TO PLAY:
• 1. Tap your soldiers to assign weapons and target incoming enemy waves.
• 2. Deploy sandbags, mines, and barbed wire to slow down hostile ground forces.
• 3. Fire heavy artillery and special strikes when swarms grow overwhelming.
• 4. Earn battle rewards to upgrade your arsenal and strengthen base defenses.

bluejetty:00033677:ios.description:
iFlight has a new Mobile app, which can be accessible on mobile and tablet devices. iFlight Crew mobile application assists crew members in looking into their published day-to-day roster details with important messages and roster change alerts. The iFlight Crew mobile application also lets crew view their Profile, Statistics, Messages, Station, Hotel details, etc.
Crew members can log in to the app with their credentials to view notifications like roster changes, expires, and broadcast messages. They can view the details and acknowledge these notifications. The app also allows viewing the check-in notification and performing check-in actions via the app.
Crew members can view their itinerary details, crew list, etc. in detail. Duty cards for different assignments like pairing, activities, training, etc are displayed in different colors so the crew can easily identify the assignment from color in the app.

How i
bluejetty:00114890:ios.description:
Flip. Match. Discover.
Do you love movies? Do you enjoy brain games that are both relaxing and challenging?
Memory Match: Movie Puzzle brings you a refreshing twist on the classic memory card game – this time with real movie posters!
How it works:
Each round gives you a grid of face-down movie posters. Your task? Flip two cards at a time and try to find matching posters. Simple? Not quite. Some posters look similar, some are from hidden gems you've never seen. But every match you make sharpens your memory and builds your movie knowledge.
Train your brain through film
Whether you're a casual movie lover or a puzzle master, Memory Match helps boost your visual memory, focus, and speed — all while introducing you to a world of underrated films.
Ready to challenge your memory and your love for cinema?
Download Read Progre: Movie Puzzle and start flipping!

bluejetty:00184859:ios.description:
Time to try Indian Rummy- An interesting game of skills that pays you Big. The special love towards Indian Rummy never fades, it is also commonly known as Paplu in India
It is a skill based game. The uniqueness of this skill game is that players winning will be dependent on players’ level of skill and not by chance. Hence, this game let talented and skill gamer’s opportunity to play game and win.
Indian Rummy is a group of matching card games notable for similar gameplay based on matching cards of the same rank or sequence and same suit. The basic goal is to build melds which consists of sets, three or four of a kind of the same rank; or runs, three or more cards in sequence, of the same suit. Every player needs to pick card from either Closed or Open Deck during their turn. The final goal is to form sets and sequences by end of the game. The player who completes arranging cards in to exact needs to declare a valid hand.
Two kinds of sets are possible: a ‘run’ of consecutive suited cards, and three or four of a kind with no duplicate suits. The basic requirement for winning a hand is at least two sequences, one of which must be ‘pure’, i.e. made without any jokers.
It is a game that gets on you instantly, regardless of how you play - with physical cards or online. Its magic is not in its cards; but, it’s purely the gameplay and the challenges that make the game so riveting for the players. 
Everyone treat Indian card games as their favorite past time and a game that fulfills their special occasions. It is easy to learn but there is hidden depth meaning that there is a lot of skill and tactical ability needed to master the game. 
The 13 cards online Indian Rummy is regarded as best skill game and your skills help you to earn amazing coins by beating your opponent. 
Simply Indian Rummy can be treated as a mental workout.The game is an ideal option to experience fun, excitement, refreshment and for winning huge credits. Get rid of your boredom and refresh your bad mood by playing Indian Rummy.
13 cards Indian Rummy is uniting all Rummy players and making free time more exciting and productive.
Play Indian Rummy online with your buddies who are residing in different cities. Nothing beats the happiness of playing online Indian Rummy from the comfort of your home. 
The thrill of online Indian Rummy lies in competing with other co-players and win. 
Another thing that makes online Indian Rummy more interesting is the option to play in online and private rooms. Not only this, you also get the option to create your own private Indian Rummy room and invite your friends and family to play this game with you. 
Always remember that Indian Rummy is a game that needs you to have an interest in the game and also a little bit of patience. 
Rummy has by far been the most popular card game enjoyed by people of various nations. It is a stress buster. It is a brain game that can give you a mental break from your busy schedule and is also known to improve hand eye coordination, math concepts, and visual judgments
How exciting it is spending your free time by playing online Indian Rummy on the go? We can never deny the fun and excitement associated with this game. So keep playing, keep winning and keep enjoying Rummy.
Beat the Boredom!!
Experience the thrill of playing without spending anything. Download it for Free!!

2. Play with your friends on a Private Table
3. Free Lucky Draw
4. True multiplayer where you can play with real people online in online multiplayer mode.
5. Very Intuitive Interface and game-play
6. Classic Styled Indian Rummy Cards
7. Free Chips to keep on playing
8. Adaptable intelligence with smart AI when playing against computer

bluejetty:00127104:ios.description:
Customer Loyalty Program: Simple. Fast. Affordable
Digitize Your Loyalty Program with WinStamp
WinStamp offers an eco-friendly, user-friendly and easy-to-implement customer loyalty solution for small businesses. Start your digital loyalty program in minutes.
How It Works in 3 Steps?
1. Business Owner: Downloads the “WinStamp Business” app.
2. Customer: Downloads the “WinStamp” app and generates a unique QR code.
3. Stamp Process: The business owner scans the customer’s QR code to add a digital stamp.
Key Features:
- Customizable Stamp Cards: Set the number of stamps, card color and your stamp image.
- Customer Management: Quickly access detailed customer information.
- Bulk Messaging: Easily send messages to your customers.
- Live Stats: Track your daily, weekly and monthly performance.
Why WinStamp?
- Fast Setup: Get started in minutes without waiting for the approval process.
- Customer Friendly: No registration information requested from your customers.
- Secure System: Stamps are only added through the business app.
- Fully Mobile: No extra devices or hardware needed - just your phone.
- Affordable Pricing: Flexible pricing according to the number of your branches. No limit on the number of stamps or customers.
You can contact us if you have any questions. We are constantly improving our application in line with your requests.
Say goodbye to paper and plastic loyalty cards with WinStamp!

bluejetty:00019219:ios.description:
An epic blockbuster action-RPG featuring Super Heroes and Villains from the Marvel Universe!
The Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, Inhumans, Defenders, X-Men, Spider-Man, and more!
Over 200 characters from the Marvel Universe are available to play!
S.H.I.E.L.D.’s very own director, Nick Fury, has sent an urgent message from the future... the convergence is destroying the world as we know it! Prepare to defend your universe!
Recruit your favorite characters, complete missions, and compete with other players to be the greatest hero and save your world.
Collect over 200 Marvel Super Heroes and Super Villains to assemble your ultimate team.
- Level up your characters and their gear to unleash their full powers!
- Build classic teams like the Avengers or X-Men to take advantage of special bonus effects.
- Choose from hundreds of Uniforms to increase your character’s powers and perfect your hero's look.
Upgrade powerful characters in Epic Quests!
- Get everyone’s favorite Super Heroes, from Captain Marvel to Doctor Strange, and level them up while playing thrilling Epic Quests.
- Unleash each character’s unique super powers as you make your way through various missions. Blast enemies with Iron Man’s Unibeam and bash opponents in the name of justice with Captain America’s shield!
- Experience even more thrilling action in PvP Arena modes, where you can bring your best team to take on the world.
Team up with friends and overcome incredible in-game challenges.
- Take a friend’s character with you when you go into a mission for emergency assistance!
- Join an Alliance and make friends. Compete with other Alliances in Alliance Conquest and take home the glory for your own team.
Original new stories only found in Marvel Future Fight!
- Experience unique, never-before-seen stories to find out who’s responsible for threatening the existence of your universe!
- Play through Special Missions featuring the New Avengers, Inhumans, and even Spidey’s Foes!
Please note! MARVEL Future Fight is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's setting. 
Terms of Service: http://help.netmarble.com/policy/terms_of_service.asp
Privacy Policy: https://help.netmarble.com/terms/terms_of_service_en?lcLocale=en

bluejetty:00000584:ios.description:
Put your timing and reflexes to the test in this most thrilling and addictive running game: Gate Rusher!
Gate Rusher is a test of timing and precision as you roll through the gates. 
Swipe left and right to control the ball and swiftly pass through them all, while the game picks up speed and intensity as you play.
See how many gates you can roll through! But don’t lose your focus, or else you’ll crash!
Gather gems as you roll through the gates and see how high you can get your score! This fun and addicting game will keep on challenging you as you aim for higher and higher heights.
Gate Rusher requires your full attention and awesome swiping skills to survive the run. Collect all the gems and get a perfect rush!
GATE RUSHER FEATURES:
SWIPE AND ROLL
- Roll through the gates and swipe to maneuver
- The speed picks up the further you go
- Collect gems and earn points!
HIGH SCORE
- Try to beat your top score
- Aim for a new top distance or to collect the most gems
- How far can you go?
FUN AND ADDICTING GAME
- Play offline – no WiFi required!
- Gate Rusher is fun and easy to learn
- Keep playing until you get a new top score!
SKILL CHALLENGES
- Single level: Start easy and complete each level. The difficulty increases as you progress. Keep your winning streak to set the record!
- Infinite level: Take the ultimate test of your skills, focus and patience! How long can you survive?
Download Gate Rusher now and feel the rush!

bluejetty:00028370:ios.description:
Evlo offers guided strength training classes designed to help you stay consistent and finally see results.
By balancing effort, recovery, and movement selection, the Evlo Method delivers enough stimulus to build muscle without the unnecessary fatigue or burnout that causes people to quit before results appear.
Women’s Health Best Fitness Apps award-winner.
Start with a 7-day free trial to experience the Evlo Method.
A DIFFERENT APPROACH TO STRENGTH TRAINING
Many workout programs rely on high fatigue, excessive volume, or constantly changing routines that are difficult to sustain.
The Evlo Method focuses on delivering enough stimulus to drive adaptation while keeping systemic fatigue manageable so progress can build week after week.
This balance helps create the conditions needed for long-term strength and body composition improvements.
RESULTS
Evlo workouts help you
- Build real strength
- Improve muscle and body composition
- Make progress without excessive fatigue
- Stay consistent with training you can sustain
INSIDE THE APP
- Structured strength programs for 3, 4, or 5 workouts per week 
- Optional cardio classes 
- Prenatal strength program
- Postpartum strength program
- Every class guided by a Doctor of Physical Therapy
- New classes added weekly
- Clear coaching and exercise instruction
- Guided training to muscular failure to finally see results
- Body recomposition nutrition guide written by a Registered Dietitian
PROGRAMS 
Evlo Weekly
Our flagship strength training program designed for long-term progress. Follow structured programming with 3, 4, or 5 workouts per week, with new 35 - 45-minute classes released every week.
Evlo Prenatal
Strength training that supports your body safely during pregnancy, with workouts tailored to each stage. Named Best Prenatal Workout App by Women’s Health.
Evlo Postpartum
Strength training to rebuild after pregnancy, with a focus on core and pelvic floor recovery. Named Best Postpartum Workout App by Women’s Health.
DESIGNED FOR CONSISTENCY
Real strength and body composition changes come from training that can be repeated consistently over time.
Evlo focuses on workouts that are challenging enough to drive progress while remaining sustainable enough to keep showing up week after week.
Start your 7-day free trial and experience the Evlo Method.
Terms of Service – https://evlofitness.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy – https://evlofitness.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00061264:ios.description:
GoCodes provides a Total Asset Tracking & Inventory Management service that includes everything you need to manage your assets. Our service includes easy-to-use, secure cloud-based software, mobile apps & patented QR bar code labels so you get everything you need to create your total solution.
The GoCodes mobile app enables you to manage your assets and track inventory using your smartphone and GoCodes patented QR code labels. This app is specifically designed to work with GoCodes cloud-based software.
Includes the following features:
* Integrated QR bar code scanner
* Support for scanning all common bar codes
* Rapidly check in/out single and multiple assets by scanning the QR code
* Rapidly view and update single and multiple assets by scanning the QR code
* Track and manage inventory quantities
* Get inventory reorder notifications
* Copy and swap asset information by scanning the bar code
* Search for and check in/out assets in groups
* Search for and update assets in groups
* View asset locations on a map
* Capture GPS location information for each asset
* View custom data fields
* View and select from custom pick lists
* Responds to gestures for updates
* Add photos to asset descriptions
* View photos full screen
* Optimized for iPhone & iPad
This app is designed to work with the GoCodes Asset Management software.

bluejetty:00008690:android.name: League of Kingdoms
bluejetty:00008690:android.summary: League of Kingdoms is the world's first MMO Strategy game owned & powered by users. All lands are owned and governed by you. You can permanently own, actively develop, launch massive alliance warfare, and earn lucrative rewards by contribut
bluejetty:00008690:android.description:
League of Kingdoms is the world's first MMO Strategy game owned & powered by users. All lands are owned and governed by you. You can permanently own, actively develop, launch massive alliance warfare, and earn lucrative rewards by contributing to the development of the continents. Your strategy, diplomacy, instincts, and war tactics all come to life here!
Are you ready for a real strategy? 
⚔️ Your strategy starts here. 
Various constraints of resources, time, and distances make your astute tactics, penetrating intuition, and swift decision-making shine on the battlefield more than ever before. Less micro-control with more strategy. Welcome to the art of war! 
⚔️ Your ownership matters.
You can own a parcel of land where the game unfolds. Invite your friends to your Land and start building a powerful alliance. The concept of ownership adds another immersive layer to the already engaging gameplay. Your active engagement will enrich your Land and attracts more kingdoms. 
⚔️ Your treasure works like a charm. 
The unique treasures are waiting for the bravest leaders. These magical relics are passed down from ancient times. When you collect all pieces of the prizes, you can unlock massive magical powers that you can actively put to use. 
⚔️ Join forces in a dominant alliance.
A full set of alliance features allow players to grow together: alliance chats with built-in translation function, officer roles, alliance research, gifts, and more! Alliances can take down monsters, seize good locations to strengthen their position and work together to unlock group achievements. Maximize your alliance power by leveraging members’ Land ownership. 
⚔️ The siege of the shrine
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of the sacred shrines. Clash with other alliances and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in the campaign to capture the control of a shrine. Occupy the highest shrines and gain control of its surrounding territories. Your feats will be remembered for ages to come. 
⚔️ The making of a democracy
Transparent voting and democratic governance process will always have your voice heard. As a citizen or an owner of the Genesis continent, you will be empowered to voice and take part in important decision makings about the future of the game ecosystem. Welcome onboard to the self-sovereign society.
PRIVAC

bluejetty:00119681:ios.description:
Control your fleet operation when away from your desk with Webfleet Mobile. 
The Webfleet Mobile app makes life easier for fleet managers with:
Vehicle and asset tracking: Locate your vehicles or assets in real time, see where they’re headed and get driver information.
Maps view: Find a single vehicle or your entire fleet on TomTom Maps or Google Maps.
Traffic: Plan routes with TomTom or Google Traffic information viewable on the map.
Messages: View text, status and order messages. Send messages straight to the driver’s PRO Driver Terminal. 
Trip data: Access previously recorded trip data by date for a single vehicle or the entire fleet.
Orders: Dispatch new orders and view the progress of an existing order for a selected vehicle, including the location of the vehicle handling the order and the estimated time of arrival.
Notifications/alerts: Get instant alerts whenever a vehicle enters or leaves a previously designated geo area and when the order status changes.
Please note this is NOT a NAVIGATION app. This app is for relevant subscribers to the Webfleet fleet management solution only.
For optimal app performance, please ensure your Webfleet user rights are set up with the appropriate access for you to effectively manage your fleet operations.
System Requirements to use the Webfleet Mobile app: iOS 11.0 and higher
The minimum screen size supported is 4.0 inches. Not all screen sizes or resolutions are supported yet. 
Languages supported 
English, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Czech, Swedish, Danish

bluejetty:00177743:ios.description:
PhotoBoost – Enhance, Restore, and Stylize Your Photos
PhotoBoost is a professional-grade AI photo enhancement app designed to improve image quality, restore cherished memories, and apply artistic styles to your photography. Our advanced AI technology delivers high-quality results while ensuring the app remains safe, secure, and appropriate for a general audience.
Professional Photo Enhancement Made Simple
Improve clarity, reduce motion blur, and bring out hidden details in your photos instantly. PhotoBoost makes high-end photo editing accessible to everyone, whether you are refreshing everyday snapshots or preserving family history.
With PhotoBoost, you can:
- Sharpen Details: Fix blurry or low-resolution photos for a crisp look.
- Enhance Quality: Improve lighting, color balance, and overall image texture.
- Restore Heritage: Repair old, faded, or physically damaged photographs.
- Colorize History: Add natural-looking color to black-and-white images.
- High-Resolution Upscaling: Increase image size for high-quality printing.
Creative Artistic Styles & Filters
PhotoBoost includes a suite of creative AI filters that allow you to apply unique artistic interpretations to your portraits. These features are designed for creative expression, turning your photos into stylized digital art.
Explore Creative Options:
- Artistic Portraits: Apply polished, professional-style themes to your photos.
- Visual Styles: Explore a variety of aesthetic filters, from classic art to modern designs.
- Profile Enhancements: Create clean, high-quality images for your social profiles.
- Seasonal Themes: Discover regularly updated styles for holidays and special events.
Additional Features
- Side-by-Side Comparison: Instantly view your original and enhanced images together.
- Precision Upscaling: Boost resolution while maintaining natural skin tones and textures.
- Image Motion (Premium): Add subtle, high-quality animation to your photos. This feature requires a Premium subscription or in-app credits.
Why Choose PhotoBoost?
- Safety First: Our AI is optimized for safe, general-audience creative use.
- Natural Results: We focus on realistic enhancements rather than artificial distortion.
- Fast Processing: Get high-resolution results in seconds.
- User-Friendly: No complex editing skills required—just one-tap improvements.
PhotoBoost is the ideal tool for families, hobbyists, and professionals who want to bring out the best in their photography through reliable AI technology.

bluejetty:00166640:ios.name: Idle Zombie Hospital Tycoon
bluejetty:00166640:ios.summary: The world has changed long ago. Buildings turned into ruins and bloodthirsty zombies walk through the empty streets. The dangerous virus pandemic spread all over the planet in a switch and now it's your deal to manage with the impact. Every
bluejetty:00166640:ios.description:
The world has changed long ago. Buildings turned into ruins and bloodthirsty zombies walk through the empty streets. The dangerous virus pandemic spread all over the planet in a switch and now it's your deal to manage with the impact. Everybody wants to kill zombies, but you will bring them mercy in this idle zombie hospital tycoon.
In this hospital simulator a tiny handful of apocalyptic survivors united and built several safe settlements and shelters. By that time scientists made a medical breakthrough and found a treatment for the virus! Finally, we can beat the infection! Thanks to the therapy in special hospitals it is now available to bring zombies back to normal.
Are you ready to become a manager of one of these hospitals for zombies? In our simulator you will start with the small clinic and do your best to turn it into a modern healing complex building for the most dangerous patients in the world. Open new hospitals all over the globe to cure all zombies!
In this clicker game you can hire the personnel, create stuff buildings, cure the infected, and try to avoid bursts of aggression. Supply paramedics with high-quality devices, expand the recreation area and equip the command post. To make your clinic truly best overthink every detail, even the ventilation system set up. Invest your money smart. 
What is so special about our zombie game?
- Zombies with different levels of infection
- Various medical procedures
- Personnel management
- Different geo locations
- Possibility of aggression burst and losing staff
Increase the treatment quality
Monitor zombies' condition to prevent bursts of aggression. Upgrade the laboratory where medicines are created. Keep your clinic’s buildings clean, install quality showers to improve hygiene. The virus impacted the psychology of Infected badly and they need entertainment to be cured. Place new TVs to the wards, benches to the yard, and even buy guitars to play music around the firepit. This will help your patients to defeat the inner beast.
Manage your personnel
To treat your patients effectively you need to hire qualified personnel! Hire and fire various specialists in accordance with your development strategy and equip them with the best medical devices. Paramedics, scientists, therapists, builders, and janitors - all kinds of staff are essential. Each person is responsible for their own part of the difficult job of fighting with infection.
Avoid the aggression outburst
Zombies are the hardest and most dangerous patients. If your doctors will not give them due attention, they can fall into rage and bite the medical personnel. The whole zombie hospital can become at risk of infection. That's why it's important to monitor patients' mood attentively, give them entertainment and improve the level of comfort in the wards. 
Invest your money smart
Both Infected and the doctors reckon on you in the clinic's development. The safety of your staff and effectiveness of treatment are rested on the quality of the utility room, laboratory, procedure and paramedic's rooms. Upgrade the wards, the recreation area and the psychologist's office. Keep your close look at water and electricity reserves.
Heal and earn
Governments devote impressive funds and expect the relevant result from your clinics' work. Zombie rehabilitation is a good business in the post-apocalyptic world. Grow your reputation and start healing zombies worldwide!
If you enjoy playing clicker games, casual tycoons, simulators and idle games, then you'll love "Idle Zombie Hospital Tycoon: Management game". Make strategic decisions for business development and increase the profit. Your career starts in the small clinic but soon it can grow up to a true hospital empire and reach extraordinary heights.
~~~~~~
Rate us in the app store and join our Facebook page: 
https://www.facebook.com/ZombieHospitalTycoon
Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/BJ3ZvRmkRk

bluejetty:00069297:ios.description:
■ This isn’t just another board game. Roll, strategize, and dominate! Master powerful cards, slay monsters, and outplay rivals in thrilling, real-time battles! ■
Not an ordinary monopoly type classic board game you’ve played. Instead of selling and buying properties, set up your hero and base! Roll the dice, attack your opponent to drain their HP and win the match! Simple, fast-paced, mix of strategy and randomness! Get ready for RPG Dice battle! 
Unlock and upgrade Heroes with powerful super abilities. 
Collect unique skins to stand out and show off on the board. 
Become a master of the leaderboard and rule them all!
■ BATTLE IN EPIC DUELS
Face opponents from all around the world in exciting 1vs.1 battles on board. 
Fight monsters and cross your base to level up your Hero. Defeat the enemy and collect awesome rewards! 
■CREATE YOUR UNIQUE STRATEGY
Combine different Heroes and Bases with various deck settings to discover the best winning strategy. Build a unique deck of special cards and surprise your opponents at every turn! 
■UNLOCK AND UPGRADE HEROES
Collect and upgrade a variety of Heroes with exclusive battle skills and equipment. Produce equipment at the Base to power up your Heroes and collect unique skins to stand out.
■RULE THE CHAOS
Discover dice cards to control your destiny! No more random luck-based throws to determine the winner – the fate of the game lies in your hands (literally!). With dice cards, you can decide where your Hero goes next and plan the moves strategically.
■BECOME THE GRANDMASTER
Climb the global leaderboards to prove you’re the greatest Dice Master of them all! 
■CONSTANTLY EVOLVING
Look out for new Heroes, Bases, skins, equipment, special events and team contents in the future!
New Mode: Monster Jack released! Team up with 3 players to hunt the giant monster! 
■GAME FEATURES
- Fight in real-time turn-based duels on board against players from across the world
- Enjoy the innovative battle system with match-based character growth and dice-cards to control your moves 
- Climb to the top of the Global leaderboard and friendly rankings
- Earn chests to unlock rewards, collect and upgrade powerful new cards
- Aim for consecutive victories to earn Victory Keys
- Unlock and collect new, mighty Heroes – each with a signature set of skills and equipment
- Complete achievements to discover new cards and build the ultimate deck
- Open and upgrade new Bases with unique abilities and equipment production features 
- Use equipment to make your Heroes even more powerful and dominate the battle board
- Discover different worlds as you progress up the leagues
- Invite your friends to private battles and see who’s the best dice master
- Participate in Monster Jack event with other players to defeat giant monsters! 
PLEASE NOTE! Dicast: Rules of Chaos is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. Also, under our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, you must be at least 12 years of age to play or download Dicast: Rules of Chaos.
Support: Having trouble? Contact us at game_support@bsscamp.com
Follow us on Facebook for tips and updates about the game! 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DicastRulesOfChaos

bluejetty:00065493:ios.description:
The Quickest and Easiest way to keep track of what you eat!
Are you ready to take control of your diet and embrace a healthier lifestyle? Or are you simply curious and want the fastest way to track your diet? This app offers the quickest and easiest way to track what you eat, helping you make smarter food choices every day!
KEY FEATURES
1. Instant Food Recognition: Snap a photo, and in just seconds, our advanced technology accurately identifies all foods in your meal. No more tedious data entry! An enormous timesaver for everyone!
2. Extensive Food Database: Explore millions of food items, including branded products identifiable by barcode. If it's edible, we've got it covered!
3. Creative Recipe Suggestions: Whether it's a photo, description, or the contents of your fridge, get personalized recipe ideas for any occasion.
4. Comprehensive Nutrition Insights: Access high-quality data on food groups, nutritional content, and even environmental impact. Stay informed and eat smart with healthy meal plans backed by years of scientific research.
5. Personalized And Secure: This app learns from your habits to provide a truly customized experience. Enjoy logging without the need to enter personal data or contact information. Stay motivated with detailed reports and timely reminders.
6. Seamless User Experience: With one-tap entry, personalized suggestions, and offline support, managing your diet has never been simpler or more efficient.
WHY CHOOSE THIS APP?
1. Start Eating Smarter Today: The app is free to download and use, supported by advertisements. For an ad-free experience and access to premium features, upgrade with a one-time payment or subscription.
2. Premium Perks: Enjoy a larger database, the ability to email your diary, and additional meal tracking options with our premium version.
3. Stay On Track: Set personal goals and leverage weekly reports and personal reminders to monitor your progress.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Upgrade for a one-time payment or opt for an auto-renewing subscription (every three months).
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
DOWNLOAD TODAY!
Remember: always verify nutritional information with packaging details and consult your doctor or nutrition specialist to set and discuss your health goals.
Your journey to healthier eating starts here!

bluejetty:00175233:ios.description:
The New York Post’s app for iPad allows readers to experience everything The Post has to offer, beautifully formatted for their iPad. Join us today for a 30-day free trial* of your New York Post app subscription.
The app features an exact replica of the newspaper, page by page. The previous 15 days’ worth of papers are always available. Download to your iPad to read offline, and save issues for as long as you’d like.
For live updates throughout the day, you can also conveniently access NYPost.com through the app, keeping all of The Post you love in one place
Download now to never miss any of our breaking news updates, leading sports news, insightful business news, opinionated columnists, must-know local news, latest entertainment news, exclusive celebrity gossip and so much more.
COMPATIBILITY
Supports iOS 17 and up
APP SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
A New York Post app subscription is required for reading the app. Within the app, you will be able to purchase one of the following app subscription options, each featuring a 30-day free trial:
• One month ($15.99)
• Six months ($87.99)
• One year ($159.99)
*App subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel a subscription during the free trial, subscription must be cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the user's Account Settings.
HELP, PRIVACY AND TERMS OF USE
• For technical issues, please visit nypost.help/ipad or email ipadhelp@nypost.com.
• For our privacy policy, please visit http://nypost.com/privacy/. For terms of use, please visit http://nypost.com/terms/.

bluejetty:00163769:ios.description:
Your Porter app is designed to assist you throughout your travels. Manage your trips, check in, get your e-boarding pass and other important day-of-travel information - your handy assistant is just a tap away.
Check in on the go
Easily check in for your flight from anywhere. Add a bag, view, change or upgrade your seat and update your details so you can skip the lines at the airport! Your boarding passes are saved for offline use in the app.
Flight status
Check your flight status by searching the flight route or flight number. You will see details of your flight such as departure/arrival times and layovers as well as timely updates of the flight status.
Flight notifications, stay in the know
Getting the latest information on your flight has never been easier - simply enable mobile push notifications to receive important flight alerts for flight delays, cancellations and check-in reminders.
Select seats
Whether you prefer a window or aisle seat or wish to enjoy more generous legroom, you can now choose your favourite seat with a click of a button on our app. 
Add baggage
If you need to bring a checked bag, the app allows you to easily add baggage to your booking. You’ll save time and money by booking your extra bags in advance - baggage fees are lower on our app vs. at the airport.
Manage trips 
With a few taps, access your existing booking and change your flights to suit your needs. The Porter app does not currently support new bookings. To make a new one with Porter, visit flyporter.com.
Offline access
Your Porter app has been optimized for offline use. View your flight information, boarding passes and more, even without internet access.
Access VIPorter
Sign up or sign in with VIPorter to take full advantage of our app and the loyalty program benefits - manage your profile, view your points, tier status and other account information.
By downloading or updating this app, you agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with Porter’s Privacy Policy: https://www.flyporter.com/en-ca/privacy

Vietcetera (vietcetera.com/en) is a content hub attracting millions of readers from all over Vietnam and the world each month. Now with this mobile application, users can update our content more conveniently and quickly.
With the mission of connecting Vietnam to the world and the global Vietnamese diasporas, Vietcetera will provide readers with in-depth content covering popular topics such as the Vietnamese diaspora, Vietnamese news, career, life, relationships, and everything Vietnam!

- Read all content of Vietcetera for free;
- Save all articles for later reading;
- Share Vietcetera’s articles to your friends.
We’d like to know your experience using this app, please send us your feedback via app@vietcetera.com

- Twitter: https://twitter.com/vietcetera
- Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/vietcetera
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vietcetera
