bluejetty:00139315:ios.description:
Crunchtime is the restaurant industry’s leading solution for inventory management. In one powerful mobile app, restaurant teams can achieve complete inventory control straight from a phone or tablet. Even if you're on the go, you can navigate your inventory tasks effortlessly and keep your restaurant operation running smoothly.
Crunchtime makes it easy for restaurant teams to: 
• Manage Inventory with Ease – Save time and reduce errors with an intuitive inventory counting process, including a barcode scanner and a built-in calculator. Count simultaneously with your team, online or offline, and maintain perpetual inventory you can trust.
• Easily Place Orders and Reconcile Invoices – Confirm deliveries, check product quantities and temperatures, apply qualitative judgments, and attach feedback or pictures to products or orders —all in the app. Eliminate supplier overcharges and ensure order accuracy from the convenience of your smartphone or tablet.
• Get Real-Time Business Insights – Track sales, food and labor costs, guest counts and so much more. Track real-time performance from the consolidated brand level down to each location. Quickly identify top-performing stores and areas needing improvement with actionable insights. 
• Optimize Operations – Free up managers and staff from manual paperwork, minimize waste, and improve order accuracy, all while making data-driven decisions on the go.
NOTE: Use of Crunchtime requires a subscription.

bluejetty:00148627:ios.name: Hidden Object: Secret of Salem
bluejetty:00148627:ios.summary: Step into the glitz of 1950s Salem, where you’ll discover one of the most enthralling hidden object games! In "Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch", illusions shimmer beneath the city’s glamorous façade, immersing you in the very heart of
bluejetty:00148627:ios.description:
Step into the glitz of 1950s Salem, where you’ll discover one of the most enthralling hidden object games! In "Secrets of Salem: Shadow of the Witch", illusions shimmer beneath the city’s glamorous façade, immersing you in the very heart of the mystery games, brimming with secrets. Join Dakota, the daughter of a Salem witch, as she returns home following the cryptic news of her mother’s death. Dare to delve into the most haunting corners of the city, where unsolved mysteries games come to life, and only the bravest can find hidden objects to uncover the truth!
Step into the dazzling streets of 1950s Salem, a city of towering lights and whispered spells, where glamour masks danger, and magic simmers beneath the surface of modernity. Dakota, the daughter of a Salem witch, returns to her hometown after receiving a mysterious letter about her mother’s death. Attacked by a shadowy figure, Dakota finds herself mortally wounded and trapped between the world of the living and the spirit realm. Guided by her mother’s friend Sebille, Dakota discovers her magical abilities and learns the killer is hunting witches across Salem. As a ghost, Dakota uncovers dark rituals, confronts vengeful spirits, and pieces together the attacker's identity. With her body lying in a hospital bed, her soul journeys into Salem’s most haunted places. Will Dakota harness her newfound powers, save her coven, and return to the living - or will she be consumed by the shadows?
Spellbinding Mini-Games!
Put your skills to the test with enchanting puzzles that unlock secrets and propel Dakota’s story forward. Tackle creative potion-brewing, memory-based spellcasting sequences, and intricate lock-picking games!
Immersive Hidden Object Games!
Delve into classic hidden object games as you find hidden objects crucial to unmasking Salem’s lurking terrors. Explore eerie cemeteries, haunted mansions, and neon-lit streets of 1950s Salem, all brimming with supernatural clues!
Choice-Driven Narrative!
Shape Dakota’s destiny with decisions that lead to multiple endings—will you stand strong or succumb to the dark? Forge alliances or fuel rivalries with characters who hold the key to defeating Salem’s witch-hunter. Every dialogue choice matters!
Magical Collectibles and Achievements!
Hunt for ancient amulets, spell tomes, and coven artifacts that enhance Dakota’s powers and reveal Salem’s haunted legacy. Earn achievements by solving mini-games flawlessly, uncovering rare items, and making key narrative choices!
Are you ready to uncover the shadows of Salem? Begin your magical journey with the free trial now!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00179858:ios.name: Kids Car Games for Toddlers
bluejetty:00179858:ios.summary: "Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing," the ultimate app designed to engage and entertain children while promoting early learning and education. This exciting game is packed with thrilling car-themed activities that will capture the imagination o
bluejetty:00179858:ios.description:
"Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing," the ultimate app designed to engage and entertain children while promoting early learning and education. This exciting game is packed with thrilling car-themed activities that will capture the imagination of boys and girls aged 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 years old. Let your baby, kid, toddler, or child embark on an unforgettable adventure with monster trucks, fire engines, police cars, and more!
Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing is specifically tailored to cater to the interests of young children, providing a safe and engaging environment where they can learn, play, and explore. We understand the importance of early learning and have created this app with a focus on enhancing cognitive skills and promoting educational development.
With a wide range of games and activities, Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing offers endless hours of entertainment while fostering essential skills. From solving puzzles and learning colors to identifying animals and washing cars, each activity is designed to enhance cognitive abilities and problem-solving skills. It's never too early to start learning, and this app ensures that every child, toddler, and preschooler can enjoy an exciting and educational experience.
At the heart of Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing are the captivating car races and challenges. Watch as your kid’s eyes light up with excitement as they navigate monster trucks through challenging tracks, put out fires with the fire engine, or uphold justice as a police officer. These games not only provide an adrenaline-pumping experience but also teach valuable lessons about teamwork, responsibility, and helping others.
We believe every child, child, toddler, or preschooler, whether they are boys or girls. should have the opportunity to explore and learn. While the app name mentions "Car Games for Kids!, it is equally suitable for boys and girls. We aim to provide a fun and educational experience for all children, fostering a love for learning and encouraging early development.
Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing offers age-appropriate content for toddlers, preschoolers, and kindergartners, ensuring that each activity aligns with their developmental milestones. Whether your child is a toddler, preschooler, or kindergartener, they will find engaging and entertaining gameplay within the app. We understand that each child learns at their own pace, and our app provides a customizable experience that adapts to their individual needs.
The safety and well-being of your baby, kid, child, or toddler are our top priorities. Car Games for Kids! Fun Racing is free from any harmful content and offers a safe environment for children to play and learn. 
Join the millions of satisfied users who have already discovered the joy of Car Games for Kids! Let your child dive into a world of adventure and early learning. Get ready for endless hours of entertainment and educational fun!
We pay great attention to the feedback of our customers, please do not hesitate to contact us at meemu.kids@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: http://www.meemukids.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: http://www.meemukids.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00084098:ios.description:
Welcome to VAIB - The Home of AI Influencers!
Step into a world where AI meets creativity and community. VAIB is not just another app; it's a universe of AI characters that you can chat with, follow, and create. Whether you’re here to discover new AI influencers, build your unique characters, or immerse yourself in engaging conversations, VAIB is your ultimate platform for AI-driven social experiences!
• Connect with a Diverse World of AI Characters 
Meet and chat with AI characters that feel alive! From iconic personalities to imaginative new creations, VAIB offers a library of AI influencers that are crafted by our community and ready to engage. Follow your favorites, interact in real-time, and see them grow and evolve based on your interactions.
• Engage in Lifelike Conversations and Role Play 
VAIB isn't just about chatting—it's about truly connecting. Enjoy deep, meaningful conversations with AI characters that remember your past interactions, making every chat more personalized and engaging. Switch seamlessly between text and voice chat for a more immersive experience.
• Unleash Your Creativity - Create Your Own AI Influencer! 
Why just follow when you can lead? With VAIB’s powerful creator tools, you can design your own AI character from scratch. Choose their appearance, voice, and unique personality traits. Bring them to life and let them interact with the world. Share your creation, grow your following, and become a trendsetter in the AI influencer community!
• Join a Thriving Community of AI Enthusiasts! 
VAIB is more than an app; it's a community. Share your experiences, get the latest updates, and connect with fellow AI enthusiasts on our social platforms. We're here to innovate, inspire, and push the boundaries of AI together!
• Ready to Experience the Future of AI Influencers? 
Download VAIB now and start your journey in the world of AI influencers today. The only limit is your imagination!
Join us on socials for updates, news, and community events:
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/VaibApp/
Discord: https://discord.gg/2etW4JGvUS
Powered by cutting-edge AI technology, VAIB is designed to bring your creative visions to life. Join the VAIB revolution and shape the future of AI influencers!

bluejetty:00179483:ios.description:
Ensemble Stars!! Music, the all-direction immersive mobile rhythm game, the essential sequel of Ensemble Stars! Basic, will be released soon! Idols from Yumenosaki Academy start their brand-new journey. You will surely find your ideal type among all 49 stylish, shining stars!
Elaborated 3D live scenes, engaging stories by famous playwrights, and a luxurious voice cast—enjoy everything about your idols here! Immerse yourself in a new experience!
[Super Real 3D LIVE, Closer to the Stage]
Switch on the 3D LIVE mode, enjoy the melodious music, and see the stylish MV performances unfold before your eyes. Four difficulty levels from Easy to Expert for Live Stages are available. The Live experience remains the same on all difficulty levels, so please enjoy the fabulous beats on whatever level you like!

All-New HDFC Bank App
Welcome to the HDFC Bank App — a secure and powerful mobile banking app designed to make everyday banking fast, simple, and convenient.
Manage your bank accounts, UPI payments, fund transfers, bill payments, credit cards, and loans from one trusted digital banking app
Key Features of the HDFC Bank App
 Thoughtfully Designed Interface
Enjoy a clean, intuitive, and user-friendly banking experience built for effortless navigation.
 Secure Lock – Take Control of Your Banking Access
Instantly block or unblock access to the HDFC Bank App, NetBanking, and UPI across apps with a single tap—helping protect your account from unauthorized use.
- One-tap block/unblock anytime
- 100% digital self-service
- Scheduled payments continue as usual
- Extra protection during travel or suspicious activity
Two-Step Verification – Faster & Safer Authentication
Approve and authenticate transactions directly through the New HDFC Bank App—without waiting for OTPs.
- Instant approvals via secure app notifications
- Strong multi-factor authentication
- Faster logins without OTP delays
- Password-less login with QR scan and mPIN
- Seamless authentication for payees and transactions
 Fast & Secure Login :
Access your account instantly using fingerprint login, facial recognition, or MPIN authentication.
Complete Account Overview :
View and manage your savings account, current account, fixed deposits, recurring deposits, and credit card details in one place.
UPI Payments & Instant Fund Transfers. Send and receive money instantly using :
- UPI (Unified Payments Interface)
- IMPS
- NEFT
- Transfer funds to any bank account securely, anytime.
 Easy Bill Payments & Recharges :
Pay electricity bills, gas bills, broadband, DTH, mobile recharge, and other utility payments directly from the app.
Apply for Loans & Manage Credit Cards :
- Apply for personal loans and home loans
- Manage credit card payments and services
- Track EMIs and loan details easily
Debit Card Reward Points Redemption :
Check your available debit card reward points and redeem them directly via the app.
Smart Savings & Deposits :
Open and manage fixed deposits and recurring deposits digitally for smarter savings.
Advanced Multi-Layered Security :
Stay protected with device binding, authentication controls, and robust security systems to ensure safe online banking.
Personalized Banking Insights :
Receive tailored financial insights and smart recommendations to help manage expenses, savings, and investments better.
Customizable Themes :
Switch between day mode and night mode for a comfortable viewing experience.
Why Choose the HDFC Bank App?
- Trusted digital banking from one of India’s leading private banks
- Secure mobile banking with advanced protection
- Fast UPI money transfer & online payments
- Easy loan applications & credit card management
- All your banking services in one powerful app
Download the All-New HDFC Bank App Today 
Experience secure, fast, and convenient banking at your fingertips. Manage accounts, transfer money, pay bills, apply for loans, and more — anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00024423:ios.summary:
Spelling Matching Quiz English: fun vocabulary practice for the whole family
Learn English words by matching pictures to their spellings. Draw a line from each picture to the right word, hear it spoken by a native speaker, and build memory
bluejetty:00024423:ios.description:
Spelling Matching Quiz English: fun vocabulary practice for the whole family
Learn English words by matching pictures to their spellings. Draw a line from each picture to the right word, hear it spoken by a native speaker, and build memory and spelling skills one round at a time. It suits young children learning with their parents and beginners who want a simple, hands-on way to review everyday vocabulary.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• 500 words in 18 categories: Animals, Fruits, Vegetables, Colors, Shapes, Numbers, Food, Transportation, School, Clothing, Household Items, Jobs, Body Parts, Toys, Nature, Places, Sports and Actions
• Native-speaker audio for every word. Tap a word to hear it again as often as you like
• Smooth line-drawing controls. Drag from a picture to its word to make a match
• Clear feedback on every match
TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Time Attack: match as many pairs as you can before the 60-second clock runs out
• Survival: each correct match adds time and each mistake takes time away. How long can you last?
TRACK PROGRESS
• My Scores saves your best results, so learners and parents can see improvement over time
MADE FOR FAMILIES
• A clean, simple interface with few distractions
• Bright, friendly pictures that young learners recognize easily
• Adjustable sound settings
Practice a few minutes a day and watch your vocabulary grow!

bluejetty:00143718:ios.description:
2nd Anniversary Celebration Starts! Tons of Benefits Await! 
Don't miss out! Log in now for free rewards and incredible discounts!
From Journey to the West to The Book of Mountains and Seas, there are many classic characters. Let's immerse in the romantic myths and legends together! 
First Invincible Hero [Victorious Buddha] debuts. Fight with Wukong, confront the destiny and evolve into Buddha! 
Never forget your original purpose as you embark once again on this journey. Return with special privileges to help Guardian Lords restart their adventure and reunite in the Three Realms!
Epic Oriental Mythology RPG Monkey King: Arena of Heroes is here! Join Monkey King and Tang Monk on an epic journey from ancient China to the West in search of sacred sutras! 
Take part in intense 6v6 RPG card battles, collect hundreds of heroes, and build up your team on the way to the champion of four realms. Don’t miss out on the lifetime free daily 10x draws! 
Features
Epic Interpretation of Journey to the West
Unveil the secrets of the four factions: Celestial, Holy, Underworld, and Demon. What is recorded in the fabled sacred sutras? And why must Tang Monk have to overcome 81 perils before he can obtain the sutras? Now, the Oriental Odyssey awaits your exploration and interpretation.
Hundreds of Heroes to Collect
How did Sun Wukong learn the 72 transformations? What's behind Tang Monk's 10 reincarnations? What was the tragic past of Lady White Bone? Want to learn more about the origin of all the heroes? Recruit them to your team and find out their secrets for yourself!
Free Hero Switch
Who says training different heroes must be tedious? Made a wrong choice earlier and has to start all over? In Monkey King: Arena of Heroes, growing a hero from scratch is unnecessary when you change a lineup. Use the quick hero switch feature to transfer exp, equipment, and resources among heroes instantly.
Lifetime Daily Free 10x Draws
Say goodbye to saving up for days just to perform a draw! Monkey King: Arena of Heroes offers free 10x draws every day forever! That's 3,650 free draws per year! Getting heroes you like has never been easier!
Kick Back and Relax
Want to take a break after battles? Want to spend more time with your heroes? Then try out the fun Homeland feature! Decorate your home and play mini-games to win exciting prizes. In Monkey King: Arena of Heroes, you can always take a break and enjoy your time!
You can find us on the following platforms. We welcome all of your thoughts and suggestions.
Customer Service Email: cs@monkeykingaoh.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/monkeyking.en
※Attention ※ 
Please don’t compare us to [Black Myth], [Black Wukong], or [Black Myth Wukong]. Our game is based on the Journey to the West universe, featuring various Wukong incarnations (mythical, dark, enlightened, etc.), but it focuses on strategic mobile gameplay.
If you are craving dazzling Wukong battles, drop your phone, fire up your computer, and give it a try!

bluejetty:00161949:ios.summary:
PORO Japanese Kanji for all is one apps of our ongoing project for Kanji learner with purpose of giving helful, free and easy tool for Japanese learner to learn Kanji .
PORO Japanese Kanji application's content included 2500 Kanji of all le
bluejetty:00161949:ios.description:
PORO Japanese Kanji for all is one apps of our ongoing project for Kanji learner with purpose of giving helful, free and easy tool for Japanese learner to learn Kanji .
PORO Japanese Kanji application's content included 2500 Kanji of all levels from Kanji N5, Kanji N4 to Kanji N3, Kanji N2 and Kanji N1 which are divided into 231 topics, covering almost kanji of all levels, to help practice and reinforce your Japanese Kanji.
Each kanji has detailed information of meanings, kunyomi, onyomi and many examples. By giving learner many tools to study from flashcards, customizable quizzes to kanji challenges and also marking remembered words.
This apps also offers 1300s of questions, with 100 quizzes test, imitates type of test in the JLPT Test. 
Main Features
== Detailed kanji info
• View kanji, its meaning, learn kunyomi and onyomi of each kanji
• Check out example words, kanji relations and its meanings to build up your word power.
== Flashcard study
• The visibility of readings, onyomi, kunyomi and associated meanings.
• Swipe to quickly to test your remembering of that kanji and also to move to another kanji to learn
• Assign favorite mark to filter kanji that you love
== Practice test
• Customize questions to test your remembering and understanding of kanji, meanings, kunyomi, onyomi and also its relation.
• Spread out your vocabulary by doing test with relation words
• Customized repeat wrong answers to help you remember it.
• Review in the end of test showed you which words have you remembered.
== Kanji challenges
• Improve your kanji recognition by challenging yourself recognize right kanji with given meaning in limited time
== JLPT test
• Each level contains over 400 grammar activities, split into about 20 tests, are made to mimic a real JLPT exam, to prepare you to JLPT test 
• Review in the end of test showed you how many questions did you correct 
• View results, explanation of the test answers to let you know what did you wrong 
== General view all over 2500 words of kanji from level beginner to advance
• By seeing all over 2500 words of Kanji in overview screen, you can look and compare the differences from each other
• Tracking your learning progress by seeing which kanji you already remembered by mark
• 5 levels, from beginner to advance, for choosing to learn. Suitable for beginner to advance
*** PORO - Japanese Kanji for ALL** suitable for:
- Japanese learner from basic to intermedite
- Is preparing to practice Japanese JLPT N1,N2,N3,N4,N5
- Love Japanese culture.
- Anyone interested in Japanese letters
- Like to challenge your level
PORO - Study Kanji for ALL is in developing process; we hope to receive your contribution comment to make it better.
We are just a team that love Japanese and try to share our love to community, so if you like this app then please take a moment to rate it. You can also get in touch with comments or suggestions via the feedback button on the Options Screen.
Please kindly contact:
- Email: PORO.lingo@gmail.com
- Fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/PORO.japanese/
- Terms of Service : https://www.app-privacy-policy.com/live.php?token=e8vq8yLmDqB7Jd6oA04UG1JCcFFYhApt
- Privacy Policy : https://www.app-privacy-policy.com/live.php?token=z87rwghlAYmOT8AsO84A4SKEeceY308h
Thank you very much and Good luck!

bluejetty:00022890:ios.name: Pregnancy Tracker, Due Date
bluejetty:00022890:ios.summary:
Congratulations on your pregnancy, and welcome to our pregnancy tracking app! This is the ultimate tool to monitor your baby’s development and the changes in your body, preparing you for the amazing journey of motherhood:
► Track Your Baby
bluejetty:00022890:ios.description:
Congratulations on your pregnancy, and welcome to our pregnancy tracking app! This is the ultimate tool to monitor your baby’s development and the changes in your body, preparing you for the amazing journey of motherhood:
► Track Your Baby’s Development: 
• Vivid images that allow you to genuinely experience your baby’s weekly growth. 
• Weekly size comparisons of your baby to cute fruits and animals. 
• Update weight weekly to easily feel your baby's growth.
► Changes in Your Body: 
• Learn about common symptoms for each week of pregnancy. 
• Understand the important milestones in your pregnancy and prepare for motherhood. 
• Countdown to your due date so you can cherish every moment until your baby arrives.
► Useful Tools: 
• Track your baby’s kicks to monitor movements and ensure your baby’s well-being. 
• Journal and chart your weight changes throughout your pregnancy.
• Track your labor contractions to determine when to go to the hospital.
• AI Symptom Checker.
• Sleep sounds help you sleep better.
• Breathing exercises reduce stress and help relax.
► Weekly Body Care Guidance: 
• Diet and nutrition guidance tailored to each stage of pregnancy for a healthy journey. 
• Pregnancy-specific exercises to maintain your health and flexibility. 
• Daily health tips provided by experts and reliable medical sources.
► Pregnancy Calculator: 
• Based on the information you provide: Due date, first day of your last menstrual period, ultrasound date, artificial insemination date, and IVF transfer date to easily calculate your baby’s gestational age. 
• In particular, our application can store and track for many pregnant mothers at the same time, extremely convenient.
► The Perfect Experience for Your Upcoming Motherhood Journey: 
• Minimalist design, easy to use, focusing on the most important aspects of pregnancy. 
• Plenty of free features for you to experience the app’s usefulness. 
• We continuously update and improve the app to provide the most comprehensive and best value for you and your baby. 
We wish you a wonderful pregnancy and look forward to welcoming your healthy baby into the world with our support!
DISCLAIMER: 
This app is for informational purposes only and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your healthca

bluejetty:00096864:ios.description:
Turn Your Car Screen Into Something Personal
Your car screen doesn’t have to be just maps and menus. With myCar, it becomes yours.
Bring Your Style to Your Car Screen
myCar lets you customize your car screen with what actually matters to you. Add your favorite couple photos, choose icons you like, or even display fun GIFs. It’s your space, make it feel like it.
A Car Dashboard You’ll Actually Enjoy Looking At
Instead of the same standard layout every day, create a look that reflects your mood and personality. Whether it’s a photo that makes you smile or a clean, minimal setup, it’s all up to you.
Add Motion, Not Just Static
Why stop at photos? Bring your screen to life with GIFs that move and catch your eye. It’s a small touch that makes a big difference every time you get in the car.
Quick, Simple, Personal
No complicated setup. Just choose what you want to see and it’s there
• Couple photos and memories
• Custom icons
• Animated GIFs
Start with a Sound You Love
Tap to hear your favorite startup sound and set the tone before you even begin driving. From powerful engine sounds to smooth electric tones, pick what feels right.
Why You’ll Love myCar
Because your car is part of your daily life, and it should feel like it belongs to you. myCar adds personality, emotion, and a bit of fun to every drive.
Make your car screen yours
Download myCar and turn every drive into something more personal.
Premium Mode
Upgrade to unlock advanced customization options, enhanced layouts, and extended tools for a more personalized dashboard experience.
Privacy and Security
Your data stays on your device whenever possible.
No personal information is sold or shared with third parties. Data is only used to support app functionality and improvements.

Looking for a new job in Ireland? Download the Jobs.ie Job Search App and start your Irish job hunt now. Jobs.ie is Ireland’s leading recruitment website; with 3,000+ live jobs from 1,200+ employers. Enjoy a quick and successful job hunt when you download the Jobs.ie App.

Jobs.ie Job Search App Features:
• Find and apply for the latest jobs in Ireland
• Search full-time, part-time, permanent, temporary and contract jobs
• Refine your job search by location, find jobs near you
• Browse the latest jobs from multinationals and Irish businesses of all sizes.

Jobs.ie – Job Search Success:
• Search over 3,000 jobs from over 1,200 employers in Ireland
• Refine and filter job search results by sector, location, salary and date
• View the latest vacancies, save jobs and see your recent job searches
• Create job alerts and get push notifications on the latest jobs
• Create a Jobs.ie profile and your next job could find you
• Upload your CV and apply for jobs with your mobile device using cloud storage services
• Get CV tips, interview advice and job search tips
• Access free online career tools designed to support your job search
Our app is regularly improved to help you find your dream job. This time this is mainly about bug fixes and performance improvements.With its head office in Dublin, Jobs.ie Ireland’s leading jobs website. Jobs.ie has been helping people find jobs in Ireland for twenty years. Jobs.ie is part of Saongroup.com, a world leader in online recruitment.

MORE JOBS.IE JOB APP FEATURES

>> Find employment in Ireland by Industry:

Accountancy & finance, banking, financial services & insurance, beauty, hair care, leisure & sport, construction, architecture & property, customer service, call centres & languages, education, childcare & training, engineering, environmental, health & safety, executive, general management & consulting, graduate, hospitality, HR, IT, legal, marketing, motoring, nursing, healthcare & medical, production, manufacturing & materials, public sector and policing, publishing, media & creative arts, retailing, wholesaling & purchasing, sales, science, agriculture, pharmaceutical & food, secretarial & admin, security, trades & general services, social, voluntary & vocational, telecoms, tourism, travel & airlines, transport, distribution and warehousing.

>> Personalise you job search to your preferred location in Ireland

Jobs.ie job app locates jobs in Antrim, Armagh, Carlow, Cavan, Clare, Cork, Derry, Donegal, Down, Dublin, Fermanagh, Galway, Kerry, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Leitrim, Limerick, Longford, Louth, Mayo, Meath, Monaghan, Offaly, Roscommon, Sligo, Tipperary, Tyrone, Waterford, Westmeath, Wexford, Wicklow. You can also search for jobs using Ulster, Munster, Leinster, Connacht, Midlands, Nationwide and International.

>> Find part-time jobs, work from home jobs, permanent jobs, contract jobs and full-time jobs

>> Search and apply for employment that match your skills and experience

MORE ON Jobs.ie.

We are Ireland’s leading recruitment website with thousands of jobs from employers and recruitment agencies in Ireland.

Whether you are at the beginning of your career, want to take your career to the next level or simply want to find work that is perfect for your skills and experience then the Jobs.ie job search app will help.

The Jobs.ie job app is packed with the latest features to make your job search quick and easy. Never miss your dream job with job alerts and on the go via push notifications.

Sync your Jobs.ie job search app with your Jobs.ie jobseeker account and you can access your profile across all your devices, making your job hunt even more effective.

Finding your new job in Ireland is now easier than ever. Download the Jobs.ie job app today and start your search for your new job in Ireland.

bluejetty:00100233:ios.name: Infinite Lives
bluejetty:00100233:ios.summary: Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe! Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, as a combat system perfect
bluejetty:00100233:ios.description:
Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe! Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, as a combat system perfected by wrestling flies to new heights. An ambitious control system supercharges EVERY button, creating a spectrum of abilities that are easy to enjoy yet difficult to master.
Tell your own origin story, as you try to survive in a city dominated by supernatural violence and reveal who you really are. Develop powers that make you MORE than human, or lose the spirit that makes you LESS than human - in a vicious cycle that never ends! Find your place among hundreds of other heroes and villains, each trying to rule the world with their own unique powers. Fight over every corner of the map to secure it for your chosen cause, as allegiances change as often as your costume! The city's dozens of locations are filled with hundreds of fully interactive weapons and destructible scenery to level the playing field.
Upon subscribing to the full game with no ads, you can make the world your own by saving your changes to any character you've defeated in battle. You can then blow off steam in "Fight Scenes" - where you decide WHO fights WHERE and with WHAT! And when it's time to roam back into the city, you'll have the privilege to start each new life fine-tuned to your liking with more and more options unlocking infinite possibilities.
The terms of service for auto-renewable subscriptions can be found here:
http://www.mdickie.com/terms.htm

bluejetty:00063067:ios.name: Builder Game - Craft & Paint
bluejetty:00063067:ios.summary:
It's your turn to run the coolest handyman’s workshop. Enjoy our tractor and truck games or home builder tasks like welding & building.
Customers want to order your best products and services. You can do activities like digging the soil,
bluejetty:00063067:ios.description:
It's your turn to run the coolest handyman’s workshop. Enjoy our tractor and truck games or home builder tasks like welding & building.
Customers want to order your best products and services. You can do activities like digging the soil, building or demolishing houses and towers, constructing wood products, cutting wood, welding and other fun things. Make what customers ordered using different building materials, tools and machines to achieve greatest results. A good name is better than riches!
• Woodworking: Cut the wood accurately with different saws. Construct a chair, bench, fence, birdhouse or doghouse with a hammer or screwdrivers. Put the finishing touch to the new wood product by polishing and painting it.
• Build the tower: Build an apartment or business tower with the help of a crane which can lift heavy loads. If some parts are not appropriate for the kind of tower you are building, put them on the assembly line and pick the right building part.
• Build the house: Pick builders tools and avoid toys and candies in the fun Catcher mini-game. Then build a house by adding windows, walls, a door, a balcony, stairs and a roof to make it a dream house.
• Demolish the tower: Sometimes an old building needs to be pulled down to make way for a new one. Use a hammer, pneumatic hammer, TNT box and wrecking ball. You will enjoy demolishing buildings in the middle of the city.
• Welding: Damages and holes have to be fixed. When you finish brushing the iron construction or leaky pipes in a customer’s house, don’t forget to use a welding mask before welding!
• Warehouse: You are getting so many orders! Pick up the phone! Customers want to order building material. Follow the shopping list, use a fork-lift and load a truck with boxes.
• Timber cutting: To get wood for your constructions, first chop timber with a chainsaw or a hatchet in the Timberman mini-game. Then move all the logs with a crane and cut them with the circular saw.
• Construction site: Be the head of the building site and roll up your sleeves. To fill the holes with soil, dig up the material with a digger, take a truck to transport it and use a road roller to flatten it.
• Tile art: Remove all the cracked tiles using different hammers, pour enough adhesive over the floor to lay new tiles and solve an animal puzzle in the meantime.
• Hardware Store: Find all must-have handyman tools and building materials in a fun game with hidden objects.
• Wall Builder: Follow building instructions to make a pillar, a wall or a built-in window, then paint a house facade with different colors.
• Electricity: Your customers need to fix the radio and lights so they call our professional electrician to help them. Electrical safety is very important!
• Bridge Builder: Operate different machines and build bridges with materials like wood, steel or concrete to become a real bridge city constructor.
Complete all fun challenges and be the boss builder in your town!
Features:
• easy-to-use game with a friendly interface
• many mini-games and creative possibilities
• over 50 different tools and building materials
• play and learn how things are made
• beautiful graphics and special sound effects
• earn coins to use entertaining tools
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, also some of those mentioned in game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO. If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml .
Terms of service: https://bubadu.com/tos.shtml

bluejetty:00021395:ios.summary: Introducing Video Rotate & Flip - the ultimate video editing app that empowers you to effortlessly rotate and flip your videos with precision and creativity! Whether you're a social media enthusiast, a content creator, or just someone who l
bluejetty:00021395:ios.description:
Introducing Video Rotate & Flip - the ultimate video editing app that empowers you to effortlessly rotate and flip your videos with precision and creativity! Whether you're a social media enthusiast, a content creator, or just someone who loves capturing memorable moments on camera, this app is your go-to solution for adding that perfect twist to your videos.
**********************
**** FEATURES: *****
**********************
Intuitive Video Rotation: Tired of sideways or upside-down videos? With Video Rotate & Flip, you can easily correct the orientation of your videos with a simple tap. Effortlessly rotate your footage clockwise or counterclockwise to ensure your content always looks polished and professional.
Flip Horizontally & Vertically: Unleash your creative prowess by flipping your videos horizontally or vertically. Bring a fresh perspective to your content and create mesmerizing effects that captivate your audience. The flip feature adds a touch of uniqueness and flair to your videos that will leave a lasting impression.
Easy-to-Use Interface: Video Rotate & Flip boasts an intuitive and user-friendly interface, making it accessible to users of all experience levels. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned video editor, you'll find the app seamless and enjoyable to use.
High-Quality Output: Our app ensures that your videos retain their original quality even after editing. Share your polished creations on social media platforms, video sharing sites, or with friends and family, knowing that they'll enjoy the same stunning visual experience you intended.
Video Toolbox: Merge, Trim, Crop, Reverse, Convert videos using this app. One place for all you video editing needs.
Save & Share with Ease: Save your edited videos directly to your device's gallery or share them instantly on popular social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and more. 
No Watermarks: Unlike other video editing apps, Video Rotate & Flip is free from watermarks. Your videos are yours to keep and share without any intrusive logos or marks.
Note: Videos are rotated frame wise. So the rotation is permanent and they are compatible with all video players on different platforms (Mac/PC/Other).
Our App can be used for free with Ads and limited features, however, you can purchase a Bulk Video Rotate Premium subscription for the additional advanced features, and remove Ads.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
When you download our App you can opt in to a 3 days free trial for monthly and 7 days free trial for yearly subscription. Our App offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Bulk Video Rotate Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING:
Premium Monthly: $1.99 / Month (3 days free trial)
Premium Yearly: $12.99 / Year (7 days free trial)
Read more about our terms, conditions, and privacy here:
• Privacy Policy: https://www.racersoft.in
• Terms of Use: https://racersoft.in/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00159550:ios.description:
Explore with ease. Fast, safe, and reliable rides at your fingertips.
Whether you’re heading to the beach, catching an early flight, or exploring nightlife, pickUP connects you to professional, licensed local taxi drivers in minutes. Say goodbye to waiting around at taxi stands or trying to flag down a cab—your ride comes directly to you.
Why Riders Love pickUP
- Easy Sign-In (Even on Airplane Mode): Register effortlessly via SMS or WhatsApp—perfect for visitors using hotel Wi-Fi or international roaming data!
- Upfront Fare Estimates: Know before you go! Get transparent price estimates for your journey before you confirm your ride.
- Card or Cash Payment: Pay your way! Link a credit/debit card to your in-app wallet for seamless digital payments, or pay cash directly to your driver.
- Ride On-Demand or Schedule Ahead: Need a lift right now or planning an early morning trip? Book instantly or reserve your ride in advance.
- 100% Licensed & Vetted Drivers: Ride with peace of mind. All pickUP drivers are verified local professionals dedicated to delivering a safe, friendly, and comfortable journey.
- Real-Time Tracking & Support: Track your driver’s arrival in real-time, stay in touch directly, and enjoy live customer support whenever you need help.
- From quick grocery runs across town to airport transfers and island tours, pickUP makes island transit effortless. Enjoy clean vehicles, spacious rides for luggage, and welcoming local drivers who know every shortcut and hidden gem.
How It Works:
1.Download & Register: Quick sign-up using your mobile number or WhatsApp.
2. Set Your Destination: See your route and estimated fare upfront.
3. Choose Payment: Cash or Credit Card.
4. Get Picked UP: Watch your driver arrive on the map in real time and enjoy the ride!
Don’t delay—download pickUP today and ride the easy way!

bluejetty:00149276:ios.name: Horizon - Intermittent Fasting
bluejetty:00149276:ios.summary: Horizon app is the easiest tool to keep track of your eating habits, and make your daily fasting routine better. Benefit from the most natural, healthy and effective weight-loss method, which has stood the test of time since ancient times.
bluejetty:00149276:ios.description:
Horizon app is the easiest tool to keep track of your eating habits, and make your daily fasting routine better. Benefit from the most natural, healthy and effective weight-loss method, which has stood the test of time since ancient times.
Perfect for establishing a simple eating discipline, Horizon is ideal for keeping yourself accountable and in control of your health, every day. Intermittent fasting makes your body regulate itself as it was designed by mother nature. It helps lose excessive weight and reinstating normal body processes that you might lost due to binge eating.
Intermittent Fasting is not a diet or a quick fix of your body. It doesn't tell you what to eat or not but instead it asks you to make a strict schedule of your eating habit. This is a simple lifestyle change for better health with a side effect of weight loss.
HORIZON’s FEATURES:
TRACKER - Set your goal, start your timer and stay on track. We'll keep you accountable from start to finish.
STAGES - Know what's happening with your body so you can stay motivated to reach key metabolic milestones.
STATISTICS - Chart your progress and see how you improve your fasting practice from day to day.
THEMES - Make it truly yours with a variety of beautiful color themes to choose from.
WIDGET - Have a glance at your fasting progress right from the home screen.
LEVELS - Keep you engaged and motivated to reach the peak title “The Fasting Guru”.
Horizon is intended to be a tool to track intermittent fasting and is not a medical or healthcare service. You should consult a medical professional before starting intermittent fasting or any weight loss program, especially if you are pregnant or suffer from a medical condition.
Download Horizon app for free! If you enjoy the experience, you can support a solo developer by upgrading to Horizon MAX and unlock all the available features.
*Payments will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. One Time Purchase items can be purchased multiple times. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings on the device.
Read more terms & conditions:
Terms of Use: https://archerandpain.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://archerandpain.com/privacy

Perfect for establishing a simple eating discipline, Horizon is ideal for keeping yourself accountable and in control of your health, every day. Intermittent fasting makes your body regulate itself as it was designed by mother nature. It helps lose excessive weight and reinstating normal body processes that you might lost due to binge eating.

Intermittent Fasting is not a diet or a quick fix of your body. It doesn't tell you what to eat or not but instead it asks you to make a strict schedule of your eating habit. This is a simple lifestyle change for better health with a side effect of weight loss.

HORIZON’s FEATURES:

TRACKER - Set your goal, start your timer and stay on track. We'll keep you accountable from start to finish.

STAGES - Know what's happening with your body so you can stay motivated to reach key metabolic milestones.

STATISTICS - Chart your progress and see how you improve your fasting practice from day to day.

THEMES - Make it truly yours with a variety of beautiful color themes to choose from.

WIDGET - Have a glance at your fasting progress right from the home screen.

LEVELS - Keep you engaged and motivated to reach the peak title “The Fasting Guru”.


Horizon is intended to be a tool to track intermittent fasting and is not a medical or healthcare service. You should consult a medical professional before starting intermittent fasting or any weight loss program, especially if you are pregnant or suffer from a medical condition.

Download Horizon app for free! If you enjoy the experience, you can support a solo developer by upgrading to Horizon MAX and unlock all the available features.

Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings on the device.

bluejetty:00179819:ios.description:
NBA 2K Mobile is a free NBA basketball card game that delivers authentic basketball simulation on your iPhone or iPad. Build your NBA team, collect real player cards, and compete in daily challenges, live events, and multiplayer matchups.
 Designed for fans who want more than arcade basketball, NBA 2K Mobile brings the strategy, depth, and excitement of the NBA to mobile. NBA 2K Mobile is a card collector and basketball simulator combined — every day offers new ways to play, earn rewards, and upgrade your roster as the league evolves.
 BUILD YOUR NBA CARD COLLECTION
 Collect hundreds of NBA player cards featuring today's stars and legendary greats like Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, and Wilt Chamberlain. Pull packs, chase rare Foil Cards, and build your NBA lineup as a true card collector. Upgrade your roster and manage your team like a true NBA decision-maker.
 MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY
 Run The Court
 Coach your team through strategic matchups as an NBA manager. Choose your lineup, activate boosts, and outplay opponents with smart offensive and defensive decisions.
 Rewind
 Play through the NBA season and relive the biggest moments. Complete daily challenges, climb leaderboards, and unlock exclusive content.
 Limited Time Events
 Fresh events rotate throughout the year, offering unique challenges and limited-time rewards to strengthen your team.
 Tourneys
 Experience playoff-style competition and earn powerful rewards as you advance through tiered tournaments.
 Head-to-Head Multiplayer
 Compete against players worldwide in real-time PvP basketball.
 CREATE AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLAYER
 Build your MyPLAYER in Crews Mode, customize your appearance, and represent your style on the court with friends in streetball-style crew battles.
 NBA 2K Mobile is a free NBA basketball card game and just one of the many titles brought to you by 2K including NBA 2K26, NBA 2K26 Arcade Edition, and much more!
 NBA 2K Mobile features high-quality 2K visuals and smooth gameplay optimized for iOS devices. Live NBA action requires iOS 15.5 or later with a minimum of 4GB RAM.
 Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa
 If you no longer have NBA 2K Mobile installed and would like to delete your account and all associated data, please visit this website: https://cdgad.azurewebsites.net/nba2kmobile
 NBA 2K Mobile is FREE to download and includes optional in-app purchases, including random items. Drop rate information is available in-game. In-app purchases can be disabled in device settings.

bluejetty:00074050:ios.summary:
App blog: https://goo.gl/da6LdZ
Millimeter Pro is an easy-to-use and helpful measurement tool for iPhone or iPad. It uses a touch screen as a ruler or tape measure to make quick measurements, split objects into equal parts, measure object
bluejetty:00074050:ios.description:
App blog: https://goo.gl/da6LdZ
Millimeter Pro is an easy-to-use and helpful measurement tool for iPhone or iPad. It uses a touch screen as a ruler or tape measure to make quick measurements, split objects into equal parts, measure object ratio (W/H), measure area, estimate diameter and angles, and split circular objects into equal parts. 
Place an object on the screen and simply touch and move rulers to measure it. 
You can measure in different units: MILLIMETERS or INCHES. 
Features: 
- mm and inch units 
- 2D measurements: vertical and horizontal rulers 
- area calculation 
- ratio calculation (W/H) 
- split linear and circular objects into equal parts 
- shows the length and angle of each part 
- disable/enable touch screen (freeze feature) 
- diameter or radius estimation 
- angle measure with Protractor / Goniometer mode
- Thread pitch gauge for TPI and pitch size measurements 
Use this app in different areas to measure small objects that fit within your phone or tablet screen: jewelry, rings, stones, gem, beads, screws, bolts, buttons, nuts, knitting needles, knitting patterns, washers, insects, mosaic tile, hooks, frame wrap angle, etc.
Enjoy the app and Thank you for your interest and support! 
VisTech.Projects Team

bluejetty:00072369:ios.description:
Introducing Actually Healthy! Our innovative recipe app that offers a range of recipes and healthy meal plans. Plus, it takes into account a crucial aspect of women's health - their menstrual phase. This ultimate women’s nutrition app not only provides a wide range of delicious recipes for every occasion, but it also suggests recipes tailored to your menstrual phase, helping you to nourish your body and maintain optimal health throughout your cycle.
Actually Healthy Features
AI Nutrition Coach:
Get instant answers to all your nutrition related questions. It’s like having your own personal nutritionist at your fingertips. The app uses an AI to respond exactly like a nutrition coach would so that you can have your health questions answered 24/7. With Actually Healthy, you’d gain access to a set of features designed to provide you with personalized healthy nutrition guidance, expert nutrition support, and a wealth of educational food resources
Recipes to Grocery Lists:
It turns recipes into custom grocery lists that connect to Instacart for convenient delivery. New recipes added monthly from our nutrition coach.
Personalized Cycle Syncing Recipe Recommendations :
Every woman should eat in sync with her menstrual cycle, and the app provides just that, providing recipe recommendations with your current menstrual phase.
Restaurant Foodvisor:
Finding a healthy meal in a restaurant can be a challenge. Don’t fret, because this app helps you find healthier options hidden among the diet disasters. Its Restaurant “Foodvisor” feature allows the app’s AI to automatically recognize and recommend healthy ordering suggestions when going to any restaurant.
For a healthy life, we need a healthy lifestyle. This app provides healthy meal recipes that will help you to maintain your health and fitness. From healthy lunch ideas, desserts, easy healthy recipes, breakfast ideas, you name it! All of our recipes have been tried and tested by food experts and home cooks, and our app makes it easy to whip up your favorites wherever you go! 
With Actually Healthy, you can easily track your menstrual cycle and receive personalized recipe recommendations based on your current phase. Whether you're in your follicular, ovulatory, luteal, or menstrual phase, our app provides recipes that are specifically designed to support your body's unique needs during each phase.
From nutrient-rich smoothies to comforting soups and stews, our app offers a wide range of delicious and healthy recipes that are easy to prepare and perfect for every occasion. You can even save your favorite recipes and create a meal plan for the week, making healthy eating a breeze.
So, if you're looking for a recipe app that not only provides delicious recipes but also takes into account your menstrual cycle, look no further than our app. 
Please note that this service requires payment after a one-time free trial offer. To continue accessing personalized recipe recommendations and other premium features, you will need to pay for the subscription. We offer weekly, monthly, and yearly plans to suit your needs. 
Download Actually Healthy now and start enjoying delicious, healthy meals that support your body's natural rhythms.
License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Disclaimer for the AI Nutrition Coach: please seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this feature and before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00179724:ios.description:
This is an application for Nikon's photo sharing service, NIKON IMAGE SPACE. This service brings your photos even closer to you and increases your enjoyment of the pictures you've taken. The app is the result of persistent sophistication of three simple functions--reviewing, organizing and sharing. It delivers greater convenience, more comfort and enhanced smartness to the photo lives of all photo lovers. 
[Main Features] 
 View
- Both photos uploaded to NIKON IMAGE SPACE and those stored on the device may be viewed. 
- Switch between the two views (Grid/Flow) to enjoy viewing photos in a form suited to your preferences.
- Photos can be viewed by sorting them by shooting date, camera model, and more.
 Management
- Photos can be rearranged into an easy-to-understand organization with the use of albums and album cases.
- Photos can be rearranged simply by performing drag-and-drop operations of their thumbnails. 
- The background processing feature allows the app to be operated while the upload or download process is underway. 
Sharing 
- The photos you want shared can be shared with the intended people by sending a URL.
- The app allows you to easily share photos by email or through an SNS.
[Other] 
- Access to all functions requires a signup with NIKON IMAGE SPACE.
- Some features may not be available if you restrict the app’s access to contacts, pictures on the device, or other device features after installation.

- App Store is a service mark of Apple Inc.

This is an application for Nikon's photo sharing service, NIKON IMAGE SPACE. This service brings your photos even closer to you and increases your enjoyment of the pictures you've taken. The app is the result of persistent sophistication of three simple functions--reviewing, organizing and sharing. It delivers greater convenience, more comfort and enhanced smartness to the photo lives of all photo lovers. 

[Main Features] 
 View
- Both photos uploaded to NIKON IMAGE SPACE and those stored on the device may be viewed. 
- Switch between the two views (Grid/Flow) to enjoy viewing photos in a form suited to your preferences.
- Photos can be viewed by sorting them by shooting date, camera model, and more.

 Management
- Photos can be rearranged into an easy-to-understand organization with the use of albums and album cases.
- Photos can be rearranged simply by performing drag-and-drop operations of their thumbnails. 
- The background processing feature allows the app to be operated while the upload or download process is underway. 

Sharing 
- The photos you want shared can be shared with the intended people by sending a URL.
- The app allows you to easily share photos by email or through an SNS.

[Other] 
- Access to all functions requires a signup with NIKON IMAGE SPACE.
- Some features may not be available if you restrict the app’s access to contacts, pictures on the device, or other device features after installation.

- iPhone, iPad and iPod touch are registered trademarks of Apple Inc. in the United States and other countries. 
- App Store is a service mark of Apple Inc. 
- Other names of products are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective companies.

bluejetty:00137858:ios.description:
Let's embark on a mechanical journey like no other in Screw Pin - Jam Puzzle. Your mission is to untwist screws and put them in the right screw boxes. You win when completing all the screw sets. Unscrew them all now!
HOW TO PLAY
- Remove screws in correct order to drop each board, one by one.
- Fill each screw box with the same color screws, you need to fill all of them to win.
- No time limit, relax and play whenever you want.
- Unlimited levels! A lot of Nuts & Bolts strategies await you.
- Multiple boosters can be used to support you in tricky situations
FEATURES
- Addictive gameplay, help you relax and train your brain
- ASMR Screw game: Beautiful design with satisfying in-game sounds
This challenging and addictive Screw pin game will put your problem-solving skills to the test as you twist, turn, and strategize your way through a maze of intricate puzzles. With each level, the puzzles become more intricate and satisfyingly complex. 
Are you a puzzle game lover?
Just finding a fun and addictive game? 
This Screw Puzzle game is perfect for you. With cute graphic and ASMR sounds, Screw Pin - Jam Puzzle is an ideal Nuts & Bolts Jam game to relax and have fun. 
Let's untwist screws now!

bluejetty:00135456:ios.description:
Train your pool game with structured drills, lessons, and powerful training tools.
Please note: WPB is a training app for real pool and billiards. It’s built for players practicing on a physical table—not a phone game.
From World of Pool and Billiards (WPB), this app turns your table time into a structured training program with drills, lessons, tools, and tracking.
THE DRILL ENCYCLOPEDIA
Stop hitting balls aimlessly and start running focused practice sessions.
 • 200+ structured drills for aiming, fundamentals, cue-ball control, position play, safeties, and more
 • Browse drills by difficulty and skill category
 • Track your scores and see your progress over time
 • Use timers and weekly leaderboards to stay accountable
 • Create and share your own custom drills
AIMING CALCULATOR | GHOST-BALL AIMING VISUALIZER
Struggling with cut shots and contact points? Use the aiming calculator to visualize the ghost ball and learn how to aim any cut shot on the table.
 • Drag and drop the cue ball and object ball to recreate any shot in seconds
 • Select a pocket and instantly see the ghost-ball position and contact point
 • See estimated cue-ball paths for stun, rolling top spin, and draw
 • Get an instant answer at the table whenever you’re unsure how to aim a shot
BREAK SPEED CALCULATOR
Don’t guess—measure.
 • Quickly time your break and see your break speed in seconds
 • Compare breaks with friends and see who’s really bringing the heat
 • Test different cues and techniques to find your most powerful controlled break
A harder break is only an advantage if you can control it—this tool helps you understand and refine both power and consistency.
COMPLETE POOL COURSE
Instead of random tips and clips, follow a clear curriculum.
 • Fundamentals: stance, grip, bridge, and shot routine
 • Shot Making: aim, cue-ball control, using side spin, and position play
 • Advanced Techniques: kicking systems and bank shots
 • Lessons link directly to drills so you know exactly what to practice next
Your place in the course is saved, so you always know what to work on when you walk into the pool hall.
TABLE LAYOUT CREATOR AND TRAINING TOOLS
Design, save, and share situations you want to study.
 • Drag and drop balls to recreate missed shots and tricky layouts
 • Build your own custom drills and annotate them with text and shapes
 • Use the shot clock, simple tournament manager, and quick links to official rule books
COMMUNITY FOR SERIOUS POOL PLAYERS
Connect with players who are actively working to improve their game.
 • Share layouts, drills, and participate in discussions
 • Compete on weekly leaderboards, share personal bests, and earn badges for performance milestones
It’s a focused space built around training and getting better at pool—not just another social feed.
WHO WPB IS FOR
 • League players (APA, BCA, and local leagues) looking to move up a skill level
 • Fargo-rated players who want to raise their rating
 • Tournament and money-game players who want structured practice
 • Coaches and room owners who want ready-made drills and layouts for students
If you’re willing to put in the work, WPB gives you a framework to follow.
FREE VS PREMIUM
WPB is free to download with a limited preview mode. To access the full training experience, every user is eligible for a 7-day free trial.
Upgrade to Premium to unlock:
 • Full drill library
 • Complete course and all lessons
 • All training tools
 • Detailed progress tracking and performance insights
Choose the plan that fits your training: Monthly, Annual, or Lifetime access.
The annual plan costs less than a single in-person coaching session—and gives you a full year of structured training.
Download WPB: Pool Training & Drills and start turning your table time into real, measurable improvement.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00085921:ios.description:
캐시닥에서 병원찾기 & 병원예약 1초만에 해결!
병원 어디로 갈지 고민이라면? 궁금한 시술이 있다면?
1:1 맞춤 상담으로 안과, 치과, 피부과, 성형외과, 다이어트 시술을 최저가로 받으세요!
다양한 혜택을 통해 병원 정보와 포인트를 동시에 버는 신개념 병원찾기 앱!
■ 병원찾기 - 내 근처 병원정보 확인!
- 평일, 주말, 야간, 공휴일 365일 연중무휴 24시간 예약 가능한 병원, 약국을 찾아보세요.
- 병원후기, 약국, 닥터 후기 확인하고 똑똑하게 병원예약 하세요.
- 전국의 치과, 안과, 한의원, 피부과, 성형 외과, 산부인과, 비뇨기과, 정형외과, 내과, 소아과, 이비인후과, 정신의학과 등 실방문자 인증 병원후기 확인해보세요.
■ 병원 이벤트 - 시술 전국 최저가 혜택!
- 나에게 맞는 시술 궁금하다면, 채팅을 통해 전문가에게 24시간 시술 상담을 받을 수 있어요.
- 백내장, 임플란트, 보톡스, 필러, 인모드, 다이어트 한약, 쌍수, 지방흡입 등 비급여 시술 전국 최저가 가격을 비교해보세요.
- 병원예약 후 병원후기 남기면 기프티콘을 구매할 수 있는 포인트를 적립해드려요.
■ 진료 내역조회 & 실비보험 청구!
- 복잡한 절차 없이 건강검진, 진료 내역을 한 곳에서 편하게 관리해요.
- 터치 한번이면 병원 실비보험, 진료비 청구가 완료돼요.
- 지금까지 받은 진료 내역 & 건강검진 내역을 한번에 확인하고 리워드를 받아요.
■ 커뮤니티 - 전문가 시술 칼럼 보유!
- 커뮤니티에서 시술, 성형 수술 꿀팁, 솔직한 병원후기, 병원정보, 건강 정보 얻고 소통 해보세요.
- 30만 건강 챌린지 유저와 함께 좋은 습관을 만들어나가요.
- 병원 리뷰 이벤트와 만보기 챌린지에 참여하면 100% 포인트 받아요.
■ 포인트 혜택
- 걷기만 해도 포인트가 쌓이는 만보기 행운이벤트에 매일 응모해보세요.
- 용돈퀴즈, 용돈라방 보고 병원 퀴즈를 풀어보세요.
- 행운룰렛, 출석체크, 친구초대, 커뮤니티, 포인트 충전소를 통해 매일 포인트를 받으세요.
- 병원예약, 병원후기 등 병원 혜택을 이용하면 포인트를 받아요.
- 적립된 포인트로 커피, 편의점 등 기프티콘 쇼핑까지 한 번에 경험해보세요.
*선택적 접근권한
사진/미디어/파일 : 실비보험 청구, 병원후기, 인증샷 촬영 시 사진 첨부
위치정보 : 현 위치 기반 주변 병원예약 / 병원검색 / 약국 / 병원찾기
신체 활동 : 만보기 걸음 수 확인
선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 서비스를 이용할 수 있으며, 휴대폰 설정에서 언제든 변경가능합니다.

bluejetty:00025597:ios.name: Necrometer
bluejetty:00025597:ios.summary:
Necrometer
Designed for ghost hunters and paranormal enthusiasts. This multifunctional app can be used to detect and communicate with spirits. We have taken known spirit communication techniques and theories and have implemented them here
bluejetty:00025597:ios.description:
Necrometer
Designed for ghost hunters and paranormal enthusiasts. This multifunctional app can be used to detect and communicate with spirits. We have taken known spirit communication techniques and theories and have implemented them here in new and innovative ways. 
-Meter that detects and measures magnetic energy
-Text and Speech modes
-2 Built in Text To Speech A.I. systems
-3 Voices
-Pitch control with randomization option
-Reverb and Echo audio effects
The Meter:
It is believed that spirits can affect magnetic energy fields. Using your phone’s Magnetometer sensor this app can detect levels of magnetic interference in the environment. These fluctuations of energy fields have a direct influence on the communication.
-Meter noise (optional) reacts to fluctuations in the meter
Text Mode:
Simply slide the power button over to "Text" and begin asking your questions. Walking around a location you can detect energy anomalies and various levels of magnetic interference. Words and phrases will begin coming through the app. The relevance of the communication is determined by multiple factors including spirit connection and strength. Those who have a stronger connection to the otherside may experience more direct and relevant communication. 
Similar to the famous Ovilus ITC device, the Necrometer app is designed to facilitate spirit communication by measuring fluctuations of energy in the environment. The idea that spirits can manipulate electronic devices for purposes of communication is well documented. Based on the theory of random selection and known evidence of energy manipulation, the Necrometer app utilizes these known methods of spirit communication and paranormal phenomena. 
-Access to over 60k words/phrases
-Custom word list, Add your own words and phrases
Speech Mode:
Sliding the power button over to "Speech" will turn on this unique mode of the app. Created to facilitate ghost box/ EVP like communication, the speech mode of the app provides audible spirit communication like no other. Generating speech sounds from within the app, there are no sound banks, word lists, radio, or any other pre-recorded audio. Spirits can use and manipulate these random speech sounds to form coherent messages, an idea rooted in ITC/EVP theory. Some of these messages may be heard in real time similar to a ghost box, other EVP-like communication can be heard on playback of the recorded audio. Again, the strength and level of communication being recieved depends on various factors. Coherent messages can only be obtained through communication with spirit, otherwise only unclear speech sounds will be heard.
-Rate slider to increase/decrease rate of audio coming through
The Necrometer app is an advanced all-in-one app that can be used to detect energy anomalies in the area, produce words and phrases that can provide relevant clues/information, and provide audible ITC/EVP communication from spirit.

bluejetty:00071282:ios.summary: Typing without limits on iPad and iPhone. When it comes to on-screen keyboards, bigger IS different, and Typefinity is built to take advantage of the larger screen size on tablets and modern phones. Stay in the flow when it's time to type a
bluejetty:00071282:ios.description:
Typing without limits on iPad and iPhone. When it comes to on-screen keyboards, bigger IS different, and Typefinity is built to take advantage of the larger screen size on tablets and modern phones. Stay in the flow when it's time to type a number or symbol or you need to move around, because the needed keys are right there in the main layout. And we use the full width, not just the middle, to display word suggestions.
Ergonomics aren't sacrificed either. The main keys are big enough to type fast, and autocorrect is fine-tuned for catching common finger misses. You'll find using Typefinity is almost like having a full bluetooth keyboard, without the weight and bulk!
How it works:
- Step 1: Install Typefinity and open the app.
- Step 2: In Settings, open General, Keyboard, Keyboards and add Typefinity.
- Step 3: Tap the globe key in any app to switch to Typefinity.
- Step 4: Type fast with big keys, and numbers, punctuation and symbols always in view.
- Step 5: Swipe to trace words, and use the cursor keys to move by letter or word.
What you get:
- Numbers and punctuation in one layout, where your fingers remember.
- Cursor keys for easy, precise movement by letter or word.
- Dedicated keys for accented characters in your language.
- Option switch for typing other symbols and accented characters.
- Full autocorrect in all supported languages, showing more than three words.
- "Short" layout option for more screen visibility in landscape orientation.
- Swipe input (trace words with your finger), and flick up on number and punctuation keys for shifted versions.
- Numeric and calculator modes.
- Multilanguage support: English, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish.
Get full access to Typefinity:
- Enjoy many themes, dark mode & transparency options.
- Use premium custom key sounds & feedback.
- Get fine-tuning for autocorrect & punctuation.
Subscribe to access premium app features; subscription details:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal turned off, in Account Settings after purchase.
- Available plans: weekly or yearly.

bluejetty:00128401:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00128401:ios.description:
You know the moment. It's 6pm, you're starving, and nothing that sounds good fits your macros.
So you make the same sad chicken and rice for the fourth time this week. Or you order the pizza and feel bad about it after.
That's the whole reason this app exists.
I'm Zach. I've spent 12 years turning the food people actually crave (pizza, burgers, tacos, cheesecake, orange chicken ramen, and more) into versions with more protein and fewer calories. Not "healthy" versions. Good ones. The kind you make again because you want to, not because you're supposed to.
Open the app, type in whatever's in your fridge, and you get real meals with the macros already figured out. No tracking. No math. No standing there deciding.
WHAT'S INSIDE
- 823+ macro-friendly recipes, new ones added every week
- Full macros and calories on every single recipe
- Step-by-step video for each one, so it comes out right the first try
- Search by ingredient, filter by calories, protein, or equipment
- Meal planner and a grocery list that builds itself
- Favorites, folders, and your own private notes on recipes you tweak
- Mark what you've made and build your own rotation
You don't have to cook separate meals for everyone else either. One dinner, the family's happy, and yours still fits.
WHAT IT COSTS
Free to download and look around. Full access is $19/month or $149/year, billed through your Apple account and cancelable anytime in Settings.
Terms of use: https://recipes.macrofriendly.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://recipes.macrofriendly.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00141381:ios.summary: M1FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empoweri
bluejetty:00141381:ios.description:
M1FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with M1FCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the M1FCU app, you must be enrolled as a Modesto's First Credit Union digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00026521:ios.summary: Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful Champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Ri
bluejetty:00026521:ios.description:
Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful Champions, and crush enemy bases. Unlock collectible cards, conquer exciting modes, and climb the Champions League. Rise to tower defense supremacy!
Unleash Your Inner Commander in Mob Control: The Ultimate Tower Defense Clash!
Defend, Conquer, and Rise to Victory in this Epic Tower Defense Showdown!
Ready to become the ultimate tower defense champion? Test your skills, wit, and tactical prowess!
ODDLY SATISFYING GAMEPLAY: CREATE, GROW, AND LEAD!
- Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions!
- Strategically deploy your mighty Champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo for victory!
- Explore intriguing level elements like speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and more.
BECOME AN IMMORTAL PLAYER: RISE THROUGH THE RANKS!
Earn Championship Stars by winning battles, fortifying your bases, and dominating tournaments. Climb the prestigious Champions League using your Championship Stars and join the elite few who have conquered this tower defense realm.
FORTIFY YOUR BASE: SHIELD YOUR DOMINION!
Secure your base from enemy raids by winning battles and earning valuable shields. Protect your resources and maintain your tower defense dominance.
UNLOCK AND UPGRADE CARDS: COLLECT, EVOLVE, AND DOMINATE!
Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Unlock all the Cannons, Mobs and Champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up.
DIVERSE GAME MODES: CHALLENGE AND CONQUER!
- Base Invasion: Raid enemy strongholds, pilfer coins, and claim bricks from rival players.
- Revenge and Counter-Attack: Turn the tables on attackers and seek retribution against those who challenge your might.
- Boss Levels: Test your mettle in unique level layouts, earning extra bonuses as you conquer the toughest adversaries.
SEASON PASS: A CONSTANT STREAM OF FRESH CONTENT!
Dive into ever-evolving content with our monthly Season Pass. Complete quests, advance tiers, and unlock new heroes, Cannons and skins.
ALWAYS IMPROVING: JOIN THE EVOLUTION!
Our dedicated team delivers fresh mechanics and content every month. Share your ideas via Settings > Discord and contribute to the evolution of Mob Control.
A PREMIUM EXPERIENCE: YOUR CHOICE TO PLAY AD-FREE!
Mob Control is free to download and utilizes ads to support ongoing development. Opt for the Premium Pass or a permanent no-ads package to enjoy uninterrupted tower defense action. Skip'Its speed up your progress and give you extra rewards without watching ads.
Join the tower defense clash! Rally your army, collect powerful cards, and become the champion you were born to be.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly subscriptions.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription.
Support: Your Satisfaction Matters! Connect with us in-game via Settings > Help and Support whenever you need assistance.
Your privacy is crucial to us. Review our comprehensive privacy policy at https://www.voodoo.io/privacy

bluejetty:00094534:ios.description:
Stream award-winning movies and TV series, including feature films, remastered Australian classics, cult favourites, Indigenous cinema, niche films and documentaries from Australia and around the world.
Watch acclaimed movies, rediscover iconic Australian classics and explore hidden gems you may not find on mainstream streaming services. From cult cinema and independent films to documentaries, genre favourites and memorable TV, Brollie brings together a curated collection for people who love discovering new movies and television series.
STREAM MOVIES & TV
Find something worth watching with a growing collection of movies and TV shows available to stream on demand including titles like Number 96, Crash Zone and Frank Herbert’s Dune.
• Stream award-winning movies and TV shows
• Explore Australian films and international cinema
• Discover cult movies, classic films and independent cinema
• Watch documentaries and compelling real stories
• Find new and noteworthy releases with new HD content added weekly
DISCOVER AUSTRALIAN CINEMA
Explore Australian movies and TV from across decades of local screen history. Brollie celebrates Australian storytelling with remastered Australian classics, acclaimed films, genre cinema and memorable productions from celebrated Australian filmmakers and performers, including director Bruce Beresford and actor Jack Thompson.
Rediscover classic Australian movies restored and remastered for a new generation, alongside independent cinema, noteworthy releases and hidden gems, Brollie includes Innocent Prey, Day of the Panther, and the perfectionist.
CULT, CLASSIC & GENRE FILMS
Go beyond the usual recommendations with a collection of cult classics, niche cult films, genre movies and hard-to-find favourites.
• Cult cinema and classic movies like: Body Melt & Bad Boy Bubby
• Remastered classic films like Wake in Fright
• Horror movies and thrillers: Crosstalk & Body melt
• Comedy and dramas like Malcolm & Showgirls
• Independent and genre films
• Overlooked movies with devoted followings
DOCUMENTARIES & REAL STORIES
