bluejetty:00137089:ios.description:
Librarius - це перший у світі український застосунок для читання електронних книжок у смартфоні як он-лайн, так і за відсутності підключення до інтернету. Ми стартували 12 квітня на День Космонавтики і ви вже можете орендувати та купувати сучасні книжки, а також читати ще тисячі безкоштовно! А скоро буде доступна функція прослуховування аудіокниг і підписна модель.
Новинки та бестселери, світова класика та дитячі книги, мотиваційна література, художня література та популярний нон-фікш – все це в одному мобільному застосунку. Користуйтесь цифровою бібліотекою, яка завжди під рукою. Читайте в будь-якому місці і в будь – який час.
Функції та можливості:
— Читайте завжди і всюди. З Librarius ваші улюблені книги будуть постійно з вами як онлайн так і без доступу до мережі інтернет.
—Миттєва реєстрація та авторизація в додатку Librarius за допомогою облікового запису Facebook або Google.
—Продаж та оренда електронних книг. Ви маєте можливість придбати електронні книги або орендувати їх за зменшеною ціною на термін 14 днів. Придбанні книги залишаються доступними на постійній основі в вашому особистому кабінеті. Доступ до орендованих книг анулюється після закінчення терміну дії оплаченої оренди.
— Cтворюйте свій особистий список бажаних книг. Обрані книги ви зможете переглянути в розділі «Моя бібліотека» за умови авторизації в особистому кабінеті.
— Зручний пошук. Ви частково пам’ятаєте назву книги або прізвища автора? Чи може ви просто хочете переглянути весь асортимент улюбленого видавництва або шукаєте щось «до душі» в улюбленому жанрі. Наш пошук допоможе знайти необхідну книгу навіть за цією інформацією. Користуйтесь можливостями нашого пошуку і ви обов’язкове знайдете, що почитати сьогодні.
— Можливість поділитись посиланням на книгу в соціальних мережах та месенджерах.
Як обрати книгу?
— 10 % будь-якої електронної книги доступні для безкоштовного перегляду. Перед тим, як купити чи орендувати книгу ви маєте можливість ознайомитись зі змістом книги та стилем автора.
— Більшість книг мають рейтинг книжкового інтернет-порталу Goodreads, який налічує багатомільйонну аудиторію користувачів.
— За допомогою фільтрів ви маєте можливість обрати доступні книги для покупки, оренди або для безкоштовного читання.
Читати електронні книги зручно!
— Додавайте потрібні сторінки в закладки і ви завжди зможете перечитати цікаві уривки книги
— Виділяйте цитати кольоровими маркерами.
— Змінюйте розмір і тип шрифту, вибирайте денний або нічний режим читання.
— Знаходьте необхідну інформацію за допомогою функції внутрішнього пошуку в тексті.
Отримайте можливість читати ліцензійні книги відомих українських видавництв в одному мобільному додатку. Наш каталог постійно поповнюється новинками та унікальними електронними виданнями. Також ви маєте можливість отримати доступ до великої кількості літературних творів, що знаходяться в суспільному надбанні та не охороняються законом про авторське право і є абсолютно безкоштовними для читання в нашому додатку.
Якщо у вас виникли технічні питання, зауваження або пропозиції щодо роботи мобільного застосунку Librarius напишіть нам на електронну адресу info@librarius.pro

bluejetty:00029836:ios.summary:

Plus, download and read the digital editions of Mot
bluejetty:00029836:ios.description:
Keep up-to-date with the latest motorsport news, opinion and in-depth coverage – including Formula 1, Sports Cars, Road Cars, Le Mans, MotoGP, rallying, historical features and much more.
Plus, download and read the digital editions of Motor Sport magazine. Once downloaded they're available to read offline, on all devices – perfect for travelling or the daily commute. Each issue is packed with exclusive interviews, industry insights and uncensored commentary from some of the best motor racing writers in the world.
◆ KEY FEATURES
- Clean, easy to use design.
- Daily news, insight and analysis - all in one place.
- Download the interactive monthly magazine.
- Special editions.
- Podcast with racing's key characters.
◆ ABOUT US
Motor Sport is the world’s leading independent voice of motor racing. Building on a history, since 1924,covering all aspects of the sport in print, Motor Sport now projects its distinctive voice across all its digital channels sustaining and engaging a growing community of racing fans across the world.
The famous British Racing Green masthead still adorns the magazine, but it has evolved from a text heavy news publication which brought race results from the UK and abroad to eager fans during racing’s golden era in the 1950s and 1960s, into today’s premium magazine focussing on intelligent long-form features, expert analysis and beautiful photography. It covers the modern and historic Formula 1 and Sports Car racing, Le Mans, MotoGP, Road Cars and the growing historic racing scene.
Through its website Motor Sport offers breaking news and informed commentary of the key themes that affect motor racing across all digital platforms sparking conversations and debate among a new generation of readers. Its famous, in-depth podcasts look behind the headlines of contemporary racing and shed new light on developments from a measured and mature perspective.
In everything it does, Motor Sport cuts out the chaff of the overcrowded modern racing market to guide readers to the stories, events and products that matter. What we offer is what matters: the best, most prominent and most significant stories and trends in the motoring world while always keeping one eye on the past.
Motor Sport privacy policy and terms of use: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/terms/

bluejetty:00080704:ios.summary: PREPARE TO BE ENGROSSED IN A THRILLING NARRATIVE of suspense and shadow, where your decisions shape the story. "City Legends: The Witness in the Rye" offers a compelling blend of finding object games and detective challenges, perfect for fa
bluejetty:00080704:ios.description:
PREPARE TO BE ENGROSSED IN A THRILLING NARRATIVE of suspense and shadow, where your decisions shape the story. "City Legends: The Witness in the Rye" offers a compelling blend of finding object games and detective challenges, perfect for fans of mystery and adventure. Join the adventure, solve the crime, and unveil the truth hidden within the misty fields of Darkwood!
CHALLENGE YOURSELF with a myriad of brain teasers and puzzles scattered throughout Darkwood. Test your detective skills with a wide array of brain teasers and puzzles. From tricky riddles to intricate challenges, prove your prowess!
The autumn breeze brings you to the sunless city of Darkwood, where you intend to find some inspiration and finish your new horror book in peace. You hear many tourists have come to these parts, fascinated by talk of the miraculous properties of local crops, although few people hear of their return afterward... Nevertheless, the gray of the sky and the red rye fields are bewitching! One can say, they have become something of a muse for the not-so-hospitable locals. So beware. The harvest festival is approaching and I'm afraid by that time you won't be able to leave the city.
EXPERIENCE EXCITING FEATURES:
MYSTERY HIDDEN OBJECT GAMES: Step into the crime city of Darkwood, where the ominous autumn breeze and bewitching red rye fields set the stage for a murder mystery that only you can solve. Delve into a world of finding object games where every hidden clue brings you closer to the truth!
ENGAGE IN CRIMINAL CASE: Join the thrill of detective games as you navigate through the shadows of this sinister city. Use your skills to solve criminal case and unravel the mystery hidden within the eerie occurrences of the harvest festival. 
OBJECT HUNT IN A CRIME CITY: As the harvest festival approaches, your object hunt becomes a race against time to prevent another disappearance. In this murder mystery game, search through detailed scenes and find hidden objects that are key to solving the criminal case and discovering the fate of the missing tourists!
PUZZLES AND BRAIN TEASERS: Face a series of mind-bending puzzles and tricky brain teasers that are integral to your success in these mystery detective games!
COMPLETELY FREE TO PLAY: Immerse yourself in the mysteries and adventures of Darkwood without spending a dime. "City Legends" is accessible to all, offering a full detective experience at no cost!
Will you escape, or will Darkwood claim you as another victim of its harvest? Download the game for free and find out!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Master BC's road rules, signs, symbols, penalty system, and driving essentials with over 70 interactive lessons, quizzes, and exams.

Struggling with the meanings of road signs and symbols? Our app offers an extensive, content-rich flashcard system, designed to familiarize you with every traffic sign and symbol. Begin with a standard flashcard session, then concentrate on signs requiring more practice, as indicated by your previous performance.
70 LESSONS, 400+ QUESTIONS, 10+ TESTS
Access an abundance of practice material to ace the test. Study systematically through each chapter and tackle over 400 questions at the end of lessons. Receive immediate feedback on both correct and incorrect responses.
LISTEN TO THE LESSONS
Benefit from our audio-enabled lessons, allowing you to follow each section word by word, enhancing focus and comprehension.
TRACK TEST & STUDY PROGRESS
Monitor your advancement through chapters and lessons, observe test scores, and check the average time spent. Resume your study seamlessly with the 'Continue Studying' shortcut.
FULL OFFLINE MODE
Study anywhere, anytime! Our app works flawlessly offline, giving you full access to lessons, quizzes, and tests without needing an internet connection.

→ Instant feedback on all answers

→ Dark mode with automatic switching

Test your timing and reflexes in a fast, satisfying game of risk and precision. In Shoot & Hide, every move is a choice — step out, take your shot, then hide before danger hits.

Step out of cover to attack — but stay too long and you’re done.

Each moment matters.

SATISFYING SHOTS & IMPACT
Land precise hits with clear, rewarding feedback.
Explosions, reactions, and clean visuals make every successful move feel great.
SIMPLE CONTROLS, SKILL-BASED GAMEPLAY
Easy to pick up, but challenging to master.
The better your timing and decision-making, the further you go.
UNLOCK & UPGRADE
Progress through levels to unlock new weapons, gear, and characters.
Improve your setup and handle tougher challenges with better tools.
INCREASING CHALLENGE
Face smarter enemies and tighter timing windows.
Each level pushes your reflexes and decision-making further.
FEATURES
Unique shoot-and-hide gameplay
Timing-based action and reflex challenges
Simple tap controls
Weapon and gear upgrades
Character customization
Short, engaging levels
Play anytime, anywhere
WHY PLAY SHOOT & HIDE
If you enjoy reflex games, timing games, and hyper-casual challenges, Shoot & Hide delivers a simple but tense experience where every move matters.
Step out. Take the shot. Get back to cover.

bluejetty:00168183:ios.description:
A+AI uses AI to give you fast and highly accurate answer to your questions. Triple-digit multiplication? A+AI’s got it. Linear and quadratic inequalities? No problem!
Key features of the app:
- Extensive Math Problem Solving: From elementary arithmetic to advanced calculus and everything in between, including word problems. Whether handwritten, in a textbook, or on a screen, A+AI is here to help you with all your questions.
- Step-by-Step Explanations: A+AI breaks down answer in multiple steps for a comprehensive learning experience.
- Fast and Accurate: A+AI provides faster and more accurate solutions within seconds, accompanied by detailed explanations for quick and effective learning.
- Multiple Subjects: Not limited to Math, A+AI can solve problems in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and for all grade levels.
- User-Friendly: Simply take a photo of your problem and receive instant answers.

- Math Word Problems
- Elementary: arithmetic, real, complex numbers, LCM, GCD, factors, and percentages
- Pre-Algebra: radicals and exponents, fractions, matrices, determinants
- Algebra: quadratic equations, system of equations, inequalities, rational expressions, linear, polynomial and exponential graphs, real numbers, set theory, expressions, logarithms, complex numbers
- Trigonometry: trigonometric ratios, law of sines, law of cosines, reciprocal properties
- Geometry: plane & solid geometry, algebra & lines, lines & planes in space, transformations
- Matrix: matrix algebra, system of linear equations & matrices
- Calculus: summations, limits, derivatives, integrals
- Statistics and Data Analysis: mean, median, mode, standard deviation, permutations, combinations, probablity, data representation, poisson / normal distribution
- Logic: reasoning & proof
Try A+AI for all your homework needs and transform your learning experience today!

bluejetty:00063459:ios.description:
The app to make the most of your stay... and now also your rewards! 
Organize, book and live every moment of your vacation with the Palladium Hotel Group app. 
And now you can take the whole Palladium Rewards experience with you: check your points, benefits and promotions directly from your cell phone. 
From your couch at home to your arrival at the hotel, the app accompanies you so that everything flows seamlessly: 
access your reservation, explore interactive hotel maps and destination guides, make room requests, book restaurants, check activities, chat with staff... and much more! 
Are you a Palladium Rewards member? Now you can: 
• View your membership level and number 
• View your points and their expiration date 
• View all your Rewards points movements 
• Access exclusive promotions and rewards 
• Transfer points 
• Invite friends and earn more 
Also, if you are not a Palladium Rewards member, you can now sign up from the app and start enjoying all its benefits. 
Main functions of the App: 
• Consult and manage your reservation 
• Personalize your experience 
• Make reservations at restaurants and bars 
• View the entertainment and activities calendar 
• Chat with hotel staff 
• Order room service or book your day at the spa 
• Access destination maps and guides 
• View corporate information 
• And now... manage your entire Palladium Rewards account! 
Hotels in paradise and urban destinations 
Palladium Hotel Group has a wide variety of exclusive hotels in urban and paradise destinations in Mexico, Jamaica, Brazil, Dominican Republic, Spain and Italy. You just have to decide what kind of vacation you want, our luxury hotels are the best setting for all kinds of adventures: 
Grand Palladium Hotels & Resorts: All the 5-star luxury for the family in paradisiacal destinations. 
TRS Hotels: Our most exclusive 5-star adults only hotels located in the most exotic destinations. 
Palladium Hotels: 4 star hotels overlooking the Mediterranean. 
Hard Rock Hotels: Hotels with an iconic and exclusive design in Ibiza, Marbella and Tenerife. 
BLESS Collection Hotels: Hotels located in the best urban and beach destinations where luxury and vanguard live. 
Ushuaïa Beach Hotels and The Unexpected Hotels: An unparalleled adults only experience, with the best music and leisure offer. 
Only YOU: Hotels located in urban destinations for you to enjoy your favorite cities in a different way. 
Fiesta Hotels & Resorts: Family hotel located in the most elegant area of Santo Domingo. 
Download the app, select your next destination and experience a unique vacation. 
Your vacation, and your rewards, in the palm of your hand.

bluejetty:00026307:ios.name: Live Traffic NSW
bluejetty:00026307:ios.summary:
Live Traffic NSW provides you with real-time information about unplanned and planned incidents that affect your trips in NSW and across borders into QLD, SA, VIC and ACT.
Features include:
- Incident information for Sydney and Regional
bluejetty:00026307:ios.description:
Live Traffic NSW provides you with real-time information about unplanned and planned incidents that affect your trips in NSW and across borders into QLD, SA, VIC and ACT.
Features include:
- Incident information for Sydney and Regional NSW including crashes, breakdowns, fires, floods, snow, public events and roadworks.
- Strategically located traffic camera images updated every 60 seconds, which you can save for quick access.
- Receive notifications about incidents affecting your saved trips
- Save areas of interest and receive notifications about incidents affecting your saved areas. 
- Follow incidents and receive notifications when the incident impact changes or ends. 
- Cross-border incident information from QLD, SA, VIC and ACT.
- Location of fires from NSW Rural Fire Service.
- Local road information in Northern NSW (supplied by myroadinfo.com.au). 
Live Traffic NSW aims to help motorists make the best possible travel decisions that will, in turn, contribute to the safe and efficient management of our roads.
Live Traffic NSW is owned and operated by the Transport Management Centre (TMC) which monitors and manages the 18,000km NSW State road network 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The TMC uses advanced monitoring, communication and traffic management systems to respond to and clear traffic incidents as quickly as possible, improve consistency of journey times, and provide customers with quality up-to-date information.
This app also uses data from interstate road agencies (QLD, SA, VIC and ACT), NSW Rural Fire Service, and Northern NSW local roads (myroadinfo.com.au). 
We're committed to ensuring that Live Traffic NSW meets the needs of road users in NSW, and your feedback is essential. If you have any ideas, suggestions for improvement or questions about the app, please contact us by using the feedback form within the app.

bluejetty:00186317:ios.description:
Piano Marvel is trusted by thousands of pianists, studios, schools, and universities around the world. Piano Marvel aids in individual learning and helps facilitate a classroom learning environment. Whether you are studying with a teacher or want to learn piano on your own, Piano Marvel will help you learn how to read sheet music and play your favorite piano songs.
- learn from over 30,000 piano songs covering 18 levels from beginner to pro and almost 1,200 guided piano lessons teaching you how to read and play the piano more musically
- Improve your sight-reading with the SASR piano sight-reading tests and sight-reading exercises!
- Learn to practice piano efficiently with our step-by-step learning paths that teach you to read music and play piano with confidence.
- Learn dynamics, phrasing, expression, articulation, and music theory with hundreds of lessons videos found in the piano Method and piano Technique lessons.
- Upload any song you want to learn and create your own custom piano learning path
- Participate in regular challenges for a chance to compete with other pianists around the world, win prizes, and improve your note reading
- Instant feedback and assessment on everything you play with a MIDI keyboard or, use the new microphone assessment to learn on your acoustic piano. 
- Beginner piano, Intermediate and advanced piano music
- piano lessons are easy to follow and teach piano concepts in a fun and effective way!
Piano Marvel has hundreds of popular songs including: 
- “Bang” by AJR
- “Perfect” by Ed Sheeran
- “We Don’t Talk About Bruno” from Encanto
- “Lean On Me” by Bill Withers
- “Let It Be” by the Beatles
- “Piano Man” by Billy Joel
- “Linus and Lucy” by Vince Guaraldi
Love Classical music? Find thousands of classical pieces in our massive catalog from composers like: Mozart, Bach, Beethoven, Chopin, Scarlatti, Haydn, Brahms, Liszt, Debussy, Ravel, Scott Joplin, and more! 
The sheet music library includes copywritten songs published by Hal Leonard, Alfred Music, FJH Music, BachSchloar, and more.
A Premium Account provides access to additional piano courses for learning scales, arpeggios, chords, note recognition, flashcards, boot camps, sight-reading, ear training, harmonization, musicality, and much more! Additional lessons and music are added to our music library daily! Free accounts gain access to Piano Marvel Premium** for their trial period and then get downgraded to a free account with limited access to Method and Technique lessons, SASR tests, and library songs.
PIANO MARVEL PREMIUM ACCOUNT SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription auto-renews until canceled by the user
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription
- You may view our Privacy Policy at https://pianomarvel.com/privacy-policy
- You may view our Terms of Service at https://www.pianomarvel.com/terms-of-service
** Music protected by copyright will not be made available during the free trial period. Upgrade for access.

bluejetty:00013651:ios.description:
Find on-site IT work that matches your skills. Tackle jobs with an iOS app designed for technicians. Get paid without the hassle of invoices. Leave the administrative work to us.
Find work that fits your experience with the all-in-one solution for connecting businesses with skilled IT technicians like you. With 20,000+ work orders each week across the US and Canada, Field Nation gives you the flexibility to work anytime, anywhere. 
The Field Nation mobile app was designed with technicians in mind. You can share updates in real-time, upload photos, message clients, scan packages, collect signatures, track payments, and much more.
To get started, highlight your skills on our marketplace by creating a profile that shows off your qualifications, skillsets, work history, and equipment. Then, quickly search for the types of jobs that best fit your experience, pay rate requirements, and location. Finally, request the work assignments you want.
Why do thousands of technicians love Field Nation?
* Get paid without the hassle of invoices: Technicians receive payment for the final work order after approval, less a 10% fee. Get paid weekly via direct deposit or PayPal, or get paid right away for an additional fee. You choose what works best for you, and we make it happen.
* Leave the administrative work to us: No more invoicing, project management, or tax paperwork headaches. Receive one 1099 tax document directly from Field Nation each year.
* Get support from our team of experts 24/7/365: We know problems don’t always happen between 9 am and 5 pm. That’s why our support team is available around-the-clock. Submit a ticket online or speak to a live person over-the-phone. 97% of customer service tickets are resolved within 2 hours.
Most common types of work available on Field Nation: Networking, point of sale, telecom/VOIP, desktop/laptop, low-voltage cabling, audio visual (AV), alarm & security, kiosk, printer, server, ATM, and electrical.
Who should download this app: Anyone living in the US or Canada with IT skills who’s interested in completing on-site work.

bluejetty:00188131:ios.summary: Designed specifically for men, Touchstones explores masculinity through informative, inspirational meditations and offers profound advice for life’s many changes. While the daily readings help with recovery, they also help men create a bett
bluejetty:00188131:ios.description:
Designed specifically for men, Touchstones explores masculinity through informative, inspirational meditations and offers profound advice for life’s many changes. While the daily readings help with recovery, they also help men create a better, more balanced life.
Continued awareness and involvement with the ideas in this app provide ongoing personal growth. Although this growth is entirely our own, its benefits are shared and spread to every relationship--friends and family alike. Here, every struggle meets an insight. And in this app, the cycle of addiction can meet its end.
In addition to a meditation for each day of the year, Touchstones includes lists of the Twelve Steps and the Twelve Traditions. Whether you participate in Alcoholics Anonymous, Narcotics Anonymous, or another self-help program, Touchstones can serve as a reliable companion on any recovering man’s journey.
Features:
PRESS the “Today” button to access today’s reading.
SWIPE forward or back to easily access more daily readings.
SHARE the daily reading with friends by e-mail or text.
BOOKMARK your favorite meditations (press the star in the upper right-hand corner) and easily return to them (press the star in the bottom toolbar).
SEARCH all 366 daily readings.
RECEIVE a notification every day to remind you to read the daily meditation.
JUMP to a specific reading using the calendar button.
SET your font size using your device settings.
CHOOSE between light or dark mode.

VIDEO CALL A VET TO GET EXPERT ADVICE.

bluejetty:00085217:ios.description:
VIDEO CALL A VET TO GET EXPERT ADVICE. 
For those middle-of-the night emergencies, and everything else, FirstVet helps you navigate the best possible care for your pet. Our service provides expert advice for situations when you're not sure what to do. Should I go to the emergency clinic? Should I monitor my pet's symptoms and then make a decision?
From the convenience of your own home, a vet can help determine the next best step with regards to your pet’s symptoms and whether they require a trip to an emergency clinic visit, a non-emergent visit, or whether the symptoms can be triaged at home.
Maybe you’re wondering why your cat has suddenly lost his or her appetite? Whether your dog's vomiting or diarrhea requires immediate treatment? With us, help is on the way when and where you need it.
ADD YOUR PET AND CONSULT A LICENSED VET
By downloading the app and adding your pet's details in advance, you can quickly get expert help when you need it the most. Signing up is completely free and takes less than a minute.
WHAT WE CAN HELP YOU WITH
All of our vets are and have 5+ years of experience. Here are some examples of what our vets can help your pet with:
- Vomiting and diarrhea
- Eye and ear problems
- Ingestion of potentially toxic chemicals
- Itching and skin problems
- Coughing and sneezing
- Ticks for dogs and cats
- Injuries and accidents
- Behavioral problems
- Dental care
- Rehabilitation and wellness
- Healthcare advice for horses

bluejetty:00180040:ios.description:

Features
* Record bowling score or bowling pin location 
* Retrieve score or bowling pin location 
* Show statistic of the score, strike, bowling pin location
* Data comparison
* Export history record to CSV (Excel), PDF, xlsx files
* Support 2 bowlers
* Support English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Chinese
* One-time purchase, no subscription required
* No sign-up needed, all data is stored locally
Pro version Feature
* No subscription (One-time purchase)
* Editing scores, bowling pin locations in history
* NO limitation number of history records
* Score sheet printing
* Support leaderboard
Ultra version Feature
* No subscription (One-time purchase)
* Export history records to xlsx files
* Pin filter in statistics
* Support bowler's icon
* Support oil pattern
* Support handicap
* Support no-tap
* Support achievement
* No limitation of number of bowlers

bluejetty:00120379:ios.name: My Little Princess Stores Game
bluejetty:00120379:ios.summary: My Little Princess Stores is a storytelling digital dollhouse game where every game is a new adventure. Have fun pretend playing in the princess village stores. Get the latest fashion at the Clothing store, dressup, makeup and lots of cloth
bluejetty:00120379:ios.description:
My Little Princess Stores is a storytelling digital dollhouse game where every game is a new adventure. Have fun pretend playing in the princess village stores. Get the latest fashion at the Clothing store, dressup, makeup and lots of clothing. Find you new best friend and the local Pets store or simply visit the supermarket for some food and party items. There are lots more shops and locations for you to play and discover in Little Princess Stores.
Why Do Kids and Parents love our games?
My Little Princess games are a digital version of the classic dollhouse game. Our kids game has no rules or objectives, it is all about free play and pretending. This is what makes our games so exciting for kids. Everything a kid sees in the game is touchable or intractable. You can have a princess dress up party, apply girls makeup and customize every character. By connecting all of our games we are helping the kids to build a whole world around there own adventure.
Game Features:
- 10 NEW locations and stores to explore!
- Brand new characters to meet and play within both the My Little Princess games.
- BRAND NEW hot air balloon feature! Each of the My Little Princess games now have a hot air balloon “station,” where you place the characters inside and then touch the “liftoff” button. The game then opens up a map with an entirely different game to explore!
- Multi-touch support so you can play with friends together on the same tablet
- Use the hot Air balloon to travel between downloaded little princess games
Recommended Age Group
My Town : My Little Princess Stores is great for kids all ages between 4-12. Younger children can play with their parents, while older children can enjoy playing the game with their friends, or by themselves. All My Town games promote imaginative play, helping to develop creativity and empathy. Our games are used by autism and special needs therapists worldwide.
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00130343:ios.name: Arrived: Real Estate Investing
bluejetty:00130343:ios.summary: Investing in real estate has long offered wealth-building potential, but buying and managing property can create significant barriers. Arrived makes it easier to get started with professionally managed real estate investments starting at $1
bluejetty:00130343:ios.description:
Investing in real estate has long offered wealth-building potential, but buying and managing property can create significant barriers. Arrived makes it easier to get started with professionally managed real estate investments starting at $100.*
Backed by notable investors including Jeff Bezos and Marc Benioff, Arrived has grown to more than 992,000 registered investors, with over $458 million invested across 589+ properties nationwide. Sign up, choose your investments, and buy shares online in minutes. Arrived handles day-to-day operations while you access the potential for income and appreciation.
How Arrived works
- Browse individual properties and diversified funds, each reviewed by Arrived's investment team for its potential.
- Select the properties that fit your goals, and choose how much to invest, from $100 to $100,000 per property.*
- Buy shares in just a few clicks.
- Sit back while Arrived manages day-to-day operations, with the potential for rental income and appreciation over time.
Diversify your portfolio
Investing across multiple markets and property types, including single-family rental homes, vacation rentals, real estate credit, and equity funds, can help you build a more diversified real estate portfolio. With Arrived, you can tailor your investments to your own goals.
Access sought-after properties
Arrived's investment team selects properties for their potential to generate rental income and appreciation, giving investors access to homes that can be difficult to invest in individually.
Stress-free property management
Arrived handles the day-to-day work of property management, from maintenance to reporting, so you're not taking on the responsibilities of a landlord. You can track your investments while Arrived manages the operations.
Flexible investment amounts
Arrived lets you invest for as little as $100.* You can invest at your own pace, based on your budget and goals, without a large upfront commitment.
Professional expertise
Arrived's team evaluates real estate investment opportunities across the country and selects a small percentage of the properties it reviews for the platform. This selective approach is designed to identify offerings with return potential; all investments carry risk, and returns aren't guaranteed.
Support when you need it
Reach our support team in the app with questions or feedback, or email us anytime at support@arrived.com.
*Subject to availability and regulatory restrictions
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: Please review the "Important Information" section of our website at Arrived.com and our offering documents and most recent financial statements at https://arrived.com/circulars

bluejetty:00179038:ios.description:
WEATHERTRACK 
Amazing Weather Details at your Fingertips. Worldwide.
"An incredibly comprehensive weather app - it accesses many data models from different agencies and provides worldwide coverage. The GRIB layers include wind, precipitation, wave height/direction/period, ocean and tidal currents, air and sea temps, relative humidity and more. WeatherTrack works offline, and GRIB files can be downloaded through an SSB connection, an Iridium AxcessPoint or as an email attachment and opened in the app." (App of the month! in Cruisingworld)
http://goo.gl/PLzpI0 (at a glance)
Official partner in the AMERICA's CUP TEAM ARTEMIS (2013)
Forecasts for Professionals and Amateurs...
"Great Tool - I hardly use my SSB radio for weather information any more. Whenever I can pick up Internet via mobile phone, WeatherTrack is much simpler and provides everything that I want."
Everything you could ever want in one app:
+++ GRIB VIEWER FEATURES in DETAIL:
Select area of interest and get detailed GRIB data. View online/offline, point forecast or meteogram (graph).
Weather types (GRIB layers):
+ Wind (10 m above MSL)
+ Gusts
+ CAPE
+ Precipitation (rain/snow)
+ Dew point
+ Cloud Cover
+ Waves Height/Direction/Period
+ Ocean current (RTOFS)
+ Barometric Pressure,Highs (H)/Lows (L)
+ Air-/Sea Temperature, Temp. at 500 mb
+ Relative Humidity, Geopot.Height at 500 mb
Forecasts:
+ Worldwide Coverage
+ Forecasts up to 16 days (depending on data model)
+ Data models:GFS, COAMPS, NAVGEM; current: RTOFS; waves:WW3, WAM85, FNMOC-WW3/FNMOC-MED/FNMOC-EQAM
+ Resolution: 0.05°, 0.5°, 1°, 2°, 2.5° (dep.on data model)
+ Forecast interval: from 15 min up to 24hr (dep.on data model)
+ Updated every 6 hr (GFS)
Map:
+ Offline, high res vector map. Use it offshore or in the mountains.
+ Zoom in - to 0.001° (111 m /121 yd) - (for very high res GRIB files)
+ Customizable
+ Online map (satellite/hybrid/map view)
Specials:
+ Works easily with low bandwith
+ User friendly
+ Meteogram, dynamic, displays any layer
+ Open GRIB files from Email/Browser, 3rd party
+ Share (Twitter, Facebook, email)
+ City/Airport Search
+ Magnifier
+ In-app guide (offline)
+ Animation - watch & share
+ Import/export GRIB files to and from your PC
+ GRIB via Iridium access point
+++ ROUTE WEATHER
helps you plan your trip well (In-App purchase).
http://goo.gl/PXFCIj (at a glance)
+ Create your own route. Import/Export to and from other apps (e.g. Dropbox).
+ Edit waypoints: name, lat/long, duration to next waypoint, (estimated) speed, fuel
+ Select wind mode: true, relative, apparent
+ Route Meteogram
+ Share complete route files by email and open in apps (e.g. Dropbox).
+ Online map. Display route in satellite/hybrid/map view.

Makes the retrieval of GRIB files over satellite connections easy.
+++Tidetech (subscription**)
Worldwide hi res Ocean/tidal current

+ Fascinating view from space.
+ Worldwide clouds updated every 3 hours
+ Anywhere detailed Point Forecasts on your finger tip, not only for two million locations
+ World Clock, analog/digital
+++ WEATHER ONLINE

+ Satellite

+ Aviation weather (partly)

+ Snow precipitation
and more.

· Detailed vehicle descriptions and photos
· Two-way text messaging platform to communicate with car shoppers
· Sales Process management with Real-Time quoting tools
· Mapping of the test drive
· Fully Secured Credit application
· Digital Documentation

bluejetty:00180517:ios.summary: Thousands of self-guided walking tours and travel articles in 1,800+ cities around the world are included in this handy app. No need to hop on a tour bus or join a tour group; now you can explore all the city attractions on your own, at you
bluejetty:00180517:ios.description:
Thousands of self-guided walking tours and travel articles in 1,800+ cities around the world are included in this handy app. No need to hop on a tour bus or join a tour group; now you can explore all the city attractions on your own, at your own pace, and at a cost that is only a fraction of what you would normally pay for a guided tour.
The app is designed to be used offline so No Data Plan or Internet is Needed, and No Roaming either.
The app is free to download. Afterwards, you can evaluate the walking tours - see the attractions and use the fully functional offline maps included in each of the city walk guides, all for free. A small payment – fraction of what you would normally pay for a guided group tour or tour bus tickets – is needed for accessing the walk route maps and activating turn-by-turn navigation functions.
The highlights and features of the FREE app include:
* Thousands of self-guided walking tours that show you what to see in the destination.
* Thousands of travel articles make planning a trip really easy.
* Offline city maps.
* The "FindMe" feature displaying your exact location on the map.
After upgrade, you have access to the following advanced features:
* Walking tour maps.
* Voice guided turn-by-turn travel directions.
* Create your own walks to see the attractions you like.
* No advertisement.
This app supports subscription which allows you to access all the walking tours and articles in this app at one low price.
How The Annual Subscription Works:
* Option 1. For $14.99 you will get access to the full version functions in all the 670+ city walks guides (London, Rome, Paris, Tokyo, etc.) included in this app for one year. Travel articles are not included in this subscription.
* Option 2. For $14.99, you will get access to the full version functions in all the travel articles in 1,300+ cities worldwide (London, Rome, Paris, Tokyo, etc.) included in this app for one year. City walks guides are not included in this subscription.

bluejetty:00086720:ios.description:
Rent e-scooters with Whoosh, your best friend for fast rides around the city.
Whoosh helps you get where you want without getting stuck in traffic, and it's fun!
SCOOTER RIDES
It's easy to reserve scooters and get riding with our free mobile app
— super fast registration
— find the closest scooter on the map
— in the app, scan the QR code on the scooter to unlock it
— track your ride progress: total time, speed, rental zones and other important information
— end your ride in any parking area marked with a "P" on the map
— now the scooter is available for the next Whoosher
The app lets you reserve scooters for free and rent multiple scooters on one account to ride with friends.
The app helps you on every step. It's important for us that your scooter rides are safe and exciting, and that our service is easy to understand and perfect.
Just tap a scooter in the app to read more about the model.
OTHER COOL STUFF:
— speed up to 20 km/h
— bright headlight for night rides
— full battery charge lasts 30 km
— you don't need to charge scooters, we do that
— easy to ride for anyone over 18 years old
— GPS tracking and detailed ride statistics
— rent by the minute
— all scooter parking areas are marked on the map in the app
You can contact our Support team in the in-app chat around the clock. If you have any questions, message us!
Have fun!

bluejetty:00089418:ios.description:
NOTE: The Limber Health Home Exercise app is only accessible and available to eligible patients enrolled by their provider. 
When it comes to your recovery, the home exercise program prescribed by your provider is key to your success. Patients who complete their home exercise program are 9x’s more likely to have a successful recovery. At Limber Health, we make keeping up with your exercises easier than ever!
The Limber Health Home Exercise app provides the tools to extend your care outside of the clinic and into your home offering: 
FOLLOW ALONG VIDEO INSTRUCTION
On-screen demonstration and voice instruction helps you complete your prescribed home exercises with the proper form.
SESSION REMINDERS
Receive notifications to help you remember to complete your home exercise sessions.
PROGRESS TRACKING
Track your recovery progress with pain and function levels inside the app
AT-HOME SUPPORT
Have a question? If included in your program, you can chat with your remote Care Navigator right in the Limber app.
Getting Started with Your Limber Home Exercise Program is as easy as 1-2-3….
1. Download the app: Keep in mind that you won’t have access to log in until your provider enrolls you.
2. Complete Your Video Program: Through the app, you will receive guided instructional videos of the exercises prescribed by your provider. Simply press play and follow along!
3. Receive Support Every Step of the Way: If eligible, you will receive access to one-on-one virtual coaching from a Care Navigator, a licensed therapy professional, dedicated to providing: 
 - Virtual support in between visits
 - Motivation and reminders to help you stay on track with your program
 - Updates to your treating provider about your recovery outside of the clinic
About Limber Health
Developed by physical therapists and physicians, Limber Health is a better way to support your home exercise program, offering guided videos of prescribed physical therapy and occupational therapy home exercises and virtual coaching in-between in-clinic appointments. Limber helps extend care outside of the clinic to improve adherence to prescribed physical therapy home exercise programs and help improve patient outcomes. Limber’s dedicated Care Navigators, who are licensed therapy professionals, offer remote support and motivation to patients and are available on-demand to answer questions. To learn more, visit www.limberhealth.com

bluejetty:00024084:ios.description:
Far away in the Sea where water is very deep, a NEW Mermaid World is waiting for you to have an amazing adventure! Come and dive to the deepest spot of the ocean and find a Sea World Castle full of mermaids! Meet a Little Mermaid and her friends! Create your own Sea World Story and have a lot of fun!
The New Underwater Kingdom full of mermaids is waiting for you in Wonderland: Little Mermaid – an amazing adventure game for girls and boys. Explore and have fun with new characters you’ll get to play: meet Little Mermaid, Sea King, Sea Turtles, Pirates and discover many different activities in this adventure mermaid game for kids. 
WONDERLAND: LITTLE MERMAID GAME FEATURES:
• 14 exciting Sea Kingdom locations and rooms to discover: 
- Mermaids House
- Restaurant
- Make up & Hair Saloon
- Pirate's sunken ship and many more
• Pick favorite clothing and hairstyles for mermaids 
• Help Little Mermaid to discover the Pirate's hidden treasure chests
• Connect Little Mermaid game for girls to other Wonderland game for kids and have a more exciting adventure 
• Multi touch-enabled so you can play your favorite underwater game for kids with friends on the same device
• Help a Little Mermaid with cooking or get her to sleep into a cozy Mermaid Shell bed
• Sea adventure is everywhere in this amazing game for girls and boys
WONDERLAND – CREATE YOUR OWN SEA ADVENTURE
Girls, have you ever wanted to become an ocean princess, or to enjoy a sea world adventure as a cute Little Mermaid? Wonderland: Little Mermaid game is a perfect story adventure game for girls to explore the Sea World and to have a lot of adventure and fun. You will be able to create a new glamorous look for your mermaid, select your favorite hairstyles and have fun in the makeup saloon! Be Little Mermaid and become ocean princess! 
Boys, would you like to explore the underwater Sea World, and search for a Pirate lost treasure? What about diving into the ocean and finding a sunken Pirate Ship full of treasures, gifts, and sea animals. All you need is your imagination to have fun in this super fun adventure game for kids!
Wonderland Little Mermaid adventure game for kids is a role-play game where you only need the imagination to create your new sea world adventure! 
VISIT LITTLE MERMAID RESTAURANT:
Have you ever dreamed to visit the Sea Kingdom and take part in the Little Mermaid Story game? How about visiting a Little Mermaid favorite Restaurant and having fun preparing delicious seafood and desserts? Or to play in the Sea playground while you are waiting for your favorite cake! Everything is possible! All you need is your creativity to make your own story!
THE BEST GAME FOR LITTLE GIRLS AND BOYS
Enjoy a new mermaid adventure game for little girls and boys! Your little ones will enjoy this pretend play Mermaid dollhouse game. There are a lot of characters and locations in this adventure game for little girls and boys that can be connected to other Wonderland games! Make your Little Mermaid adventure game interesting! Explore a sea paradise in this underwater game for kids! 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
This game is perfect for Kids 4 -12, the game promotes creative thinking, imaginative gameplay, and endless role-playing game time. Wonderland games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Play the best toddler game with fun!
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES STUDIO
The My Town Games studio designs digital pretend play dollhouse games that promote creativity and role-play for children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce experiences for hours of imaginative pretend play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania, and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00143766:ios.name: CameraFi Live
bluejetty:00143766:ios.summary:
Use CameraFi Live for all your recording & live streaming needs! 
Stream on platforms like YouTube, Facebook and Twitch with high-quality content, effects, and real-time editing features.
With features like sports scoreboards, and external
bluejetty:00143766:ios.description:
Use CameraFi Live for all your recording & live streaming needs! 
Stream on platforms like YouTube, Facebook and Twitch with high-quality content, effects, and real-time editing features.
With features like sports scoreboards, and external camera connections, you can produce impressive videos and live streams effortlessly.
[Main Features]
• Camera Mode
Start live streaming with the 'Camera Mode' that broadcasts your smartphone camera shooting! (Mobile screen capture mode to be released soon)
• Screen Broadcasting Mode (New)
Share your entire device screen in real time! Stream screen content such as mobile games and app tutorials directly to your viewers.
• Image, Text Overlay
You can easily add image and text sources while live-streaming. Use various effects to easily edit real-time video effects on your mobile device.
• Chat
You can interact with your viewers in real-time by watching and responding to their chat messages. Super Chat is also supported!
• Web Browser Overlay
You can connect live-streaming donation/subscription alert platforms such as Streamlabs by web source overlay. Monetize your live broadcast.
• External Camera Connection
You can connect external USB cameras, such as camcorders, DSLRs, webcams, and drones to your smartphone. By using Accsoon SeeMo, you can now easily use professional cameras for high-quality live streaming.
• Motion Effect
Apply diverse cool effects to attract viewers. With a few clicks, you can add sports scoreboards, subtitles, and animation effects.
• Save a Live Video
You can save your live-streaming video in your smartphone memory to create a highlight video afterwards.
[Specifications]
• Streaming Server
YouTube, Facebook, OBS, vMix, RTMP and SRT(Secure Reliable Transport)
• Interfaces
- Video source: Built-in Camera
- Audio source: Built-in Mic, Bluetooth microphone and Internal sound
• Video Size
SD(640×480), HD(1280×720), FHD(1920x1080) ~ up to UHD(4K, 3840x2160)
(Varies from platforms and smartphone models)
• Encoder
H.264 and HEVC
[Required Permissions]
• Storage: Used for saving photos/vidoes or load stored photos/videos
• Microphone: Used for recording souynd during video recording
• Camera: Used for taking pictures and videos
• Notification: Used for indicating information about live streaming in the notification area
[Feedback]
If you have any comments or questions about the app, please use the feedback button on CameraFi Live(CameraFi Live settings > Feedback > Suggest a feature/Report a bug).

 • Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/vaultmicrocamerafi

* Over 340 questions.

* Modern and very easy to use interface.
------------------------------------------------------
If you enjoyed the app, please rate it on App Store and tell a friend!
------------------------------------------------------

bluejetty:00036331:ios.description:
Do you want to bring order to the streets?
Step into the role of a hero working from the shadows and defend cities from crime in a thrilling 3D adventure game. The main goal of our exciting and realistic shooting game is to safeguard civilians and assist law enforcement by neutralizing threats and maintaining peace.
~~~ Game Features ~~~
~ Exciting Missions
In the game, you'll find various rescue missions where your character must fight crime and save lives. Rescue hostages, prevent dangerous incidents, and foil criminal plans. Each mission will test your ability to think and act quickly to make the right decisions and keep innocent people safe.
~ Weapon Upgrades
Unlock and upgrade a variety of rifles, shotguns, and pistols. Improve your weapons' accuracy, range, and firepower by upgrading components such as scopes, barrels, and stocks. Your upgraded arsenal is the key to completing even the most challenging missions.
~ Immersive Gameplay
Experience a realistic sniper game with intuitive controls and dynamic environments that make every mission engaging. Use your scope to zoom in, identify targets, and choose the right course of action. Earn rewards for your efforts and unlock new challenges as you travel to cities where your help is needed most.
In every mission, your skills and decisions have a real impact. Protect the innocent, thwart dangerous plans, and prove that peace is in good hands.
Are you ready to be the hero the world needs?
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe now to get:
1. +20% energy
2. +20% profit
3. Better weapons
4. Free piggy bank
5. One additional energy recharge per day
6. Faster weapon upgrades
Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $11.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $49.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time. To prevent automatic renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00151858:ios.description:
Looking for a heartwarming game to relax without boredom? Eager to meet like-minded friends but afraid of social awkwardness? This game filled with flowers and surprises solves all your worries!
Dual gameplay of managing a garden + flower shop—therapeutic and fun, plus real flower rewards waiting for you to claim! 
Unlock a World of Blossoms, Manage Your Exclusive Garden & Flower Shop
Dive into a diverse world of flowers in The Cozy Florist! From daisies and lilies of the valley to rare tulips, craft your one-of-a-kind garden with your own hands and run a personalized flower shop—pure therapeutic joy!
Flower-Stealing Interaction: Thrilling & Super Stress-Relieving
Spotted vibrant roses blooming in a friend’s garden? Sneak a few blooms, but watch out—don’t get caught! Snagging rare flower seeds brings immense a sense of achievement!
Garden Socializing: Easily Connect with Fellow Flower Lovers
Wander through strangers’ creative gardens and like your favorite designs; join the garden community and effortlessly gain a group of new flower-loving friends—no more feeling lonely while gaming!
Play the Game, Win Real Flowers!
Here’s the biggest surprise: Lucky players can redeem real flowers—you could be the next lucky one! The romance from the game blooms into reality, full of ritualistic charm!
You can manage a dreamy garden, enjoy flower-stealing interactions, make like-minded friends, and even win real flowers—who wouldn’t love The Cozy Florist?
Register now to get the 「Newbie Flower Seed Mega Pack」 and unlock your garden and flower adventure! Real bouquets are ready—waiting for you to win them～

bluejetty:00179193:ios.description:
國道一路通 -- 台灣高速公路即時影像、塞車狀況、車速查詢、車速警示、沿線語音播報以及警察廣播電台播報
打開定位即實際地圖上繪製所在地中心附近的車況圖，可縮放地圖，不再是小小的縮小圖，快速了解高速公路的路況。另提供各國道交流道間的車速、測速照相偵測、即時監視器影像、車速警示、警察廣播電台以及沿線語音播報等功能。
目前包含路段：各國道、快速道路(台6x, 台7x, 台8x 等)、台9線以及台11線等。
主要功能
- 打開即用：打開定位即實際地圖上繪製所在地中心附近的車況圖
- 底圖選擇：地圖採用 Mapbox ，提供「白色底圖」、「黑色底圖」兩種
- 地圖縮放：可放大方便了解哪路段附近的交流道回堵，重新開啟時，將依最後觀看比例縮放
- 附近匣道：首頁列表依定位座標排列出最近交流道的國道、高速公路，方便找到最近國道
- 車速資訊：提供各國道交流道間的車速資訊
- 自定色盤：若覺得地圖車速路段顏色不易區分，可以自行變更顏色
- 警廣電台：可以同時播放警察廣播電台，包括兩種選項，預設依定位所在地切換最近的地區警廣電台，可以切換成全國網選項。
- 監視影像：提供各國道交流道間的即時監視器(CCTV)影像 
- 省電定位：除了一開始的定位，每隔五分鐘才重新定位乙次，並會依座標更新地圖中心所在地
- 道路標誌：地圖上標示國道、快速道路標誌 (不包括國1,國3標誌)
- 交流道點：地圖上用虛線空心圓圈標示交流道，點擊可查交流道名稱，方便確認塞車路段 (避免和國1混淆，不包括「汐五高架」交流道)。另外，可以切換標示警廣路況資訊所在地。
- 語音播報：基本提供沿線資訊播報，包括沿線電子看板(又稱資訊顯示板, CMS)、固定式測速照相、休息服務區以及警廣即時路況(警察廣播電台)。 若程式判斷十五分鐘內都沒在國道或快速道路上，將自動停止語音播報，節省用電。(預設每分鐘定位)
- 車速警示：另提供「沿線資訊及車速」模式切換，除以上基本語音播報，包括車速測量功能 ，若超過限速，車速會以紅字提醒，若超過所設定的限速(110%, 105%, 100%) 時，則嗶聲提醒，此功能也可選擇關閉。由於連續定位，基本語音播報功能會更精準，然而，耗電也相對較高，建議同時接上電源(比如隨身電池等)使用。另外，此模式下地圖將自動轉向車子行進方向。
- 背景播報：打開「永遠」定位以及「背景更新」權限下，語音播報功能開啟後，按 Home 鍵離開 App(或者手動關閉螢幕)，即進入背景語音播報，適合前景搭配其他導航軟體使用。進入此模式也相對耗電，也建議接上電源時使用。
- 其他播報：另可設定前方交流道以及前方路段平均車速播報。
- 國道五號(雪山隧道、雪隧)呈現內側與外側車道即時分道車速
＊語音播報注意事項
 - 開啟語音播報時，定位將由原本五分鐘省電定位，改成一分鐘定位，會比較耗電。若打開車速警示功能，即連續定位，會更耗電。
 - 短時間內連續相同內容者，將不重覆播報
 - 避免和國1混淆，播報內容不包括「汐五高架」交流道資訊.
 - 由於每分鐘才定位乙次，有些路段相近平行的路段可能會誤判，比如國1 分別和 台72, 台74 相近的路段。
資料主要來源：
- 交通部高速公路局「交通資料庫」
- 交通部公路總局省道交控路側設備資料
- 警政署 警廣即時路況資訊
若有其他功能需求，或者使用上有問題，可以利用 App 設定內回報給我們。另外，資料來源眾多，難免資料會有錯誤，也可利用 App 設定內回報給我們。

Players read cards displayed on the phone aloud. The catch? Each card contains a seemingly gibberish phrase that sounds like real words when said out loud. Your mission is to be the first in your group who guesses the gibberish phrase before time runs out!

- Instant Party Starter: Ideal for breaking the ice or revitalizing a dying party, this game will have players overthinking in no time

bluejetty:00157551:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157551:ios.description:
***********Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D – The Ultimate Goat Rampage Simulator*************
Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D is the wildest, funniest goat simulation game ever! Play as a crazy goat on the loose, causing total mayhem in a big open-world city. Smash cars, crash into people, break fences, and do the most unexpected stunts—because why not?
Jump, run, headbutt, and create chaos while exploring every city corner. Complete silly missions, unlock cool goat skins, and show everyone who's the real boss! With realistic physics and hilarious ragdoll effects, every moment is fun.
Ready to unleash your inner rampaging goat? Get Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D now and let the madness begin! 
Get ready for the most hilarious and action-packed goat simulation game ever! In Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D, you take control of a wild and unstoppable goat, causing chaos in a massive open-world city. Smash, crash, and destroy everything in your path as you complete crazy missions and unleash your inner rampaging goat!
 Features That Make This Goat Game Crazy Fun! 
Epic Open-World City – Explore a huge 3D city filled with cars, buildings, people, and objects waiting to be smashed!
Goat Mayhem – Charge at pedestrians, headbutt vehicles, break fences, and even jump across rooftops!
Exciting Challenges & Missions – Complete wild tasks like racing, destruction missions, and time-based challenges!
Powerful Goat Abilities – Perform headbutts, super jumps, flips, and crazy stunts to create ultimate chaos.
Unlock Unique Goat Skins – Customize your goat with different skins and looks to make your rampage even more fun!
Realistic Physics & Ragdoll Effects – Enjoy funny and realistic physics as you toss objects and watch the world react to your destruction!
Immersive Sound Effects – Experience hilarious goat sounds, city noises, and powerful destruction effects!
Become the King of the Goat World!
From running wild in the streets to pulling off epic stunts, Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D lets you live your best goat life. Whether you want to explore freely or complete thrilling missions, the choice is yours!
Are you ready to cause the wildest destruction ever? Download Angry Goat Crazy Hoof City 3D now and start your crazy goat adventure today!

bluejetty:00100193:ios.description:
A New Way Forward in Personal Insight
You don’t need a therapy degree—or endless self-help books—to find real clarity. 
WooMoo brings the art of self-reflection into the age of AI—with your own empathetic guide by your side. It’s more than advice;it’s a conversation with your inner self.
Express with clarity, gain meaningful insight
Before every session, WooMoo helps you clarify your thoughts and feelings—because clear expression brings clear understanding. Whether it’s stress, relationships, or your next personal goal, framing your experience opens the door to growth.
· Smart prompts guide you to articulate what really matters.
· Voice input lets you talk through your feelings naturally, like chatting with a wise and supportive friend.
Reflect and center yourself
When you engage with Bloomo, you’re not just logging data—you’re tuning in to your present emotional state. Each interaction is a mindful pause, designed to bring calm and presence. Thoughtful animations help you transition into a reflective mindset.
Understand yourself in depth
WooMoo’s insights combine principles from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Positive Psychology, and Mindfulness to reveal deeper patterns in your thoughts and emotions. It’s not about prediction—it’s about pattern recognition for personal well-being.
· AI-trained on established psychological frameworks and humanistic principles.
· Integrates practical insights for real-world applications.
· Multi-layered reflections: surface thoughts, underlying emotions, and constructive perspectives.
Feel heard, not judged
Your AI Companion isn’t here to tell you what to do—it’s here to help you understand yourself with compassion and curiosity. You’ll leave each session feeling more grounded, self-aware, and equipped to take helpful steps.
· Supportive tone that feels genuinely human, not robotic.
· Personalized summaries you can revisit anytime for continuity.
· "Audio Reflection" feature—listen to your insights hands-free for reinforcement.
Simple, calm, transformative
Open → express → reflect → grow.
WooMoo turns your screen into a space for stillness, self-connection, and clarity.
Express openly. Reflect deeply. Move forward with self-awareness.
WooMoo is your AI mental health companion for guidance that feels real—because it starts with you.
Need help? Email us:
support@woomoo.app
We don't do creepy stuff with your data
Privacy Policy: https://www.woomoo.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.woomoo.app/terms.html

Intramurals - Clubs - Fitness

bluejetty:00133481:ios.description:

Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? Radiation, hunger, disease and suffering are all around you. Your goal is to escape from the dying city and find the love of your youth. Unique atmosphere and piercing to the depths of the story. Reveal the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to perish..

- Hard survival. You will be haunted by the typical problems of a survivor, such as hunger, disease, thirst, a gradually coming nuclear winter and bandits.
- Unique story. Along the way, you will find many stories of different people, exciting puzzle quests and the right to choose during the passage of quests.
- Dynamic game world. In the game world, weather conditions will change, the balance of power of groups of people outside, and so on.

Peculiarities:
- Crafting system

- Exploring an interesting world
Now - Demo Version.

bluejetty:00179373:ios.summary:

In the beginning there is your decision. Let's not fool ourselves. I
bluejetty:00179373:ios.description:
This app was developed by former smokers based on the experiences of many other former smokers and has already helped millions of users quit smoking. How can it help you?
In the beginning there is your decision. Let's not fool ourselves. If you are not serious, it will be difficult. But if you really want it, your chances are good that you will make it with the help of this app.
There are many different strategies, methods, and tools that can help you quit. Whether one thing or the other works better for you can vary from person to person, but the experiences of millions of former smokers show that it is almost always a mixture of information, motivation and participation that ultimately led to success.
Therefore, this app relies on a selection of tried and tested methods and tools, which are based on the three strategic pillars of information, motivation and participation.
What tools does this app offer?
Numbers::
Keep track of the most important numbers: number of days as a non-smoker, number of cigarettes not smoked, money saved.
Health:
Review your health progress and your physical reactions to not smoking.
Knowledge:
Carefully researched and comprehensive knowledge, context and advice on every aspect of smoking will ensure that your decision to quit is strengthened, that you remain motivated and are as well prepared as possible for withdrawal.
Tasks:
During the particularly difficult initial period of quitting, you will be given small tasks every day, aimed at reflecting on the knowledge you have learned, convincing you of your decision, and keeping motivation high.
Cravings Help:
If you want to have a cigarette, you will be shown practical solutions for the respective situations in which you are currently in. Statistics also show you in which situations you are most often at risk, so that you can avoid them or approach them differently in the future.
Top 10 Tips:
Get valuable advice from former smokers about what helped them the most to quit smoking. Since they speak from experience, there's a good chance that there's something there that will be a great help to you too.
Awards:
You regularly receive awards for milestones achieved on your way to becoming a non-smoker, which you can share with family and friends.
Savings goals:
Set savings goals and watch getting closer and closer to them because of the money you save.
100 reasons:
If you have a strong cigarette craving, 100 reasons to not smoke a cigarette will help you.
Apple Watch App:
The Apple Watch app quickly shows you the most important numbers of your non-smoking career.
Widget:
The widget quickly shows you the most important numbers of your non-smoking career. 
http://www.appinghouse.com/quit-smoking-privacy.html
http://www.appinghouse.com/quit-smoking-terms.html

bluejetty:00168443:ios.description:
Groupsy by Photobucket. Trusted by more than 70 million people.
Over 14 billion photos and videos safely stored, protected, and shared. Backed by more than 20 years of helping people preserve what matters most.
Groupsy by Photobucket is the private photo and video sharing app built for real life—not public feeds.
Whether you’re sharing family memories, wedding photos, vacation albums, sports highlights, or pictures from a night out with friends, Groupsy gives every group its own private space to collect, organize, and relive moments together.
No algorithms or strangers. Just your people.
A HOME FOR SHARED MEMORIES
Photos shouldn’t disappear inside endless group chats.
They shouldn’t live across five different phones.
And they shouldn’t become content for people you don’t know.
Groupsy gives every family, friend group, sports team, travel crew, classroom, and community a shared home where everyone can contribute photos and videos in full quality.
Every memory stays together. Exactly where it belongs.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE GROUPSY
- You’ll have private spaces for every group in your life
- Easily organize all of your photos and videos
- Your photos and videos stay compression-free, exactly as you took them
- Express yourself with reactions and comments
- Access your uploads across all your devices
- Seamlessly sync with WhatsApp and Meta
- FaceFinder helps you quickly and easily find all the pictures of you
- Automatically back-up your digital memories
GROUPSY IS PERFECT FOR…
- Private photo and video sharing
- Organizing group memories
- Curating family albums
- Collecting wedding and event photos
- Sharing team sport highlights
- Saving travel and vacation pics
- Sorting and keeping group chat photos
- Collaborating in group projects
And so much more!
WHY MILLIONS TRUST GROUPSY
For more than twenty years, Photobucket has helped people protect their memories.
Today:
• 70+ million users
• 14+ billion photos and videos
• Trusted since 2003
Groupsy continues that legacy with a new experience built specifically for private group sharing.
Whether you’re planning a wedding, starting a new family, coaching a team, traveling with friends, or simply sharing everyday moments—Groupsy keeps everyone connected in one private place.
Because the best memories belong with the people who lived them.
HEAR FROM CURRENT USERS
“Great experience! Love how easy it is! The sharing function worked really nice for my recent family trip. Everyone was able to upload all their moments and it was really special to have them all together. Worked great and will be using time and time again for events and life moments.” - PAD
“Customer service is great!! They've gone above and beyond to help me, highly recommended!!” - MacKenzie Oakes
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Who can see my photos and videos?
Your photos and videos stay with you and only the people you invite! You control who can see, share, or contribute, so your memories stay just how you want them.
Why use Groupsy instead of social media or cloud storage?
Groupsy gives you private spaces for different groups, without algorithms, ads, or the pressure of public posting. And instead of treating your memories like files in a folder, it's built for sharing, reacting, and reminiscing. The way memories are meant to be experienced together.
How do I share my Group?
You can easily share a single image or video, or multiple images and videos from your Group by creating safe and secure sharing links.
Is FaceFinder private?
Yes. FaceFinder runs entirely on your device. Your photos and face data never leave your phone. We don't receive, store, or access any of it. The feature is opt-in only, and you can turn it off at any time.
Support: https://support.photobucket.com/
Terms of Service: https://photobucket.com/legal/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://photobucket.com/legal/privacy-policy
Biometric Policy: https://photobucket.com/legal/biometric-information-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00062065:ios.description:
New Ginkgo option - World Chess Champion 2026 (ICGA). Special upgrade offer for a limited time. From Beginner (ELO 600) to AI Grandmaster (ELO 3600). Improves gameplay throughout the app. Plays like a human being at any level.
Winner of "Best Strategy Game". 
Six modes of play.
Annotated databases, Puzzles, Training Mode, Rated Mode with ELO appraisal, Blitz Mode, World Rankings and more ...
Learn to play and master the classic strategy game Chess with an app that takes you from novice all the way to Grandmaster level with 100 graded levels!
Mastersoft Chess has one of the World's best Desktop PC chess engines crammed inside! This engine finished 4th in the World Microcomputer Chess Championships and is not available in any other iPhone chess game. Designed by chess champions to play like a human opponent, Mastersoft Chess will take you from Novice to Grandmaster level! Features stunning high resolution sets by renowned Chess designers.
Easy to play but difficult to beat, this is pick up and play chess at its best!
As previously supplied by the World's biggest OEMs, and now available for a fraction of the original price thanks to the power of the App Store!
The #1 Best Selling Chess App for iOS*
PROFESSIONAL REVIEWS:
"I bought all chess applications for iPhone and this one is probably better than many $7-9 applications. Check TEST ALL. 66 chess applications at only ONE page in the World ..."
- www.chess-iphone.blogspot.com
"It truly is close to flawless and is by far the best mobile Chess game I have played on any platform."
- PDA 247.
AWARDS
HP Choice Strategy Game of the Year
Smartphone Magazine runner up.
Various levels, board styles and breathtaking Retina Display chess sets combine with an outstanding World beating chess engine to offer you a great playing experience and an ever increasing challenge. 
Whether you're just starting out or else a seasoned pro, Mastersoft Chess has something for you!
BEGINNERS
Hint facility. 
Built in coach to monitor your progress
Training levels that dumb down your iPhone / iPod Touch. 
Take back a move if you change your mind! 
Your iPhone/iPod Touch checks that your moves are allowed.
Simple intuitive uncluttered interface that lets you concentrate on your game.
NB If you are new to Chess then please ensure that the coach is turned on in options and that the lowest difficulty level is selected.
GRANDMASTERS
A unique engine unlike any other - plays interesting and sometimes quite aggressive chess.
Designed to play like a human opponent - right up to Grandmaster level!
Huge opening Book
100% Full Chess rules including enpassant, castling etc. 
Thought analysis (main line, depth and score). 
Setup position (including castling rights, enpassant and side to move) 
Move forward / backward to any point in the current game. 
Includes Standard Chess Book Sets in addition to the realistic ones.
OTHER FEATURES
Huge collection of stunning high resolution chess sets in both 2D and 3D. Makes the most of Retina Display!
Boards constructed from the real thing - Oak, Ash, Marble, Slate and more! 
Save and load games. 
Realistic sound effects. 
Adjustable piece movement animation. 
Autosaving of your current game.
Great for novices but will grow with you and still offer a challenge at Championship level.
Universal App. Play on your iPod, iPhone and iPad. No additional purchase necessary.
Great value!
Source: US App Store 2011.
New sets, new boards, improved engine, universal app, retina artwork and more! Voted No1 best Chess app!
PS Don't forget the EN PASSANT Pawns Chess rule!

bluejetty:00039329:ios.description:
Wees altijd als eerste op de hoogte van de aanbiedingen en folders van meer dan 60.000 winkels in Nederland. Met de Folderz app weet jij direct wanneer en waar jouw favoriete product in de aanbieding is. Zo bespaar je geld én tijd!
Dit is hoe Folderz jou helpt met besparen:
- Als eerste de laatste aanbiedingen ontdekken
- Favoriete aanbiedingen, topics en folders opslaan en volgen
- Snel en eenvoudig je boodschappenlijstje samenstellen 
- Gemakkelijk zoeken naar folders, deals en winkels
- Locatie aanzetten en acties in de buurt ontdekken
- Geld besparen met Folderz!
Dit is wat de Folderz community zegt:
***** “Handig. Alle aanbiedingen in één app. Geen rondslingerende folders. Makkelijk weer een actie terugvinden door op een artikel te zoeken” - J. Peace, 2023
► Als eerste op de hoogte van de laatste aanbiedingen
Zeg gedag tegen de rondslingerende papieren folders die je telkens moet doorbladeren. Krijg je direct toegang tot de nieuwste reclame folders en (cashback) acties van jouw favoriete winkels, allemaal op één plek. Of het nu gaat om supermarktaanbiedingen, cashback acties, of acties bij de drogist, je bent altijd als eerste op de hoogte van de beste deals.
► Markeer acties of topics als favoriet en volg ze
Met Folderz heb je een overzicht van jouw favoriete aanbiedingen. Geen gedoe meer met het zoeken naar die ene speciale deal die je niet wilt missen. Met slechts één druk op de knop kun je jouw favoriete acties markeren en volgen. En het beste van alles? Je kunt al jouw opgeslagen folders terugvinden, zoals de AH folder, zodat je altijd toegang hebt tot de aanbiedingen die voor jou het belangrijkst zijn. 
► Stel jouw boodschappenlijst samen
Stel eenvoudig jouw boodschappenlijstje voor deze week samen. Voeg de items toe aan je lijstje terwijl je de aanbiedingen bekijkt. Vink in de winkel je de boodschappen af zodra je ze in je mandje legt, zodat je niets vergeet. Bovendien kun je prijzen vergelijken van verschillende winkels, zodat je altijd de beste deal krijgt. 
► Zoek per aanbieding, folder, categorie of winkel
Of je nu specifiek op zoek bent naar aanbiedingen van bekende merken zoals Heineken en Pampers, of als je de topdeals van jouw favoriete winkel zoals Aldi, Bruna, Jumbo of Plus wilt bekijken, onze zoekfunctie helpt. Voer simpelweg de naam van het product, de winkel of de categorie in die je interesseert, en onze app toont je direct alle relevante aanbiedingen. 
► Winkels en aanbiedingen bij jou in de buurt
Wil je niet stad en land af om geld te besparen? Ontdek wat er allemaal te vinden is in jouw directe omgeving. Folderz laat je zien welke winkels zich bij jou in de buurt bevinden en welke promoties ze hebben. Zo kun je eenvoudig beslissen waar je naartoe wilt gaan om te winkelen en profiteren van de acties in jouw omgeving.
► Alle aanbiedingen en folders, van A tot Z
Op zoek naar de laatste acties van Dirk, de bonus van Albert Heijn of cashback acties? Bij Folderz zit je goed! De app bevat de laatste folders van onder andere Albert Heijn, Aldi, Boni, Dekamarkt, Dirk, Etos, Hema, Hoogvliet, Jumbo, Kaufland, Kruidvat, Lidl, Nettorama, Plus, Vomar, Douglas, Temu, ICI PARIS XL en Action. Ook vind je in de Folderz app de beste acties van merken zoals Ariel, Bacardi, Campina, Dolce Gusto, Hertog Jan, NESCAFÉ, Nomad, Heineken, Pampers en Oral B.
► Bespaar geld met Folderz!
Wist je dat er veel verschil zit tussen supermarktprijzen? Zo ben je bijvoorbeeld bij de Aldi het duurste uit en bij Dirk het goedkoopst. De Folderz app zet de beste aanbiedingen van al deze winkels voor jou op een rijtje. Zo vergelijk jij eenvoudig alle acties en stel je op basis daarvan jouw boodschappenlijstje samen. Zo bespaar je namelijk gemiddeld maar liefst 30 tot 35% op je boodschappen!
Geld besparen was nog nooit zo eenvoudig. Met Folderz hoef je nooit meer te zoeken naar de beste deals. Download Folderz nu geheel gratis en start met besparen.

bluejetty:00014647:ios.summary:
Repair shop software built for the counter and the bench. Check a device in with a few taps, keep every job on track, and know your numbers without opening a spreadsheet.
Say the job in one sentence, out loud or typed, and SpotsPOS fills i
bluejetty:00014647:ios.description:
Repair shop software built for the counter and the bench. Check a device in with a few taps, keep every job on track, and know your numbers without opening a spreadsheet.
Say the job in one sentence, out loud or typed, and SpotsPOS fills in the ticket for you.
CHECK IN REPAIRS FAST
- Describe it, we fill it in: say "iPhone 15 Pro, cracked screen, needs it by Friday" and SpotsPOS fills in the device, the problem and the priority
- Or pick device type, brand, model and problem in four taps
- Passcodes, notes and photos stay on the ticket
- Warranties on every repair, with time left shown on the ticket
EVERY REPAIR, ON TRACK
- The Repairs screen is your whole bench: high priority jobs on top, ready for pickup and waiting on parts one tap away
- Find any ticket by IMEI, name or ticket number
- On iPad, Repair Board shows every open repair as a card you drag to its next status
- Status updates go out to the customer on their own, and every finished repair can ask how it went
- Repair Advisor gives the technician best practice guidance right on the ticket
SPOTS INTELLIGENCE
- Ask your shop anything: "How's today going?" or "What's running low?" and get the number, a chart and the list behind it
- On iPhones and iPads with Apple Intelligence, the answers are worked out on the device, from your own data
- Parts your shop usually uses for a repair, a plain summary of any ticket and checkout suggestions
BUYBACKS AND DEVICE MANAGEMENT
- Buy a device from a customer, grade it, make an offer and pay when they accept, all in one form
- Every used and refurbished device grouped by model and tracked unit by unit by IMEI or serial
- Filter units for sale, sold or loaner, and see what your buybacks earn
SELL, STOCK AND REPORT
- Parts and labor are already on the ticket; take off the deposit and check out at the counter
- Parts inventory updates itself, with low stock alerts and purchase orders
- Inventory counts with barcode scanning, plus a full history of every adjustment
- Sales against profit, end of day reports and Business Health with goals and trends
- Receipts by text, email or Epson and Star printers, plus barcode labels
KEEPS WORKING OFFLINE
When the internet drops, your repairs, customers, sales, orders and inventory stay on screen. Look up a ticket, a price or a customer and keep the counter moving. Changes wait until you are back online.
BUILT FOR YOUR WHOLE SHOP
- Appointments that turn into repair tickets when the customer arrives
- Time logs per ticket, so you know what a job really took
- Every location from one login, with repair transfers between shops
- Everyone signs in with their own PIN and sees only what their role allows
- Import customers, inventory and devices from a CSV file
- Webhooks send repairs and sales to the tools you already use
- Ready for iPhone Duo
- English, Spanish and French
Works on iPhone and iPad, with a web portal for the office.
Start with a free 14-day trial. Plans are available inside the app.
Terms of Use: https://spotspos.com/terms
