bluejetty:00138743:ios.description:
• Log your blood sugar, weight and notes in seconds
• Get an estimated A1c and see how much of your data is in range
• Export a glucose log as a PDF for your doctor
Blood Sugar Tracker & Glucose is a simple glucose diary for people who have been asked to keep track of their readings at home. Enter what your meter shows, and the app turns it into an estimated A1c, a time-in-range figure, trends and a clean PDF you can hand to your doctor.
The screen is deliberately plain: large figures, few taps, nothing in the way.
■ Main features
• Morning, noon, evening and before bed, with a before-meal and after-meal value at each meal
• Values in mg/dL, mmol/L or g/L, with the unit for your region suggested on first launch
• Weight in kg or lb, and a note for each day
• Calendar view of every day you have logged
• Estimated A1c, calculated from your average glucose
• Time in range: how much of your data sits inside your own target range
• Average, highest and lowest readings for any period

[이용문의]
페이북/ISP는 안전한 결제인증 서비스를 제공하는 브이피(주)에서 운영하고 있습니다.

bluejetty:00036175:ios.description:
Overview
 • The E! app is the best place to catch up on the most recent season of your favorite shows, watch live TV, and stream movies and past season content!
 • Get full episodes of E!’s must-know pop culture shows like Live from E!, Kimora: Back in the Fab Lane, Botched Presents: Plastic Surgery Rewind, Honestly Cavallari: The Headline Tour, AND MANY MORE!
 • Get started by signing in with your TV subscription (cable, satellite, or digital). The E! app supports most TV providers, including DirecTV, Spectrum, Xfinity, Dish, and AT&T.
App Features
 Watch Your Way
 • Watch the latest episodes of new E! shows the day after they air on TV.
 • Live stream and schedule available 24/7 when signed in with your TV provider.
 Explore Versant Content
 • Access to on-demand content from across the Versant family of networks (including USA, SYFY, E!, Oxygen, MSNOW, CNBC, and Golf Channel).
 • Don't miss a second of the Premier League, the WNBA, A10 hoops, the PGA and LPGA Tours, and NASCAR!
 • Live stream your favorite Versant networks within the app.
 • Dedicated page for each network showcasing the hottest series.
 • Stream recent and throwback favorites, like Law & Order: SVU, Chicago Fire, Chicago P.D., and Chicago Med.
 • Filter shows by network and genre while browsing. 
 TV Provider Access
 • Sign in with your TV subscription to gain access to the entire catalog of VOD and Live content.
Availability Notice
 • Versant's family of networks are only available to stream in the US and US territories.
 • Those outside the US will be unable to watch full episodes or live TV.
 • If you're traveling, you'll regain full access as soon as you return to the US.
Comments or Questions
 • Please fill out our contact support form at https://help.versantmedia.com/s/contactsupport for assistance.
 • Please note: Use of the app is limited to the United States and its territories. Video is accessible via 3G, 4G, LTE, and Wi-Fi networks. Data charges may apply.
 • Privacy Policy: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy 
 • Your Privacy Choices: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy/cookies 
 • CA Notice: https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy/california-consumer-privacy-act

bluejetty:00186100:ios.description:
Transform Your Typing: Discover Typing Fingers on the App Store!
Enhance Your Typing Skills with Fun and Interactive Learning
Whether you're a homeschooling champ or just looking to improve your typing prowess, Typing Fingers is the app for you! Designed for the US/EN QWERTY keyboard layout, it's the perfect blend of education and entertainment.
A Revolutionary Approach to Typing
Ditch the boring drills for Typing Fingers' fresh and engaging method. It's not just about typing; it's about learning to type efficiently with all ten fingers. This app turns the learning process into a delightful experience, complete with serene music and a stunning design that appeals to all ages. Finish all levels and earn your very own Typing Fingers Diploma!
SYMMETRIC SUPER LEARNING - A Brain-Friendly Method
Our unique SYMETRIC teaching approach is grounded in brain science. It engages both hemispheres of your brain, ensuring a balanced and effective learning experience. The repetitive symmetric patterns make learning intuitive and natural.
Earn Your Typing Fingers Diploma
Complete the game, and you'll be awarded the prestigious Foriero's Typing Fingers diploma, personalized with your name and completion date. It's more than just a certificate; it's a symbol of your dedication and skill!
32 Levels Guided by Interactive Tutor 'Dennis'
Meet Dennis, your friendly tutor who makes learning fun and easy. Progress through 32 carefully designed levels, each teaching you the correct finger placement for different keys.
A Perfect Blend of Learning and Gaming
Every lesson is a two-part adventure: first, learn with Dennis, then test your skills in a thrilling game with only three lives. It's a challenge that will keep you motivated and engaged.
Your Feedback Matters - Write to Us!
Your thoughts and ideas are invaluable. Use the WRITE US button in the game to share your feedback. We're committed to making Typing Fingers even better with your help.
Get Ready to Type Your Way to Success! Download Typing Fingers from the App Store and embark on a typing journey like no other!
[Available now for both Apple and Mac versions]
Note: External keyboard recommended for the best experience.

bluejetty:00177860:ios.description:
The fun game for kids learning math!
Try Teach Your Monster: Number Skills free today and unlock the full adventure with a subscription. Subscriptions give you access to all the number games (plus every new update we add!), and can be easily managed or cancelled anytime in your App Store settings. No ads, just evidence-based, teacher-approved, fun monster learning!
WHY CHOOSE TEACH YOUR MONSTER NUMBER SKILLS?
• Developed by the Usborne Foundation, creators of the acclaimed game Teach Your Monster to Read
• Collaboratively designed with early math specialists Bernie Westacott, Dr. Helen J. Williams, and Dr. Sue Gifford
• Aligns with the USA's common core standards from Pre-K through to Kindergarten and beyond
• Game supports math learning worldwide, emphasising numbers up to 20
• Featuring 15 captivating mini-games with 150 levels tailored for progressive learning
• Join Queenie Bee and pals in Number Park: from dodgems to bouncy castles, learn math through play
CORE BENEFITS
• Tailored Pacing: The game adapts to each child’s progress, ensuring comprehensive understanding.
• Curriculum Aligned: Seamlessly blend classroom teachings across the USA with at-home practice.
• Engaging Play: Kids adore practicing numbers when every mini-game offers exhilarating math fun.
SKILLS COVERED
• Addition/Subtraction
• The foundations of multiplication
• Counting Mastery: Grasp stable order, 1-2-1 correspondence, and cardinality.
• Subitizing: Instantly recognise number quantities.
• Number Bonds: Understand numbers up to 10, their compositions, and versatile uses.
• Arithmetic Basics: Gain proficiency in addition and subtraction.
• Ordinality & Magnitude: Know the sequence and relational aspects of numbers.
• Place Value: Learn how the order of numbers affects their value
• Arrays: Develop the foundations of multiplication
• Manipulatives: Use teaching aids familiar from the classroom like fingers, five frames, and number tracks 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
This app includes a free trial and a subscription that unlocks all the fun math games — plus every new update we add in the future!
• Subscriptions are charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your plan will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
• You can manage your subscription or cancel anytime in your iTunes & App Store Account Settings.
• Payment for renewal will be charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the price of your chosen plan.
• If you start a free trial and then subscribe, any unused trial time will be lost.
• Your subscription works across any device signed in with the same Apple ID.
Try Number Skills free today — help your monster learn numbers in a fun, friendly way, with no ads!

bluejetty:00150188:ios.description:
What is the Flame of Love Movement? 
Elizabeth Kindelmann, the Secular Carmelite and widowed mother of six to whom Mary and Jesus entrusted the mission of spreading this movement, asked this very question. Our Lady said: “My Immaculate Heart’s Flame of Love is Jesus Christ Himself!” The Blessed Virgin Mary explained to Elizabeth that She obtained from the heavenly Father, by the merits of the Passion of her Most Holy Son, an outpouring of graces so great as have not existed since the Word of God became Flesh (the words of our Most Holy Mother). She explained that She will blind Satan with the Flame of light and grace which bursts forth from her Immaculate Heart. This Flame must enkindle all hearts. Through Elizabeth, She tells us what we must do to collaborate with her in this great endeavor. The Most Blessed Virgin Mary asks us for prayers, sacrifices, holy hours in the family, and fasting to help her in this fight against evil. 
The very purpose of the Movement is to break Satan’s hold on souls, so that souls can be open to receiving an outpouring of grace implored by Our Lady. This grace that we will receive enables Mary, as Mother of God and of Humanity, to form Christ more fully in each heart. With Christ more fully formed in our hearts, the world will be prepared for the Triumph of Her Immaculate Heart, which will thus invoke a Second Pentecost, and will lead to a greater indwelling of the Holy Trinity in souls. Mary said Herself, “Since the Word became Flesh, I have never given such a great movement as the Flame of Love that comes to you now. Until now, there has been nothing that so blinds Satan.”
Download the app to learn more about this extraordinary grace!

bluejetty:00128975:ios.description:
It's just a well-known Backgammon game: everything you need to play and nothing more:
• a simple and nice interface
• play alone, with a friend or online 
• works offline without internet
• wooden board and atmosphere
• both vertical and horizontal board orientations are supported
• the Doubling cube with the Crawford rule.
The dice are thrown randomly and do not depend on who is playing, AI level and board conditions.
-> WHAT IS SO SPECIAL ABOUT BACKGAMMON?
Backgammon is one of the oldest board games, dating back about 5,000 years. Now the game is popular worldwide.
Playing backgammon requires strategy, tactics and luck. With each roll of the dice, players choose from a variety of options to move the checkers, and must anticipate their opponents’ possible counter-moves.
In one game, luck in rolling the dice can be critical, but in a series of games, skill is critical to win.
-> HOW TO PLAY
Each player has 15 checkers of a different color that move in opposite directions counting the points according to the numbers rolled by a pair of dice. The player first to get his checkers around, and then off the board, wins the game.
---
We value your feedback. Send any questions or feedback to us at contact@adikus.com

Over the Reality: A new level of Reality!
Discover Over the Reality (OVER), the leading platform in the world of Augmented Reality (AR) that transforms how you interact with physical spaces. With a global map divided into virtual plots (OVRLands), you can create and explore unique AR experiences anywhere in the world.
KEY FEATURES:
* Create and Customize Your Virtual Space
Personalize your OVRLands with immersive AR content. 
* Explore the World in AR
Join virtual events, discover artistic installations, and engage with interactive games overlaid on the real world. Every corner of the planet can hide a unique experience.
* Connect with the Community
Interact with other users, share your creations, and participate in global events and challenges.

You'll be able
bluejetty:00119248:ios.description:
Invoice & Estimate Maker app help you to quickly create professional invoices and send them to your customers. Its a perfect app for web designers, contractors, musicians, freelancers and all kind of small business owners. 
You'll be able to create invoices and estimates with-in few seconds. This business app allows you to create unlimited customers, products and services. You can choose from highly professional templates to generate invoice PDF and send it to your customer. You can enter all information about your business i.e. your company name, logo, address, email, phone number and more.
Manage all your invoices and billing on the go. The app shows you all outstanding invoices and help you to get paid faster. This app does not requires you to have an active internet connection. So you can invoice your customer before leaving the place where there is no network available. 
The app also keeps track of all the payments made towards an invoice. You can also sign the invoice or estimate on your device. 
Features:
* Create invoices and estimates.
* Customize company details and logo.
* Add unlimited customers, products and services.
* Professional invoice themes.
* Realistic invoice signature.
* Track payments.
* Configure multiple taxes (i.e. Service Tax, VAT etc).
* Discount on item or total.
* Email invoice in PDF format.
* Notes to specify terms / conditions.
* Convert estimate to invoice with just a single tap.
* iCloud backup & restore.
* Import customer from contact address book.
* Statistics
* Add "Paid" stamp on paid invoices.
* Fast & easy interface.
Please leave a 5 star rating if you find this app useful. Your support help us keep improving this app.
Information about the auto-renewable subscription
- You can purchase for monthly subscription ($1.99/month) or annual subscription ($19.99/year).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- For more information on how to cancel subscription, please review - https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: http://www.svgapps.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of use: http://www.svgapps.com/terms

bluejetty:00133413:android.description:
The Doomsland: Survivors Update Log
The world is engulfed in crisis, and our cities are occupied by countless wandering zombies!Arm yourself with weapons and powerful skills, and show them what you've got! Explore the map and collect resources, danger and opportunity coexist, start a thrilling adventure!
Simple operation, smooth experience
One-handed operation, flexible shuttle between monsters, tossing and turning in dangerous organs, flexible movement and fine strategy are indispensable, thrilling and exciting coexist! Excellent hand feel, bringing the most comfortable shooting experience!
A Variety of Skills, Play Your Game
Electric shock, flame, dual-wielding, random shooting, infinite combinations of multi-dimensional optional special talent skills, each time you clear a level, you will get a new game experience. Gorgeous effects and unique skill design bring a new and shocking sensory experience.
Massive Firearms, The Maddening Raging Firepower
Mighty grenades, SMGs with mindblowing rates of fire, and flamethrowers with incredible range will help provide a sense of security. Gather supplies, upgrade your equipment, and complete your arsenal. Use the weapons at your disposal to give these monsters a taste of your power!
Mystic Scenes, Start the New Adventure
Streets full of zombies, research rooms full of strange creatures, random maps make the adventure full of variables, and a variety of exquisite horror and detailed maps are waiting for your exploration!
Survive, and face this mutant menace!
Monsters are on the prowl. Danger lurks in every shadow of the city. Some have even mutated into grisly beings. Plants with mouths full of sharp teeth sprout from vines and release deadly toxins into the air. Every enemy is a deadly threat!
Facing the tide of enemies, use all your strength to survive in the apocalypse, you are the last hope!
The adventure continues!
The world needs a hero

bluejetty:00162578:ios.description:
TU ESTILO, TU MUNDO – TOMMY HILFIGER MÉXICO
DESCUBRE EL MUNDO DE LA MODA CON LA APP OFICIAL DE TOMMY HILFIGER MÉXICO
Lleva el estilo clásico americano al siguiente nivel con la app oficial de Tommy Hilfiger. Diseñada para quienes viven la moda todos los días, nuestra app te conecta con las últimas colecciones de ropa para hombre, mujer y niños, además de darte acceso a beneficios exclusivos, cupones, lanzamientos anticipados y mucho más.
Con una experiencia de compra rápida, intuitiva y segura, podrás renovar tu guardarropa desde donde estés, con productos originales y entregas en todo México.
COMPRA MODA PREMIUM DESDE TU CELULAR
● Accede a lo último en ropa, accesorios y calzado Tommy Hilfiger.
● Encuentra moda para mujer, hombre y niños con colecciones completas.
● Compra directamente desde la app y elige envío a domicilio o recoger en tienda.
● Agrega tus productos favoritos a la lista de deseos para comprarlos después.
● Usa tu cuenta Tommy.com para sincronizar tu experiencia online y en app.
● Filtra por talla, color, tipo de prenda o temporada.
BENEFICIOS EXCLUSIVOS PARA USUARIOS DE LA APP
● Sé el primero en conocer lanzamientos y ediciones especiales.
● Recibe promociones y cupones exclusivos solo por tener la app.
● Disfruta descuentos únicos durante eventos especiales como Hot Sale, Buen Fin o temporadas de rebajas.
● Participa en eventos y experiencias de marca solo disponibles desde la app.
EXPERIENCIA DE USO PERSONALIZADA
● Administra tu perfil y preferencias de compra fácilmente.
● Realiza seguimiento detallado de tus pedidos.
● Gestiona devoluciones y cambios directamente desde la app.
● Consulta reseñas de otros usuarios para ayudarte a elegir.
● Escanea códigos en tienda para obtener más información o comprar online.
NOVEDADES, TENDENCIAS Y MÁS
● Activa notificaciones para enterarte de promociones, lanzamientos y noticias de la marca.
● Mantente al tanto de eventos de moda, colaboraciones especiales y contenido exclusivo.
● Inspírate con ideas de outfits para cada temporada: primavera, verano, otoño o invierno.
● Recibe noticias del mundo del fashion en tiempo real.
MODA PARA TODOS LOS ESTILOS
Desde polos, camisetas, jeans y sudaderas, hasta vestidos, chamarras, bolsos y calzado: en Tommy Hilfiger encontrarás prendas que combinan lo clásico con lo contemporáneo, para cualquier ocasión. Ya sea que busques un look casual, elegante o urbano, la app te ofrece una selección premium que se adapta a tu estilo.
¿POR QUÉ ELEGIR LA APP TOMMY HILFIGER MÉXICO?
● Ropa 100% original y garantía de autenticidad
● Acceso prioritario a lanzamientos exclusivos
● Descuentos especiales para miembros de la app
● Compra segura y envíos a todo México
● Atención personalizada y soporte desde tu perfil
COMIENZA A DISFRUTAR DE LA EXPERIENCIA TOMMY
Descarga hoy mismo la app Tommy Hilfiger México y descubre una nueva forma de comprar moda con beneficios exclusivos, estilo premium y todo el respaldo de una marca icónica. Tu nuevo outfit está a solo unos clics de distancia.

bluejetty:00039743:ios.description:
DogHero agora é Serviços Petlove.
Novas reservas de cuidados do seu pet devem ser feitas no app ou site Petlove. Mas não se preocupe, o processo é simples e você continua contando com a mesma rede de heróis de confiança.

----------------------------------------------------
A DogHero é uma plataforma (aplicativo e site) que conecta tutores de pets a cuidadores de confiança para oferecer serviços de cuidado animal, funcionando no estilo de uma "plataforma de hospedagem" para pets.
Principais serviços oferecidos:
Hospedagem: O pet fica hospedado na casa de um cuidador ("herói") enquanto você viaja, recebendo atenção em um ambiente familiar.
Pet Sitter: Um cuidador vai até a sua casa para alimentar, trocar a água, limpar o espaço e brincar com o pet sem tirar ele da rotina.
Creche: O pet passa apenas o dia (algumas horas) na casa do cuidador para brincar e não ficar sozinho enquanto você trabalha.
Diferencial: Toda a reserva, pagamento e acompanhamento (envio de fotos e vídeos) são feitos pelo próprio app, garantindo cobertura de saúde/veterinária emergencial durante o período do serviço.

bluejetty:00115874:ios.description:
Smart Printer App makes everyday printing and document handling easy. Whether you need to print documents, photos, scan receipts or edit a PDF on the go, everything’s just a few taps away. No cables, no hassle! Just connect to Wi-Fi and you’re ready.
What you can do with Smart Printer:
WIRELESS PRINTING
- Send documents, photos, web pages and even notes straight to your printer
- Print anything straight from Dropbox or Google Drive
- Works with all popular formats like PDF, DOCX, PAGES, TXT and more
- Pair instantly with HP Smart Printer App, Canon Print or Epson Printer App for a smooth, plug-and-print experience
SCAN & SHARE
- Scan documents using your phone’s camera
- Instantly print or send scans wherever they need to go
EDIT & ORGANIZE
- Remove pages you don’t need from a PDF
- Turn photos into compact, easy-to-share PDFs
- Shrink image sizes without losing quality
- Switch images between different formats
- Add notes or markups with simple drawing tools
- Fine-tune your photos with easy-to-use editing features
DO EVEN MORE
- Extract text from images with OCR
- Remove image backgrounds in seconds
Smart Printer works with thousands of AirPrint-enabled printers from leading brands HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, Xerox, Lexmark, Ricoh, Kyocera and many more. No extra setup needed. Just connect your iPhone or iPad to the same Wi-Fi network as your printer and you’re good to go.

bluejetty:00175434:ios.description:
Don’t be fooled by media bias, fake news and misinformation. AllSides provides balanced news and media bias ratings.
Get news from The New York Times, Fox News, USA Today, The Wall Street Journal, CNN, The Daily Caller and hundreds more, all in one place. Instantly see the best political news coverage from the left, center and right.
Compare headlines side-by-side to get the full story. It’s the best and fastest way to avoid being misled by partisan media. 
800+ Media Bias Ratings reveal the political leaning of any outlet. 
Quickly find news and information on 100+ different topics.
We make the political bias of hundreds of news sources transparent, so you can easily identify different perspectives and avoid being manipulated by partisan media. 
The AllSides app features:
Balanced News and Headline Roundups. Compare stories from the left, center, and right, side-by-side so you can get diverse perspectives, spot media bias, and think for yourself.
Media Bias Ratings. 800+ media bias ratings reveal the political leaning of any news outlet. Add your voice to the ratings.
Topics and Issues. Quickly find news and information on 100+ different topics.
Perspectives Blog. Media Bias Alerts, commentary and analysis to help you explore media literacy, political polarization, bias, filter bubbles, and more.
Bias is natural, but hidden media bias misleads and divides us. By providing a balanced newsfeed informed by hundreds of media bias ratings, AllSides frees people from one-sided information bubbles so they can better understand the world — and each other.

Hop on your ship and escape to Adv
bluejetty:00129099:ios.description:
Adventure Bay is a fun farming game where you can rebuild your family's paradise farm town & ship and explore secret treasure islands! Get ready for a pirate world full of quests, puzzles and adventure! 
Hop on your ship and escape to Adventure Bay today and enjoy a new seaside paradise life as if you are in the Caribbean Isles; pass your time on the beach chilling, embrace hay day in your farm and harvest tropic crops, tend your animals with love and care, explore a titanic valley full of adventures and puzzles. Adventure Bay will be your go-to farming game! 
* EXPLORE a different island every time you travel! Enter the jungle, witness a wild animal crossing the river; visit a pirate town and sing with a happy sailor; defeat pesky thieves and get the treasure! All in the comfort of your home! You’ll never need another island quest away from your home!
* MANAGE your own family farm! Harvest crops, plant flowers, keep your animals well fed and happy! Farming has never been this fun! A family farm adventure awaits you when you get tired of the city and want a tropic escape to the seaside!
* FOLLOW Lydia, Henry and Jojo in a heartwarming story of love, adventure and bravery. Build a life and witness their happy ending! Your choices matter! Each episode is filled with love, secrets to uncover and mysteries to solve! Will they become a family? Will Jojo find love? And what about this monkey!? You decide! From sundown to sunrise village full of stories and secrets is at your fingertips!
* DECORATE your farm with dazzling trophies that are fit for kings! Treasures from the Sun Isle and gifts from the Moon Valley are ready for you to claim and display in your family farm! This idle island adventure will captivate you and you’ll never get bored.
* GET your town ship ready for adventures! Make upgrades to your ship and be the best sailor! Watch your very own ship evolve from a simple boat to a roaring pirate vessel! Travel to the far away tropic jungle, outsmart thieves, find treasures; solve puzzles and discover that secret seaside cove! Return home with treasures and relax on your titanic beach!
* FIX and decorate the biggest town in the Caribbean Island and create your own farm! Enhance your town, upgrade your factories, enlarge your fields; up your adventure game skills and build yourself a family island!
* OPEN your own tavern and get to cooking! Cook delicious tropic recipes! Bake a banana pie, mix a sunrise mocktail, make coconut ice-cream – you name it! Help Chef Otto with orders and receive valuable rewards! One piece of that delicious pie will be enough to swoon your customers and make Chef Otto happy!
* COLLECT treasures and valuable goods on the way of your adventures. Discover trophies in every different island and decorate your home town with them.
* PLAY special events that take place in a magical valley, a sunny beach and a monkey world! Escape to the happy world of seaside adventures with enjoyable puzzles and special rewards! Fun never ends in this funky bay town!
* BECOME the best sailor in the world along with Lydia, Henry and Jojo! Trade your goods with pirates from other bay towns!
* BUILD your own crew and compete with other crews! Meet new people and make friends! Socialize and enjoy a tropic and idyllic island adventure together with your friends! 
In Adventure Bay: Farm Games, sweet shimmering sands of tropic beaches and your own seaside village are waiting for you to explore, farm, fix and decorate! Enjoy the best island life simulator – your free time will be unique and pleasing like watching the sunrise every day! Play this happy idle adventure and farming game now!
Have questions and suggestions? Contact us at mobile@gamegos.com"

A new free to play version of Enchanted Kingdom: Backwoods that many players will like! This version has no plot differences with the original object finding games adventure, and its main feature is that you can play the entire hidden objects mystery games quest FOR FREE!
It’s been nearly 100 years since the greatest battle between the Arcadians and the Kinzuls and all that remains of the Kinzul Empire are fables and myths… Or so everyone thought. Reports of Kinzul sightings in the Arcadian Forest have reached your Academy, and it’s up to you to explore every nook of this new Empire! Your quest quickly takes a dark turn when during your thrilling adventure, you find mystical warriors with old scores to settle and a leader bent on the world’s destruction! Can you work with demigods and stop the Kinzuls from regaining their former glory? Find out in this exhilarating game!
· SAVE THE WHITE GRIFFIN FROM DRAGUS
Explore the Bonus Chapter to find another bunch of detective games and seek & find games and protect the White Griffin's life force from the evil Dragus - and the Empire from destruction!
· PLAY CHALLENGING PUZZLES AND MINI-GAMES, AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS.
Play hidden objects games to go through a range of exciting puzzles and riddles! You have to solve them all to save your Empire and its residents from the Kinzul warrior!
· UNIQUE COLLECTIONS AND ARTIFACTS!
Find and collect all the statuettes and hidden object games to learn about the Kinzuls, all the examples of medallions to find out about the magic creatures inhabiting the Woods, and use Phoenix Feathers to purchase items for your Laboratory! 
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Enchanted Kingdom: Backwoods! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00024299:ios.description:
Slither like snake! Play time limited mode with shrinking play area or unlimited time mode in the huge game arena & become the Biggest worm!
Features of the game:
• Collect unique skins for worms;
• Earn gold coins and gems for completing daily and calendar tasks;
• Improve your skills, collect bonuses and upgrade your worm;
• Participate in themed and secret events with unique gifts and tasks;
• Try classic mode, time mode and endless challenges.
GIFTS EVERY DAY
When a player enters the game, he will definitely receive a reward. As a result user can always improve his own worm and become #1 in the war arena among many other worms.
MISSION CALENDAR
Every month players can complete exciting tasks in the Mission Calendar to unlock unique worms skins with many skills and get big prizes.
ONLINE LEADERBOARD
In Worm Hunt there are global and local leaderboards. Players from any country can find the records of the best snakes in their own region, local maze or around the world. Share your records with friends!
How to beat the worm game? Collect as much food as possible and become the biggest snake in the gaming arena! Many other worms will get in the way of your battle royale, but you can defeat them by upgrading your worm. Join players from all over the world and fight in the battle arena in the worms zone! 
We constantly hold themed events in the game, such as Halloween, Christmas Day, New Year, St. Valentine Day and so on ... In which you can get unique skins for worms and a wide variety of gifts for every taste.
Always welcome your feedback and suggestions for improving the game so feel free to contact us at:
support@wildspike.com
Happy snake hunting! Play Worm Hunt and slither like a snake!

bluejetty:00114236:ios.description:
Get ready for a fun and addictive truck puzzle challenge!
Tap once to send the cubes from the truck onto the conveyor and watch them sort automatically. Match, clear, and progress through exciting levels filled with tricky obstacles!
How to play:
Tap the truck to release cubes onto the conveyor.
Sort and match the cubes to clear the line.
Outsmart unique obstacles that keep every level fresh.
Obstacles you’ll face:
Hidden Blocks – reveal what’s behind them to continue.
Curtains – sort the required color to lift them.
Ice Blocks – break through to free the cubes.
Barriers – prevent cubes inside from going out, but allow new cubes to enter.
Simple to play, hard to master! Can you clear them all?

bluejetty:00132622:ios.description:
ZOO ANIMAL DOCTOR - VET CARE
It’s a busy day at the zoo! The sweet animals aren’t feeling well today. Put on your coat, grab your medicine bag, and give each one the gentle care they need.
HELP SICK ANIMALS FEEL BETTER
The animals are waiting in line for your care! Each one has a special problem that needs a vet's attention:
• Poor Elephant has an itchy red rash all over! Use soothing cream to treat every spot until its skin is smooth and happy.
• Alligator ate way too many sweets and now its teeth hurt! Fill cavities, brush each tooth, and fix its smile so it can show off its pearly whites again.
• Little Squirrel has a painful inflammation and feels very unwell! Catch and remove all the bad germs so it’ll feel better and be ready to hunt for nuts again.
You’ll also care for a playful coyote, lovely dog, cute hippo, funny raccoon, and many more animals.
PLAY FUN ANIMAL GAMES
It’s not just checkups! Wash your new animal friends, feed them tasty treats, solve puzzles, and explore many fun surprises. Every visit brings something new and exciting!
DESIGNED FOR TODDLERS & PRESCHOOLERS
This fun and educational doctor game is made for kids ages 2–5, with activities perfectly paced for their attention span, skill level, and interests:
• Bright and colorful design with cute domestic and wild animals
• Simple, intuitive touch controls – perfect for little hands
• Fully human-voiced – hear the names of each animal and build vocabulary
• No ads or pop-ups – a safe, uninterrupted play experience
NURTURE KINDNESS & IMAGINATION
This game helps children develop compassion and care for animals while boosting logic, creativity, and emotional growth through pretend play and puzzle-solving.
CALM & CHEERFUL MUSIC
A warm and playful soundtrack creates a positive atmosphere that kids will love.
PLAY ANYWHERE, NO WIFI NEEDED
Download once and play anytime – in the car, at a restaurant, or cozy at home. All activities are ready wherever you are!
Every child has a heart ready to care for others. This is a quiet space for that kindness to grow — a place for gentle play, warm moments, and the simple happiness of being a friend to the animals.
Terms of Use: https://mathgamesfortoddlers.com/terms-of-use/index.html

bluejetty:00114448:ios.description:
Instant AI-Video & Synthetic Media Detector – Real or AI?
In a world where AI-generated and synthetic videos spread fast, Null AI: AI Video Authenticity Detector gives you the tools to verify whether a video is real or AI-generated in seconds. Perfect for social media, news verification, personal security, and fact-checking before you share.
Null AI – Fake Video Detector is a fast and accurate AI-generated video detection tool designed for everyone. Instantly analyze videos using advanced scanning technology built for daily users, journalists, creators, and social media consumers.
Check If a Video Is Real or AI in Seconds
Not sure if a video is authentic? Null AI analyzes visual patterns and signals to deliver a clear Real vs AI authenticity score. Ideal for viral clips, suspicious videos, manipulated media, and misinformation across social platforms.
Key Features of Null AI: AI Video Authenticity Detector
• AI-Generated Video Detection 
Identify synthetic or manipulated videos using advanced AI analysis.
• Fake Video Scanner 
Upload any video to check if it was generated or altered by AI.
• Video Authenticity Check 
Receive a confidence score explaining whether content appears real or AI-generated.
• Fast On-Device Scan 
Quick, secure, and privacy-first analysis.
• User-Friendly Interface 
Simple and intuitive design built for everyday users.
• Multiple Format Support 
Scan videos directly from your gallery or downloads.
Perfect For
• Verifying whether a video is real or AI-generated 
• Detecting synthetic or manipulated content 
• Journalists, educators, and creators 
• Anyone concerned about misinformation or video scams 
• Users looking for a fast, accurate, privacy-focused verification tool 
Privacy-Focused AI Video Verification
Null AI processes videos securely and does not require account creation or intrusive permissions. Files are analyzed temporarily and results are removed once the scan is complete.
Why Null AI?
Unlike generic AI tools, Null AI is built with one purpose: 
Help users verify video authenticity quickly, reliably, and transparently.
Stay Safe in the Age of AI-Generated Media
Synthetic and manipulated videos are becoming more common. With Null AI, you can analyze viral clips, suspicious messages, and social media videos before trusting or sharing them.

• Monthly Plan: $9.99 per month 
• Yearly Plan: $39.99 per year

bluejetty:00144166:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00144166:ios.description:
Transform Your Home with SmartHue
Elevate your living space into a sanctuary of light and color with SmartHue - the ultimate iOS app designed to unlock the full potential of your Philips Hue Bridge and Bluetooth-connected Hue lights.
Built specifically for Philips Hue smart lighting systems, SmartHue offers intuitive control, effortless customization, and seamless connection. With added support for Wiz, Tuya, LIFX lights, SmartHue brings your lighting vision to life.
Whether you’re setting the mood for a cozy evening, energizing your workspace, or bringing vibrant colors to life, SmartHue makes lighting your home simple, personal, and inspiring.
Key Features
1. Ultimate Philips Hue Control
Instantly control Philips Hue bulbs, strips, spotlights, and downlights via Philips Hue Bridge or direct Bluetooth connection.
Enjoy full functionality without the need for complex setups.
2. Effortless Setup
Connect to your Hue Bridge and Bluetooth-enabled lights in just a few taps.
Seamlessly integrate lights across your home’s Wi-Fi and smartphone Bluetooth.
3. Personalized Schedules
Automate your lights to wake you with a gentle sunrise, brighten your workspace, or create the perfect evening glow.
Set schedules with easy-to-use time and scene automation.
4. Group and Room Control
Organize your lights by room or zone.
Adjust the atmosphere of an entire floor or a single space with one tap.
5. Fine-Tuned Brightness and Temperature
Perfectly adjust brightness and color warmth to suit your needs, from vivid clarity to soft relaxation.
6. Voice Control with Siri
Hands-free lighting is here! Use Siri voice commands to turn lights on or off in any room.
Just say: “Hey Siri, turn on all lights on SmartHue” - and let your voice do the work.
7. Ongoing Improvements
Regular updates bring enhanced performance, new features, and an even better lighting experience.
Our dedicated support team is ready to assist whenever you need.
Why SmartHue?
If you love Philips Hue and want to experience its true potential, SmartHue is built for you.
Whether you are setting up your first Hue Bridge, expanding your smart home, or simply seeking effortless control, SmartHue makes smart lighting beautifully simple.
And for those looking to broaden their lighting setup - SmartHue also supports LIFX lights for even more flexibility.
Requirements
Compatible Devices: Philips Hue Bridge, Bluetooth-enabled Hue lights, Wi-Fi smart bulbs, light strips, lamps, and tubes.
Zigbee Protocol: Supports a range of Zigbee-enabled brands, including IKEA TRÅDFRI, GE Link, Osram, Sonoff, and others.
Support
For any questions or assistance, contact us at: smarthue@ecomobile.vn
Privacy policy: https://policy.ecomobile.vn/privacy-policy/privacy-policy-light-control-remote
Terms of Service: https://policy.ecomobile.vn/privacy-policy/term-of-service-light-control-remote

bluejetty:00080633:ios.name: Bíblia Sagrada NTLH
bluejetty:00080633:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00080633:ios.summary:
Bem-vindo à Bíblia nova tradução na linguagem de hoje, o aplicativo onde você pode ler a versão da Bíblia Sagrada NTLH offline!
Nova Tradução na Linguagem de Hoje (NTLH): Esta tradução, preparada pela Sociedade Bíblica do Brasil (2000), se
bluejetty:00080633:ios.description:
Bem-vindo à Bíblia nova tradução na linguagem de hoje, o aplicativo onde você pode ler a versão da Bíblia Sagrada NTLH offline!
Nova Tradução na Linguagem de Hoje (NTLH): Esta tradução, preparada pela Sociedade Bíblica do Brasil (2000), segue os princípios da tradução de equivalência dinâmica, sendo fiel aos textos originais (em hebraico, aramaico e grego).
A versão foi desenvolvida pela Comissão de Tradução da Sociedade Bíblica do Brasil, num processo que tomou 12 anos de pesquisas, buscando manter o texto com significado mais próximo aos textos originais – hebraico, aramaico e grego. A NTLH é uma revisão da Bíblia na Linguagem de Hoje, lançada em 1988. Porém, ela recebeu uma revisão tão profunda que é considerada pela própria SBB como uma nova tradução das Escrituras Sagradas.

bluejetty:00015782:ios.name: Terminology
bluejetty:00015782:ios.summary: Terminology is a browser for the English language – part dictionary, part thesaurus and part research tool. Terminology makes it easy to explore words and phrases, diving down to more and less specific terms - accessing web resources and ot
bluejetty:00015782:ios.description:
Terminology is a browser for the English language – part dictionary, part thesaurus and part research tool. Terminology makes it easy to explore words and phrases, diving down to more and less specific terms - accessing web resources and other apps for more detail and sharing.
More than a dictionary, Terminology can be extended with custom resources to search the Internet and other reference apps – making it a great place to satisfy any of your curiosities. 
## DICTIONARY, THESAURUS & SEARCH ##
- Offline U.S. English dictionary and word reference with simple, straightforward definitions. Based on the latest version of the Open English WordNet
- Definitions, synonyms, antonyms, and deeper word relations such as more and less specific words, part, part of, members, member of, pertains to, and more
- Favorite and create lists of terms
- Word browsing history
- Add your notes to any term
- Audio pronunciations
- Wildcard (?,*) searching
- Spelling suggestions
- Fast, reliable iCloud (CloudKit) sync and backup of history, favorites, notes, and resources
## EXTENSIBLE RESOURCES ##
Resources provide quick links to look up and search your terms on websites and in other apps. Ready to use resources for popular reference sites like Wikipedia, ChatGPT, Google, IMDb, and more, or create your own with simple URL templates.
Get more creative with AI resources to drill down on pre-populated prompts.
## MORE FEATURES ##
- Share extension lets you access Terminology from a text selection in any app
- Control Center integration for quick search
- Spotlight and Handoff support
- Great support for Accessibility features like VoiceOver and Dynamic Text.
- Shortcuts support
## TERMINOLOGY PRO ##
Terminology is always free to use, but you can get more out of the app with a Terminology Pro:
* Custom resources
* Unlimited term lists
* Unlimited notes per term
Terminology Pro is a reasonable annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime unlock.
## SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS ##
* Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase
* Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
* Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were initially charged for the subscription
* Subscriptions can be managed or canceled by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase
Have questions? Email support@agiletortoise.com.
Terms: https://agiletortoise.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://agiletortoise.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00086142:ios.name: PICOOC
bluejetty:00086142:ios.summary:
Welcome to Picooc, the health management application chosen by 25 million users worldwide. Using PICOOC smart devices and software can help you understand your physical condition more clearly and manage your health better.
Monitor Body Com
bluejetty:00086142:ios.description:
Welcome to Picooc, the health management application chosen by 25 million users worldwide. Using PICOOC smart devices and software can help you understand your physical condition more clearly and manage your health better.
Monitor Body Composition
PICOOC's team of health experts and engineers has developed a powerful algorithm model that can help people of different races around the world get more accurate body data. With the measurement of PICOOC smart body fat scale, it can provide you with up to 19 body indicators such as weight, fat, visceral fat, BMI, etc., and interpret and analyze these indicators.
*The number of body indicators depends on the device you are using.
Blood Pressure Data Logging (Russia only)
You can view the blood pressure data from the PICOOC smart blood pressure monitor on the PICOOC APP, including diastolic blood pressure, systolic blood pressure, pulse and other indicators. The PICOOC APP provides a convenient and intelligent blood pressure mean mode, which can make blood pressure recording more scientific.
Body Data Analysis and Health Advice
Every time you measure through the PICOOC smart body fat scale, you can get a detailed body data analysis report. PICOOC can help you analyze the changes in your body in different time periods, and provide health advice, such as problems that should be alerted or improved.
Baby Growth Record
You can use the PICOOC APP to record the baby's physical data during the growth process, including weight, head circumference, body length and other data. PICOCC will analyze the baby's growth for you through the data you have recorded.
Easy to Understand
All physical data are accompanied by colored prompts to help you better understand the status of the indicators, allowing you to accurately understand your physical condition. The clear trend chart can see the changes of main body indicators in each time period.
Data Storage and Sharing
Your measurement data is safely saved in PICOOC Cloud, so even if you reinstall it or change your smartphone, the data will not be lost. PICOOC can be used in conjunction with Apple Health, and the data of each measurement can be synchronized to Apple Health. PICOOC is also compatible with popular health and fitness apps like Fitbit. You can also download the data locally through PICOOC to help yourself or provide it to others for analysis.
PICOOC APP has been continuously improving, and also includes the following features:
● Record body circumference, you can record 6 items of body circumference data including waist circumference, hip circumference and chest circumference at the same time, PICOOC will also perform body shape analysis for you to help you improve your figure;
● Monthly health report, PICOCC will provide you with a health report every month for you to understand the changes in your body in that month.
● Unlimited users, you can create different accounts for all your relatives, PICOOC will also analyze and provide suggestions for the body measurement data of these accounts.
● Measurement reminder, you can easily set reminders through the APP, so that you will not miss the measurement.
● Athlete's body model. If you are a long-term exerciser, ordinary body fat scales are difficult to get accurate results. In PICOOC, you can use the athlete's body model BETA to help long-term exercisers understand the real situation of their body composition.
Data Security and Privacy
Data security is of paramount importance to us, your measurement data is stored in the app on your smartphone and in PICOOC's secure cloud services, which are fully compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) to ensure Your data is safe.
*Our health advice comes from experienced health experts who can guarantee the scientific nature of the health advice, but these advices are not equivalent to medical advice. If you have medical needs, please consult your doctor and follow their advice.

bluejetty:00044210:ios.description:
Welcome to Mystery Farm: Family Adventure—where family bonds and supernatural secrets collide!
Tired of city life? Join the Our Family as they trade skyscrapers for picket fences in a quirky American town. But this isn’t just any move—their new home buzzes with magical oddities, eccentric neighbors, and mysteries waiting to be solved!
WHAT AWAITS YOU:
UNCOVER SUPERNATURAL SECRETS
From sentient rose gardens to mirror-world doppelgängers, every corner holds a new enigma. Investigate ghostly sightings, decode ancient spells, and outwit mischievous magical creatures—all while keeping your family grounded (mostly!).
MEET YOUR FAMILY:
Grace: A journalist mom who narrates life like a news anchor. “Breaking news: Our backyard’s haunted—film at 11!”
Jim: A lovable inventor-dad who fixes problems (and toasters) with equal flair.
Luna: A teen mystic convinced every shadow hides a fairy.
Kevin: Her little brother, a pint-sized skeptic armed with science and snack theories.
FEATURES:
LIVELY STORYLINES
Dive into episodic tales blending heartwarming humor and spooky twists. Help Grace expose a fraudulent “magic” influencer, guide Luna through a fairy realm, or decode sentient graffiti with Jim!
BUILD YOUR TOWN
Restore the family’s Victorian house, plant magical gardens, and unlock quirky shops. Every renovation reveals new clues—and maybe a ghost or two!
ECCENTRIC CHARACTERS
Befriend (or outwit):
Ernie: A hustler selling “haunted” lawn gnomes.
Crow: A sarcastic talking bird with a superiority complex. “Caw! Your detective skills amuse me, humans.”
REALITY OR ILLUSION?
Dive into mysteries where magic blurs with imagination! Is that actual ghost in the attic… or just Ernie’s "haunted" merch scheme? Use Grace’s sharp wit to debunk frauds, Luna’s mystical hunches to spot real spells, and Kevin’s science experiments to prove—or prank—the truth. Will you expose the town’s biggest hoax… or accidentally summon a poltergeist? 
GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS:
Casual Puzzles: Match magical herbs, reassemble enchanted artifacts, or negotiate with trolls under the bridge.
Choices Matter: Help Luna embrace logic or double down on magic. Will Kevin become a believer… or a tiny MythBuster?
Seasonal Events: Host a spooky Halloween bash, solve a Valentine’s love curse, or outsmart leprechauns in spring!
CHARMING VISUALS
Explore hand-drawn neighborhoods where fireflies glow brighter and porch swings creak with secrets. Each season transforms the town—autumn leaves hide riddles, winter snows sparkle with hidden glyphs!
FREE TO PLAY
Mystery Farm: Family Adventure is free to download! Optional in-app purchases enhance your experience (but won’t bribe Crow—he’s stubbornly anti-microtransaction).
Ready to swap traffic jams for tractor ghosts?
Download now and start your family’s weirdest (and wittiest) adventure! 
Requires internet connection. Contains light fantasy violence (angry garden gnomes) and dad jokes. Parental guidance suggested for sarcastic birds.

bluejetty:00133483:ios.description:
OnePTE is your go-to practice app for mastering the PTE Academic, PTE UKVI and PTE Core Exam. This is a PTE exam preparation app where you can practice regularly with a study guide and mock tests that are similar to the real exam. You can even take a free PTE mock test to judge the quality of our practice exams before making any purchase. 
It also offers free templates for different types of questions, loads of audio for practicing listening, shadow reading to improve your pronunciation, blogs about different tips and tricks to answer tricky questions and of course with a comprehensive set of pte vocabulary. 
Key Features:-
5,600+ Practice Questions: Access thousands of practice questions with model answers. We update questions monthly to keep you prepared with 60% repeated questions.
AI Scoring for Realistic Results: Our advanced AI scoring system gives accurate scores in over 50 practice tests. It checks your fluency, pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary, giving you a score similar to the real PTE exam.
Instant Feedback: See your score and get feedback right after each practice session. Improve your skills with clear guidance after every attempt.
Mock Tests with Detailed Analysis: Take full-length mock tests that simulate the real PTE exam. Each test comes with a detailed report to help you see where you need to improve.
Personalized Study Plans: Get a study plan made just for you. Focus on the areas that matter most to reach your goal faster.
Templates and Strategies: Use proven templates and video tutorials to answer each question type effectively. Save time with strategies used by PTE experts.
Stay Up-to-Date: Prepare with the latest PTE questions and updates. We keep everything current to match the latest exam trends.
Community Support: Join our WhatsApp group for tips, shared study materials, and guidance from experts and fellow PTE students.
Study Anywhere, Anytime: Learn on your schedule. Use OnePTE on iOS for easy, flexible studying.
Extra Free Resources: Enjoy free templates, MP3s for listening practice, shadow reading exercises to improve pronunciation, and a complete PTE vocabulary list.
Track Your Progress : OnePTE keeps you informed of your progress with easy-to-read analytics. See your scores improve and track your progress over time – know exactly when you’re ready for the PTE exam.
Real-Time Practice Mode: Don’t have time for a full mock test? Use our Real-Time Practice Mode to work on specific skills or question types whenever you want, even for just a few minutes each day.
Simple & User-Friendly Interface: OnePTE’s clear design makes it easy to find what you need and get started with your study session. 
How OnePTE Helps You:
Boost Your Skills
Practice every section of the PTE exam with confidence. With OnePTE, you’re fully prepared to tackle every question type.
Stay Motivated
Track your progress, celebrate milestones, and stay motivated as you watch your scores improve.
Prepare Smarter, Not Harder
OnePTE’s targeted approach means you’re not just studying – you’re studying effectively, with every session designed to help you succeed.
OnePTE isn’t just about practice – it’s about smart preparation. Download OnePTE today and join thousands of PTE test-takers working toward success.

bluejetty:00160199:ios.description:
SPECIAL NOTE ABOUT DOWNLOAD
*** Downloading this app is a 2-step process: the first step is a download of the app template, and the second step is a full download of app content. Please do not navigate away from the app until both steps have been completed. ***
Developed especially for patients, caregivers, and families, this version of the Merck Manual medical information app is created just for you. Now with many new features and enhancements, the Merck Manual Consumer app is written in everyday language. This Consumer Version provides clear, practical explanations for thousands of medical disorders, including symptoms and what doctors do to diagnose and treat medical conditions. 
The trusted Merck Manual Consumer medical information app for on-the-go reference offers: 
• Health and medical information written and updated regularly by more than 350 medical experts
• Topics searchable by symptom, diagnosis or treatment, all written in easy-to-understand language
• Photos and Illustrations on thousands of disorders and diseases
• Animations that visually demonstrate diseases and treatments 
• Interactive Quizzes* to test knowledge on health topics--scores can be posted on Twitter 
• Drug and Medicine Information 
• Medical News and Commentary* covering the most current and important health topics 
• Editorials* written by top medical experts 
• Self-assessments* to check your health and fitness levels
• Medical Podcasts* debunking medical myths from acclaimed doctors across the country
*Internet access needed.
About Merck Manuals
Our mission is simple: 
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world. 
That’s why we are making the Merck Manuals available for free in digital form to professionals and patients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads.
NOND-1179303-0001 04/16
This mobile application is intended for use in the United States, its territories, Puerto Rico, and Canada only.
For more information please read the End User License Agreement at 
https://www.merck.com/policy/terms-of-use/merck-apps-home.html. 
For more information about our privacy practices, please see our privacy commitment at https://www.msdprivacy.com 
To report an adverse event with a specific Merck product, please call the Merck National Service Center at 1-800-672-6372.
For questions or help with the app, please contact merckmanualsinfo@merck.com

Welcome to Candy Crush Solitaire, the new solitaire game from the creators of Candy Crush Saga.
Play this fun, free-to-play TriPeaks solitaire card game! Train your brain and keep your mind sharp by challenging yourself with exciting levels to win candylicious rewards.
Candy Crush Solitaire is a fun and challenging solitaire card game for all types of players.
Join iconic Candy Crush Saga characters in a delicious journey around the world, creating lovely postcards on the way.
Relax and immerse yourself in Candy Crush Solitaire's beautiful game graphics, animations and design!
Candy Crush Solitaire is the perfect solitaire experience that combines the best features of classic TriPeaks patience games with the playful yet challenging Candy Crush Saga inspired blockers, and boosters.
Play it now for free and discover:
EXCITING & CHALLENGING SOLITAIRE LEVELS
Play through loads of fun and challenging TriPeaks card levels, all accessible anywhere, anytime online and offline.
Improve your skills and stock up for challenges by playing bonus levels to make your solitaire adventure more delicious than ever.
THE SWEETEST JOURNEY
Embark on a sugar-coated journey around the world, together with beloved Candy Crush Saga characters.
Decorate beautiful postcards from Hawaii, Paris, Japan, and beyond while progressing through the game.
UNIQUE DELICIOUS FEATURES
Try the powerful “Hold Slot” to set aside cards to use later in the level!
Use sweet Candy Crush boosters to help you go through hard levels, like the powerful Color Bomb.
TASTY REWARDS & EXCITING EVENTS
Log in daily to unlock exclusive rewards and take on thrilling events that challenge your skills. Win big prizes while diving into a world of fun-filled adventures!
RELAX & UNWIND
No matter where you are, Candy Crush Solitaire offers the perfect escape.
Step away from your routine and enjoy a delightful blend of strategy and relaxation, all in one smart and entertaining game.
Download Candy Crush Solitaire now for free!
Enjoy the sweetest TriPeaks solitaire card game. Unwind and relax while traveling around the world and challenge yourself in a new exciting solitaire adventure!
By downloading Candy Crush Solitaire, you agree to our Terms of Service, which can be found at https://king.com/termsAndConditions. Contains optional in-game purchases.

bluejetty:00095833:ios.description:
Your Ultimate Tinnitus Management App - TinniSound Sound Therapy.
Discover TinniSound Tinnitus Relief, a user-friendly, customizable app designed to mask and manage tinnitus with soothing sounds and gentle noise therapy. Whether you're seeking relaxation, improved sleep, or relief from tinnitus, this app offers powerful tools to create a personalized sound treatment tailored to your needs.
Key Benefits:
① Reduce Tinnitus Stress & Anxiety: Ease the emotional burden of tinnitus with calming audio.
② Fall Asleep Faster & Sleep Deeper: Enjoy uninterrupted rest with tailored soundscapes.
③ Relieve Ringing, Hissing & Buzzing: Target tonal and persistent tinnitus symptoms effectively.
④ Boost Focus & Mindfulness: Enhance concentration with sound-based therapy.
⑤ Developed by a Tinnitus Sufferer: Built with real experience for genuine relief.
Key Features:
* Custom Sound Blending: Combine white noise, pink noise, rain sounds, fan noises, and ambient layers for a unique mix.
* Tinnitus Matching Tool: Identify the perfect tone to mask your specific tinnitus frequency.
* Sleep Timer: Set durations with a gentle fade-out as you drift off.
* Ear Balance Control: Adjust sound to the left or right ear for targeted relief.
* Simple Design: Crafted for nightly use with ease of navigation.
Why Choose TinniSound?
Try TinniSound Tinnitus Relief today and reduce the impact of tinnitus on your life. While not a cure, TinnSound’s sound generator supports your tinnitus treatment or therapy journey. 
SUBSCRIPTION
TinniSound App offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: https://betterfeel.me/privacy-policy
Terms of service: https://betterfeel.me/terms
DISCLAIMER
i
TinniSound is not a tinnitus cure or tinnitus treatment. Whilst TinniSound is designed to help to reduce the impact of the distress associated with tinnitus, it should not be used as a substitute for, or replace professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you have any questions or concerns about your tinnitus or health in general, you should always consult with your doctor or audiologist.

bluejetty:00036426:ios.summary:

【Detailed Game Pictur
bluejetty:00036426:ios.description:
【Vast Map】
 Unknown fantasy world waiting to be explored. 
【Weather Systems】
 Such as drizzle, wind, snow, and other weather conditions, thereby transforming the game environment and making it no longer static.
【Detailed Game Picture】
 Whether if it’s a small bridge on top of a stream or a darkened altar scene, TALISMAN ONLINE M attempts at its best to restore the charm of ancient Chinese structures while leading you into this new immersive world to explore, solve, and take part in.
【Gameplay】
 * Alliance
 Random Team: Team up with strangers to do tasks, kill monsters, or complete specified operations，then you will get EXP, gift, silver, and materials.
 Guild：Set up or join a Guild to build and grow Guild together
 Spouse System：After reaching a certain level, players can date with favorite players. After dating a certain number of times, players can choose to become a companion, then hold a grand Chinese wedding ceremony, and invite friends to attend the wedding banquet.
 * PVP System
 Siege： Different from the full-service competition for a city in the general game, TALISMAN ONLINE M has designed a unique multi-city competition in the Siege. There are three main cities in the game, each Guild can only choose one of them to sign up. Compared to competing for a single city, how the Guilds choose between opponents and teammates to make the Siege more strategic.
 Cloud Arena: Players can play 3V3 PK challenges in team mode, invite friends to fight alongside, and fully enjoy the fun of PVP competition
.
 * Interaction
 Manor: Create furniture, entertain friends, plant crops, and freely build the ideal mansion. The antique furniture with Chinese characteristics not only can be used as decoration, but also can interact with each other, so that players can experience more fun of Manor.
 Trading system: Sell extra gears and gain silvers at any time. 
Real-time interaction: Send voice messages, and chat with everyone.
 * Cultivation
 Weapons: Talisman Online M inherited the gameplay settings of Talisman Online, each class has two main weapons which can be easily adapt to various combat environments.
 Forge system: Using forge system is the most efficient way to power up gears, mounts, weapons. 
Pet System: The most intuitive manifestation of a pet is that it helps the character, giving you bonus stats based on different stat point allocation
 Mount System: More than 100 mounts can be selected. Mounts play a vital role in the game. Not only can be used as players' mobility tools, but also can help players improve their combat power. The mount system is activated at lvl 8 and can be divided into single mounts and double mounts. The methods of obtaining and training are different.
Talisman Online M Official Facebook Page：https://www.facebook.com/TalismanOnlineM/

bluejetty:00025813:ios.description:
Train your brain logic with a ink painting (Black & White) Japanese crossword! Enjoy nonogram puzzles.
How to become a master?
There is no time limit in this logic game, so no rush. Think one step ahead when you face a difficult board. It might become your last one!
Try to use your logical thinking on the puzzle board to find out where the black square lying and where the 'X' icon taking place in order not to fill up the board.
Find your zen by balancing between drawing an ink painting with your imagination and getting correct in selection which is black and which is white by the hint from the numbers.
Why play this game?
Pixel Art Puzzle: Number Logic has been designed for people who want to unwind and train their brain at the same time. This puzzle game includes combinations of various scales and complexity together with simple addictive gameplay which is similar to mine puzzle from old computer and sudoku games. Whether you are tired or in low spirits, a few rounds of playing Pixel Art Puzzle: Number Logic will cheer you up and let your mind relax.
If you like challenging yourself with logic games, Pixel Art Puzzle: Number Logic is the perfect option for you. Take a break from the daily grind and get rid of negative thoughts by immersing yourself in this brain teaser. You definitely won't be bored playing number puzzle games! Relieve stress or train your brain with a relaxing yet challenging block puzzle game of Pixel Art Puzzle: Number Logic anywhere, anytime!

Conoce Tenpo, el primer neobanco de Chile. 100% digital, sin sucursales físicas y con lo mismo de tu banco pero desde una sola App. Descubre una experiencia personalizada, abre tu cuenta y obtén tu Tarjeta de Crédito en minutos. Gana dinero solo por tener saldo en tu cuenta y muchos otros beneficios. ¡Descárgala ahora!
Con tu cuenta Tenpo, tienes todo en tu celular. Puedes transferir sin costo a otros bancos y entre Tenpistas, comprar online o en comercios físicos, invertir y enviar plata al extranjero. Además, retira efectivo desde cajeros automáticos con tu Tarjeta física Tenpo cuando lo necesites.
Beneficios de usar Tenpo:
100% digital: Sin sucursales físicas ni trámites presenciales.
Apertura accesible: Abre tu cuenta en minutos, sin papeleos ni complicaciones.
Menos costos: Cuentas y Tarjetas sin comisiones ocultas ni costos de mantención.
Cuenta remunerada: tu dinero puede generar rendimientos automáticamente.
Experiencia personalizada: configura límites, alertas y recibe recomendaciones según tus hábitos financieros.
Control total desde la App: visualiza gastos, movimientos y saldos en tiempo real.
Atención 24/7: soporte por chat, llamada o correo, cuando lo necesites.
Seguridad y regulación: protección de tus datos y tu dinero bajo lo más altos estándares del sistema financiero.
Más beneficios en un solo lugar: pagos, transferencias, ahorro, inversiones y mucho más desde una sola App.
¿Tienes entre 14 y 17 años? Prueba Teenpo, la cuenta pensada para los teens, sin cobros y con control desde la App.
¿Qué incluye la cuenta Tenpo? Una cuenta que no te cobra por todo.
¿Cómo? Depositando dinero desde tu Cuenta RUT, Cuenta Vista, Cuenta Corriente y/o Cuenta de Ahorro a Tenpo, sin límite de saldo.
Con tu Tarjeta Tenpo puedes:
Comprar online en Chile y el extranjero (Amazon, AliExpress, eBay y mucho más.)
Pagar suscripciones como Netflix, Spotify, HBO Max, Uber, Steam, Playstation, y más.
Comprar en tiendas como Paris.cl, Easy, Mercado Libre, y otras.
Pide tu tarjeta física y podrás comprar en todos los comercios del país.
Con tu cuenta puedes:
Transferir fácilmente a cualquier banco y entre usuarios Tenpo
Dividir gastos con amigos o cobrarles desde la App
Enviar dinero a Colombia, Argentina, Perú, EE.UU., Haití y Venezuela
Retirar efectivo con tu tarjeta en cajeros automáticos
Invierte con tu cuenta Tenpo de manera simple y segura con fondos de Credicorp Capital Asset Management, compañía que cuenta con más de 65 años de trayectoria en Chile. Haz crecer tu plata directamente desde tu App.
Además, tu plata puede generar ganancias todos los días de forma automática y sin complicaciones. ¡Si la tienes en otra parte, muévela a donde ganas más!
Otras funciones de tu cuenta digital:
Programar pagos automáticos de cuentas básicas (luz, agua, cable, etc)
Recargar celular, Internet, cable y más.
Revisar tus gastos por categorías con “Mis Finanzas” ¡Te ayudará mucho para tener consciencia sobre lo que gastas!
Visualizar notificaciones, cartolas, y novedades
Contratar seguros personalizados (Robo de Auto, Seguro de vida, Seguro de Multi asistencia y personalizarlos con más coberturas).
Participar en desafíos financieros y ganar premios. Al subir niveles podrás crecer y acceder a nuevos beneficios.
Acceder a atención al cliente 24/7. Estamos disponibles para ti a través de nuestro Call Center 600 006 1110, página web Tenpo.cl o ingresando a nuestro centro de ayuda desde la App.
Tu seguridad es prioridad. Tenpo está regulado por la Comisión para el Mercado Financiero (CMF) de Chile. Tu plata y tu cuenta están 100% seguras.
Ubicación: Presidente Riesco 5711, Santiago de Chile.
Todo lo que necesitas en una sola App: tu cuenta digital + tu tarjeta. ¡Descárgala ahora!

bluejetty:00152687:ios.description:
Auto AI: AI Job Search & Apply
Transform your job search with Auto AI Jobs - the revolutionary platform where you swipe to apply and AI agents handle the entire application process for you.
KEY FEATURES:
Swipe to Apply System
Browse curated job opportunities and simply swipe right to apply. Your personal AI agent takes over and completes the entire application process automatically, including form filling and document submission.
AI Agent Job Applications
Your dedicated AI agent applies to jobs based on your swipe preferences and profile. The more you swipe, the smarter it gets at finding and applying to opportunities that match your interests and qualifications.
Smart Job Matching
Intelligent algorithms analyze your profile and swiping behavior to match you with the most suitable job openings. Get personalized job recommendations that align with your career goals and preferences.
Resume Optimization
AI-powered resume analysis and optimization suggestions help you create compelling application materials. Improve your resume quality and increase interview callbacks.
Application Tracking
Monitor all your job applications in one centralized dashboard. Track application status, interview schedules, and employer responses efficiently.
Professional Profile Management
Maintain detailed professional profiles with work experience, skills, education, and career preferences. Keep your information updated and ready for instant applications.
Real-time Notifications
Get instant alerts for new job matches, application updates, and employer communications. Never miss important opportunities or deadlines.
Multi-platform Integration
Connect with major job boards and company career pages. Apply to positions across multiple platforms without switching between different websites.
WHY CHOOSE AUTO AI JOBS:
Increased Application Volume
Apply to significantly more positions in less time compared to manual applications. Our automation ensures you never miss relevant opportunities.
Higher Success Rate
Optimized applications and strategic matching increase your chances of getting interview invitations and job offers.
Time Efficiency
Reduce job search time from hours to minutes daily. Simply swipe through opportunities and let your AI agent handle all applications while you focus on interview preparation.
Career Growth
Access advanced career insights and market trends. Make informed decisions about your professional development.
Privacy Protection
Your personal information and job search activities remain completely confidential. Secure data handling with enterprise-level encryption.
PERFECT FOR:
Active job seekers looking to maximize their application reach
Professionals seeking career advancement opportunities 
Recent graduates entering the competitive job market
Career changers exploring new industries and roles
Busy professionals conducting discreet job searches
Remote workers seeking flexible employment opportunities
SUBSCRIPTION BENEFITS:
Premium subscribers unlock unlimited AI job applications, advanced resume optimization, priority job matching, detailed analytics, and premium customer support.
Free users can explore basic features including limited job applications, standard job matching, and basic profile management.
Download Auto AI Jobs today and revolutionize your job search experience. Let artificial intelligence accelerate your career growth and help you land your dream job faster than ever before.

bluejetty:00120676:ios.description:
Medical Simulation on the iPhone and iPad.
Excellent learning tool for doctors, medical students, nurses and paramedics/EMS.
Undertake realistic medical simulation training without the need for expensive/high-fidelity mannequins. 
Perfect revision aid for life support courses, OSCE exam preparation or ad hoc teaching.
Verbally create a scenario as simple or as complex as the teacher wishes. If the student has a 2nd device, connect via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi and the 2nd device becomes a realistic monitor.
If the student initiates appropriate management for the simulated patient, the teacher can improve the patient’s vital signs. If not... the patient can deteriorate and eventually suffer cardiac arrest.
The teacher can alter multiple patient parameters as the scenario evolves:
- ECG
- BP
- Arterial Line
- SpO2
- Resp Rate
- Temperature
- Fingerprick Glucose
- Capnography (once intubated)
- End-Tidal CO2
- Lab results - Haematology/Biochemistry/Blood gases
Change ECG rhythms instantly or via defibrillation/CPR cycle.
Choose from an extensive list of ECG rhythms (In App Purchase required to access advanced waveforms)
•Normal Sinus Rhythm
•VF
•VT
•Asystole
•Various AV conduction defects
•AF
•AF with digoxin effect
•Torsades de Pointes
•Atrial Flutter
•Flutter Pause
•Bigeminy
•Electrical Alternans
•Mild / Severe hyperkalaemia
•Junctional Escape
•Long QT
•Multiple Ectopics
•Pacemaker with and without capture
•Pre-Excited AF
•ST elevation / depression
•SVT
•Wolf Parkinson White
Once intubated, multiple capnography options are available (In App Purchase Required to access advanced waveforms)
•Normal Breathing

listings.description:
Medical Simulation on the iPhone and iPad.

Excellent learning tool for doctors, medical students, nurses and paramedics/EMS.

Undertake realistic medical simulation training without the need for expensive/high-fidelity mannequins. 

Perfect revision aid for life support courses, OSCE exam preparation or ad hoc teaching.

Verbally create a scenario as simple or as complex as the teacher wishes. If the student has a 2nd device, connect via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi and the 2nd device becomes a realistic monitor.

If the student initiates appropriate management for the simulated patient, the teacher can improve the patient’s vital signs. If not... the patient can deteriorate and eventually suffer cardiac arrest.

The teacher can alter multiple patient parameters as the scenario evolves:

- ECG
- BP
- Arterial Line
- SpO2
- Resp Rate
- Temperature
- Fingerprick Glucose
- Capnography (once intubated)
- End-Tidal CO2
- Lab results - Haematology/Biochemistry/Blood gases

ASVAB Test - is a comprehensive preparation app for the Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery (ASVAB) tests widely used in the U.S. Armed Forces. With interactive exercises, detailed explanations, and personalized progress reports, ASVAB Prep provides effective and confident test preparation. This app provides the tools you need for effective and focused preparation.

- Over 2,000 practice test questions, each with detailed answer explanations
- Analysis of current results in the Statistics section.
- 5 test models for quick successes
- Regular notifications when you need to practice. 
In-app purchase:

- Subscription cost: one week - $3.99, one month - $9.99, tree month - $19.99.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be disabled by going to User Account Settings after purchase.
- Cancellation of the current subscription during the active subscription period is not allowed
