With
bluejetty:00083164:ios.description:
As the proud owners of 6thNBRHD, we embody the vibrant spirit of urban fashion. Our brand is a fusion of street style and professional edge, empowering individuals to make a bold and confident statement through their wardrobe choices.
With each collection we curate, we strive to create pieces that resonate with the urban lifestyle, capturing the essence of modernity, versatility, and self-expression. Our designs are carefully crafted to exude authenticity and capture the pulse of contemporary fashion trends.
At 6thNBRHD, we believe that fashion is a powerful tool for self-ownership and personal empowerment. We invite you to embrace your unique style and elevate your wardrobe with our meticulously curated selections. Whether it's a casual streetwear ensemble or a polished professional look, our brand is dedicated to helping you own your style and make a lasting impression. 
In the heartwarming backdrop of our childhood, six cousins grew up side by side in the same neighborhood, nurturing a bond that would shape our lives and ignite a shared passion for creativity and entrepreneurship. Inspired by the values instilled in us by our families and the sense of unity we experienced growing up, we embarked on an extraordinary journey to create 6thNBRHD.
Our brand is more than just a label; it is a testament to the power of community, friendship, and shared dreams. Together, we combined our diverse talents and perspectives to build a brand that celebrates authenticity, inclusivity, and the transformative power of fashion.
With every stitch and design, we pour our hearts into creating pieces that reflect our collective experiences, memories, and aspirations. Each garment is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, using only the finest materials and techniques.
We invite you to join us on this remarkable journey, where you can not only discover impeccable style but also become a part of our story. As you don our creations, you are not just wearing a garment; you are embracing the spirit of a neighborhood that fostered creativity, camaraderie, and a shared sense of purpose.
Together, we are redefining the boundaries of fashion, weaving together threads of heritage, innovation, and authenticity. By embracing our brand, you become part of our extended family, where trust, respect, and customer satisfaction are at the core of everything we do.
We are 6thNBRHD, a brand that believes in the power of unity, the magic of childhood memories, and the infinite possibilities that emerge when we come together. Come, be a part of our journey and experience the transformative impact of fashion, as we bring our shared vision to life.

Live Transcribe - Speech to Text
Transform spoken words into text instantly with Live Transcribe - Speech to Text. This innovative application is designed specifically for individuals who value effective communication. Whether you’re a student, a professional, or someone who is deaf or hard of hearing, Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is tailored to enhance your communication experience seamlessly and efficiently.
Key Features of Live Transcribe:
- Real-Time Transcription: Experience the power of real-time speech-to-text conversion with Live Transcribe. This app employs advanced speech recognition technology to ensure you capture conversations instantly. Perfect for lectures, meetings, or casual discussions, Live Transcribe ensures you never miss a word spoken and gives you the confidence of knowing you have accurate text outputs.
- Designed for the Hearing Impaired: Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is a crucial tool for individuals who are hearing impaired. With immediate text outputs, Live Transcribe ensures that everyone can actively engage in conversations. This app fosters an inclusive environment both in personal and professional contexts, making it easy for users to participate without barriers.
- User-Friendly Interface: Navigate effortlessly with the intuitive design of Live Transcribe. The user-friendly interface of Live Transcribe - Speech to Text is accessible for users of all ages, allowing quick adjustments to personalized settings for all your transcription needs.
- Multilingual Capabilities: Break down language barriers effortlessly with multi-language support in Live Transcribe. Whether you're speaking Spanish, French, or any other language, Live Transcribe - Speech to Text accommodates various languages, making it perfect for multicultural interactions and diverse communities.
- Export and Sharing Options: Save your transcriptions for future reference! With Live Transcribe, you can easily export conversations into PDF or text files, simplifying the process of creating study materials or sharing important meeting notes with colleagues.
Who Can Benefit from Live Transcribe - Speech to Text?
- Students: Capture every important detail during lectures to enhance your academic performance. Live Transcribe - Speech to Text acts as an essential study aid, ensuring you never miss crucial points discussed in class.
- Professionals: Improve your productivity and efficiency in meetings. With reliable transcription services from Live Transcribe, you can focus on listening and engaging in the conversation rather than worrying about note-taking, ensuring that every vital piece of information is accurately recorded and available for later review.
- Educators: Use Live Transcribe to create accessible lesson plans that cater to the needs of all students. By utilizing Live Transcribe - Speech to Text, you can provide valuable resources for your classroom, promoting inclusivity and engagement among all learners.
- Deaf and Hard of Hearing Communities: Live Transcribe significantly enhances communication abilities in both personal and professional environments. It bridges gaps in conversation, enabling individuals to participate fully in discussions without barriers, ensuring a more inclusive experience.
Why Choose Live Transcribe - Speech to Text?
Effective communication is more critical than ever in today’s fast-paced world. Live Transcribe - Speech to Text provides a comprehensive solution for anyone seeking to improve accessibility. Its robust features allow for the easy conversion of spoken language into written text, helping users navigate conversations smoothly and eliminating barriers that hinder communication.
With Live Transcribe, you can take control of your communication experience in busy lecture halls, office meetings.

Are you looking for a calming tile-matching game to relax while waiting for your coffee, winding down after work or taking a short break?
Blossom Master: Tile Matching is your peaceful escape - a simple and beautiful puzzle game with flower tiles, relaxing visuals, and satisfying gameplay.
Just tap to match three identical flower tiles and clear the board. Inspired by classic mahjong solitaire, each level is designed to be smooth, fun, and just challenging enough to keep you coming back.
 Why you’ll love Blossom Master:
- Relaxing, stress-free gameplay made for puzzle & flower lovers.
- Easy to start, with smooth level progression.
- Beautiful flower tiles and soft, calming effects.
- Smart layouts that combine logic and beauty.
- Weekly Challenges with unique layouts and exclusive tile skins to unlock!
- Regular updates bring fresh levels and the most delightful visual experience.
 Main Features:
- Match 3 of the same flower tile to clear them.
- Play offline anytime - no internet needed.
- Unlock 300+ flower tile designs.
- Use helpful boosters when things get tricky.
- Compete on the global leaderboard.
- Over 10,000+ levels waiting for you to conquer. 
- Join Weekly Challenges for exclusive rewards and fun new layouts.
 How to Play:
- Tap tiles to match 3 of the same kind.
- Match fast to earn bonus stars.
- Clear all tiles before the timer ends.
- Use boosters to help you win tough levels.
- Unlock new tiles and layouts as you level up.
- Check in every week to take on new Weekly Challenge!
Whether it's a quick play during breaks or a relaxing session before bed, Blossom Master brings calm and joy to your day.
Download Blossom Master: Tile Matching now and enjoy peaceful puzzle play anytime, anywhere.
If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us at support@lihuhugames.com. We are here to ensure you have the best gaming experience possible.

bluejetty:00146171:ios.name: Remote for Tautulli
bluejetty:00146171:ios.summary:

WHAT IS TAUTULLI?

bluejetty:00146171:ios.description:
Remote for Tautulli connects to your existing Tautulli server installation and gives you easy access to all data.
WHAT IS TAUTULLI?
Tautulli is a monitoring application that you can run alongside your Plex Media Server and tracks what has been streamed, who streamed it, when and where they streamed it, and how it was streamed. For further information please refer to tautulli.com. Remote for Tautulli is not affiliated with Plex Inc. or Tautulli itself.
FEATURES
- Universal app for iPhone and iPad
- App for Apple Watch
- Easy initial setup using qr code scanner
- List of current streams incl. details like user, player, quality, eta
- Option to terminate streams with optional message
- All details to media e.g. summary, file size, bitrate, audio/video/subtitle tracks, duration, release date, rating and more
- Watch history for media items
- Cross linking between related media, track/album/artist, episode/season/tv show
- Cross linking to the official Plex app (if installed)
- iCloud keychain sync for connection info (if enabled in system)
- Dark Mode / Light Mode (requires iOS 13)
ADDITIONAL FEATURES OF PRO VERSION
- Tautulli notifications for all events that are supported by Tautulli*
- Easy Tautulli notification setup process
- Plex Media Server update monitoring
- Tautulli update monitoring incl. release notes
- Option to trigger Tautulli update
- Playback history incl. search and stream details
- Recently added media
- User list incl. details like playback statistics, recently watched, last known ip address incl. map*, and user's playback history
- Statistics e.g. most streamed movie/tv show/artist or most active users
- Statistics graphically represented as charts
- List and details of all libraries incl. search with access to all media details without having those streamed
- Plex Media Server logs*
- Tautulli logs
- Tautulli notification logs
- Tautulli newsletter logs
- Siri Shortcuts (requires iOS 12)
- Widgets (requires iOS 14)
- Lockscreen Widgets (requires iOS 16)
- Today widget for easy and fast overview of current streams and updates
- Management of multiple Tautulli servers incl. fast switch
- Number of current streams as app icon badge
USE CONDITIONS
Remote for Tautulli requires an already configured installation of Tautulli v2.1.20 or higher that is connected to your Plex Media Server and reachable from outside your local network. 
* This feature requires a corresponding configuration in Tautulli

Pick a walking itinerary, preview its stops and walking times, and see how it fits into your day. Use the map to put each place in context and find your next stop as you explore.
KNOW MORE BEFORE YOU GO
Find out what makes each place worth a visit, check practical details and estimated visit times, and decide where to spend your time.
Download your travel companion and make your next day out your own.

bluejetty:00080190:ios.description:
STEP UP AS THE HERO who stops possessed entities from wreaking havoc. Your mission? Prevent the darkness from engulfing the city. Search for hidden objects, decode an array of puzzles, and find the difference that unravel the secrets within.
TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE as you face off against malevolent forces! An amusement park, once filled with laughter and joy, now terrifies its visitors with hauntings and horrors. Don your detective's hat and delve into a series of puzzling deaths and occult happenings!
You will investigate the deaths of people in a strange set of circumstances. A once place of fun and laughter now horrifies its visitors. The Amusement Park is haunted, they say… but where’s the proof? And then a woman finds you, Allison. She asks for help to find out what happened to her beloved sister. Could she be the victim of the ghosts as well? Unravel the tangle of enigmas and put the puzzle together. The evil spirits are on the loose! Darkness is descending upon the city and only you can stop it! Don't be afraid of the dark side, and it won't be able to consume you. Remember, you hold the fate of many restless souls in your hands!
THRILLING DETECTIVE GAME FEATURES:
A HAUNTED AMUSEMENT PARK: Investigate eerie deaths and uncover the truth behind the chilling whispers!
ACHIEVEMENT GALORE: Revel in the accomplishment of a variety of achievements that not only mark your progress but also challenge you to master the game's puzzles!
OVER 100 ENIGMATIC PUZZLES: Search and find hidden objects, decipher clues, find the difference and piece together the mystery to progress!
THEMED ARTWORK AND MUSIC: Experience captivating visuals and haunting melodies that deepen the atmosphere!
RIVETING GAMEPLAY: Search for hidden objects in multiple locations, each with its own unique atmosphere, solve intricate puzzles to progress through the storyline! 
FREE TO PLAY VERSION: The f2p version offers you the chance to dive into this mystery adventure and enjoy its rich storyline, with optional in-game purchases to enhance your experience!
Dive into "Mystical Riddles: Ghostly Park" for a free-to-play experience of solving mysteries and battling darkness!

Tide Flow – Tides, Weather & Waves
Your essential tide & weather companion for beach lovers, surfers, swimmers, fishermen, and everyone enjoying the coast.
Tide Flow features a unique and beautifully designed real-time tide clock—simple, intuitive, and visually stunning. Instantly see whether the tide is rising or falling, and how long until the next high or low tide, at a single glance. No need to interpret complex charts: with Tide Flow, understanding the tides has never been easier.
Get fast access to wave heights, UV index, and accurate local weather forecasts, all in one easy-to-use app. Whether you’re fishing, surfing, swimming, or just relaxing seaside, Tide Flow gives you the info you need for a perfect day on the coast.
Key Features
Real-Time Tide Clock: Instantly know if the tide is coming in or going out, and how long until the next high or low tide—thanks to our unique, elegant clock interface.
Tides, Weather & Waves: All coastal conditions in one place – tide heights, wave swell, wind, UV index, and weather forecasts. Powered by Apple WeatherKit and trusted marine sources.
Global Coverage: Find tide predictions for over 20,000 coastal locations worldwide.
Favorites: Track your favorite beaches, fishing spots, surf breaks, or coastal towns at a glance.
Plan Ahead: View detailed tide charts and forecasts. The Premium version unlocks 10-day forecasts and even more detailed data to help you prepare your next fishing trip, surf session, swim, or seaside outing with confidence.
Tide Flow combines essential functionality with an elegant, easy-to-use experience. Perfect for locals, tourists, water sports lovers, fishermen, and anyone who wants to enjoy the coast at its best.
Note: Tide Flow is for recreational planning only and not for professional navigation.

bluejetty:00180377:ios.description:
Optiontown offers unbeatable discounts of up to 50% on flight tickets, and up to 75% on upgrades, preferred seats, extra bags, airport lounge and several other unique travel options to provide a luxurious and comfortable travel experience within your budget. 
The simple design of the Optiontown app makes it easy to explore the various travel options according to your travel needs, desires and preferences. So, you are just a few steps away from enjoying the best of travel benefits with the Optiontown app.
Download our FREE App to enjoy awesome benefits and huge savings:
• Flight Pass – Smart Pass for Smart Travelers! Save up to 50% on flight tickets. Fly more pay less.
• Upgrade to business class for up to 75% less!
• Enjoy Flatbed in economy for more comfort (empty seats next to you)
• Buy extra bags for your flight at up to 50% discount!
• Reserve your preferred seats at half price!
• Access airport lounge for up to 50% less
• Buy Priority Check-in & Boarding
• Earn cash rewards for travel flexibility
• Ultimate peace of mind in travel planning and booking
Key products of Optiontown:
Flight Pass Option (FPo) – Flight Pass allows you to conveniently pre-purchase a number of flights at a fixed LOW PRICE and book flights later when you want to travel.
Upgrade Travel Option (UTo) – This option allows you to upgrade to Business or First class for up to 75% less and enjoy the luxurious comforts and privileges.
Upgrade Pass (UP) - This pass offers the most convenient and cheapest way to pre-purchase multiple upgrades to Business / First Class at a very low price and book upgrades later when needed.
Empty Seat Option (ESo) - This option offers you a chance to acquire one or more empty seats next to your seat, thereby giving you more comfort and space.
Empty Seat Pass (ESP) - This Pass offers the most convenient and cheapest way to pre-purchase empty seats at a very low price and book empty seats later when needed.
Preferred Seat Option (PSo) – This option allows you to get preferred seats for your flights (emergency exit, window, aisle, etc) at a nominal price and makes your journey a lot more comfortable.
Preferred Seat Pass(PSP) - This Pass offers the most convenient way to pre-purchase preferred seats at a low price and book your favorite seat later whenever needed.
Extra Baggage Option(XBo) – This option offers travelers a chance to carry Extra Baggage on their flights at substantially low prices, thus making their journey a lot more convenient and within their budget!
Bag Pass - This Pass offers the most convenient way to pre-purchase extra baggage at a low price and carry the extra baggage later whenever needed.
Priority Handling Option (PHo) - This option gives you the fastest route through the most congested airport areas and minimizes the time spent at the airport for a nominal price. You also get priority boarding and check-in.
Lounge Access Option (LAo) - This option offers travelers Business Lounge access at the airport at a substantially lower price and enhances your travel experience and convenience.
Flexibility Reward Option (FRo) – This option allows you to earn rewards of upto $100 per passenger if you are flexible to take an alternate flight of your own choice.
Preferred Flight Option (PFo) - This option allows you to get a chance to fly on your most preferred flight at a nominal fee.
Multiple Booking Option (MBo) - This option offers you the advantage to hold bookings on multiple flights and decide which flight you want to take later.

bluejetty:00066476:ios.description:
*** Now with Spotify and Apple Music integration ***
Welcome to djay! The #1 DJ app and winner of multiple Apple Design Awards lets you start mixing your favorite music instantly. Connect your Spotify or Apple Music account to access millions of songs and create your own DJ mixes in no time – right inside djay.
djay transforms your iOS device into a full-featured DJ system. Seamlessly integrated with your music library, djay allows you to mix your favorite songs and playlists. You can perform live, remix tracks, or enable Automix mode to let djay create a seamless mix for you automatically. Whether you are a professional DJ or a beginner who just loves to play with music, djay offers you the most intuitive yet powerful DJ experience on an iOS device. 
SPOTIFY INTEGRATION
• Access to the full Spotify music catalog
• Your playlists, editorial selections, and more seamlessly integrated
• Powerful search capabilities for the vast music catalog of Spotify
APPLE MUSIC INTEGRATION
• Access to over 100 million songs
• Your library: all your music seamlessly integrated
• Powerful search capabilities for the vast music catalog of Apple Music
• Match: recommendations based on the currently playing song 
• Add songs and playlists to your Apple Music library right from within djay
ADVANCED MEDIA LIBRARY
• Spotify: Millions of tracks + your own playlists (Spotify Premium subscription)
• Apple Music: Millions of tracks + your personal library in the cloud (Apple Music subscription)
• TIDAL: Millions of tracks, music videos, high quality sound (TIDAL DJ Extension) 
• SoundCloud: Millions of underground and premium tracks (SoundCloud Go+) 
• Beatport: Millions of electronic music tracks (Beatport Advanced Subscriptions)
• Beatsource: Millions of open-format music tracks (Beatsource Subscription)
• Files: access files in the cloud (e.g. Dropbox), on your iOS device, or on external hard drives seamlessly
• My Collection: Powerful playlists management and meta data editing 
AUTOMIX
• Automatic, beat-matched mixes 
• Queue and Playlist automation
NEURAL MIX™
• Isolate vocals, drums, and instrumentals in real time (not available with Apple Music or Spotify)
MUSIC PRODUCTION TOOLS
• Sequencer: create beats on top of your music live
• Looper: remix your music with up to 48 loops per track
• Beat-matched sequencing of drums and samples
• Extensive content library with 1000+ loops and samples.
HARDWARE INTEGRATION
• Plug-and-play integration with 100+ MIDI controllers by Pioneer DJ, AlphaTheta, Reloop, Hercules, Numark, Denon DJ
• Digital Vinyl System (DVS) Integration
• Advanced MIDI Learn to map any class-compliant MIDI controller
• Support for Bluetooth audio and MIDI
• Support for multi-channel USB audio interfaces and video output
POWERFUL AUDIO ENGINE
• Ableton Link integration
• High-quality mixer, filter, EQ, isolator, and limiter
• Advanced time-stretching and pitch shifting
• Over 40 built-in audio effects 
• Live recording 
ADVANCED AUDIO ANALYSIS
• Fluid Beat Grid: the world’s most sophisticated beat detection and sync engine
• Key detection 
• Colored waveforms
• Auto-Gain 
BUILT FOR iOS
• Accessible via VoiceOver
• Airplay, Apple Watch, and iCloud integration
The optional PRO subscription allows you to subscribe once and use djay Pro across all your Mac and iOS devices, including access to all PRO features, as well as 1000+ loops, samples, and visuals. Cancel anytime. 
A supported streaming subscription and an internet connection are required to access songs from a streaming service in djay. No recording available for streamed songs. Neural Mix cannot be used when streaming from Apple Music or Spotify. Specific songs may not be available or accessible on your account or in your country. Streaming service availability and pricing may vary depending on country, currency and service.

bluejetty:00120024:ios.summary:

Starting to learn a
bluejetty:00120024:ios.description:
New topics, more content! Daily Anatomy Flashcards teaches healthcare students the 500 most important anatomical structures in a beginner-friendly format. The perfect entry into the world of anatomy!
*Reach your goals*
Starting to learn anatomy can be overwhelming, but it shouldn't be. Daily Anatomy can be used without any prior knowledge. It starts with the basics, and challenges your brain more and more over time. Learning with Daily Anatomy is not only about repetition. It introduces information in varying forms. Solving a problem in different ways helps you memorize information longer-term and finally be able to fully absorb it. Whether on your next exam, or in your medical professional career, all the anatomy structures will be at hand. No more thinking. Just knowing.
*What will you learn?*
With Daily Anatomy you learn all the important structures of human anatomy. This includes bones, muscles, nerves, vessels and specific points on the bones.
Instead of many thin arrows pointing at various structures, each structure is clearly highlighted in green in its entirety. This way you can easily identify and memorize both shape and location.
*How to stay motivated and not forget*
Whether you need to learn lists of information, or for instance, every muscle and bone in the human body including how they function together, there is a method really works to help you out. The bonus is that this method doesn't stress you out either because you get to take lots of breaks.
It's called spaced repetition, and it's the way to go for knowledge that sticks in your cranium.
By using spaced repetition, you work through a series of increasing intervals of time between studying what you've previously learned. Whether you need to learn lists of information, or for instance, every muscle and bone in the human body including how they function together, there is a method really works to help you out. The bonus is that this method doesn't stress you out either because you get to take lots of breaks.

bluejetty:00029555:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of air combat and become the ace fighter in this extraordinary game that combines the thrill of dogfight and WW2 plane games. Get ready for an epic air war in Metalstorm style and unleash your skil
bluejetty:00029555:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of air combat and become the ace fighter in this extraordinary game that combines the thrill of dogfight and WW2 plane games. Get ready for an epic air war in Metalstorm style and unleash your skills in this high-flying adventure. Prepare for intense dogfights, showcase your aerial prowess, and join the ranks of the sky warriors!
Engage in various thrilling game modes:
- Ranked Match: Engage in fast-paced 4v4 Team Death Match, intense 2v2 Duels, or challenging 1v1 Solo battles against friends and foes alike.
- Event Mode: Choose from cooperative and competitive modes such as Free For All, Last Man Standing, Last Team Standing, Capture the Flag, and Defend the Base.
- Group Battle: Invite your friends to join you online and train together to become master pilots, showcasing your skills against players from around the world.
- Single Player Mode: Embark on an unrivaled collection of dogfight missions, including Death Match, Bonus Hunt, Devil Regiment Challenge, Cannon Only, and Duel!
Highlighted Features:
- New Event: Participate in exciting seasonal events to unlock exclusive and rewarding content.
- Friend System: Invite and add friends within the game, team up with them to partake in thrilling online battles.
- Upgraded Team System: Join a team and compete for glory on the Top Team leaderboard.
- Impressive Aircraft Fleets: Choose from a vast selection of over 100 fighters, each based on real modern prototyped aircraft, for adrenaline-pumping dogfights.
- Extensive Tech Tree: Explore a deep and unique upgradable tech system for each aircraft, enhancing your skills and capabilities.
- Customized Equipment System: Enhance your combat power by equipping advanced wings, engines, armor, and radar.
- Arsenal of Weapons: Arm your aircraft with powerful air-to-air missiles, air-to-surface missiles, and cannons for peak performance. Use flares to decoy enemy fire.
- Personalized Paintings: Stand out in the sky with famous airshow paintings and unique seasonal paintings, giving you a competitive edge.
- Graphics Selection: Tailor the game's graphics settings to optimize performance on your device.
- Intuitive Maneuvers: Execute thrilling barrel rolls and backflips by swiping in different directions to evade enemy fire.
- Smooth Controls: Enjoy easy and responsive controls by customizing the accelerometer or virtual pad to your preference.

bluejetty:00168110:ios.description:
Hey, Law Nerds! You asked for an app, and we heard you loud and clear. So we built one just for us! Introducing the Law Nerd App – never miss a livestream again! #WeLiveHereNow and it's time to bring our global community together. 
Designed specifically for our ever-growing community of law nerds, this app will keep you informed, engaged, and always in the loop. Are you tired of missing out on last-minute livestream updates, verdicts, and prime-time TV appearances? Worry no more, because the Law Nerd App has your back!
Features:
1. Push Notifications: Stay in the loop with real-time push notifications for livestreams. If something wild goes down in court, we’ll be able to easily reach you so you don’t miss it! You'll be the first to know when Emily goes live, so you can tune in and get your legal fix of Law Nerd Love.
2. Global Availability: Finally, our international community is brought together! The Law Nerd App is available worldwide, so law nerds from every corner of the globe can stay connected and informed. We’re so excited to bring you all under one roof!
3. User-Friendly Interface: Navigating the Law Nerd Live App is a breeze, thanks to its clean and intuitive design. You'll find all your favorite Emily D. Baker content at your fingertips – no law degree required!
**Coming soon** 
Law Nerd Meetups: When Emily attends an event LIVE, she'll be able to create a space just for attendees of the event to connect! This will be a game-changer for the Law Nerd community. From YouTube Conferences to BravoCon, to special events— we’re looking forward to seeing our community in person.
One-Tap Calendar Integration: Sync the calendar on your phone with the Law Nerd App and you’ll never have to worry about time zones again! Whether it's a scheduled livestream or a pop-up session, subscribing to the calendar integration will allow you to see how Emily’s programming fits within your day!
So, what are you waiting for? Download the Law Nerd App today and make sure you're always in the know, up-to-date, and ready to ride with us! 
See you on the inside!
--

bluejetty:00089274:ios.description:
ARRO is a taxi app created to simplify everyday transport through innovative, easy-to-use tools for hailing and paying for taxi rides. With the tap of a button, ARRO connects you to the nearest available drivers in every location, to get you where you’re going, faster! Download the app today and start using it for all of your travel needs!
Available in: New York, Chicago, Boston, San Francisco, Houston, Miami, London, and more!
HOW TO HAIL WITH ARRO:
At the bottom of the home
screen, tap the box labeled "I NEED A TAXI". Next Tap
"Where to go?" You will see a dropoff screen where you can
enter Final Destination. You'll receive a fare estimate, route
preview, and ETA of the nearest available driver. When you're ready
to hail, tap "Order a Taxi" at the bottom of the screen to
be matched with a driver. When the ride is over, the fare is paid
automatically with the card on file or another payment method of your
choosing. If you are not logged in or do not have an account we will
still provide a free fare estimate for you to compare with other ride
services as our courtesy. 
HOW
TO PAY WITH ARRO:
If you are already in a taxi that you didn’t hail with our app, you
can still use ARRO for faster payment! From the home screen, tap “I'M
ALREADY IN A TAXI”, then enter the 7-digit check-in code displayed
at the top of the taxi’s screen to pair the taximeter with your
ARRO account. At the end of your trip, your fare will be paid
automatically and your receipt will be emailed to you!

bluejetty:00092068:ios.description:
The Armstrong Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Armstrong Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Armstrong Bank App, you must be enrolled as an Armstrong Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.
